She has remained in complete remission for over three years after transplant, without detectable treatment-related sequelae. The authors suggest that dose-intensive chemotherapy with autologous bone marrow rescue may have curative potential in children with refractory malignant germ cell tumors.

pmid-8275469.summary_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ精巣胚細胞腫瘍92例を解析し、真の病理学的病期Iと潜在性病変を有する病期IIを区別する原発腫瘍の特徴を検討した。多変量解析では血管侵襲と胎児性癌の割合が有意で、この2因子による予測モデルは85.9%の確率で病期を正しく判定した。両因子を全例で評価し、治療方針の決定に役立てることを提案している。
pmid-8275469.summary_en: This study analyzed 92 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors to identify primary tumor features that distinguish true pathological stage I disease from occult advanced disease. In multivariate analysis, vascular invasion and the percentage of embryonal carcinoma remained significant. A model using these two variables predicted pathological stage correctly in 85.9% of cases. The authors suggest that these factors should be assessed in all clinical stage I nonseminomatous patients to guide therapeutic decisions.

pmid-8276652.summary_ja: 1964〜1988年に精巣摘除術と腸骨・傍大動脈への放射線療法を受けた精巣セミノーマ128例の後方視的解析。5年無病生存率は病期Iで97%、病期IIAで93%であった。再発は4例（3%）で、いずれも照射野外であり、多くは化学療法で救済された。予防的縦隔照射の有無にかかわらず縦隔再発は認めず、根治的精巣摘除術と放射線療法が第一選択と結論づけている。
pmid-8276652.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 128 patients with histologically confirmed testicular seminoma, including 95 with stage I and 33 with stage IIA disease, treated with orchiectomy and radiation therapy to the iliac and paraaortic lymphatics at a single institution from 1964 to 1988. Five-year disease-free survival was 97% for stage I and 93% for stage IIA. Four patients (3%) relapsed, all outside the radiation field, and most were salvaged with chemotherapy. No mediastinal recurrences occurred with or without prophylactic mediastinal irradiation. The authors conclude that radical orchiectomy with iliac and paraaortic irradiation is the treatment of choice.

pmid-8283538.summary_ja: 腎転移性絨毛癌は稀な病態であり、その初発症状として血尿と腎腫瘤を呈する例はさらに稀である。本論文は2症例を報告し、文献レビューを行っている。無月経も診断の手がかりとなり得ることを示唆している。これらの所見を認めた際には、腎腫瘤の鑑別診断として転移性絨毛癌を考慮する必要性を示している。
pmid-8283538.summary_en: This report presents two cases of metastatic choriocarcinoma of the kidney, a rare entity whose primary presentation was hematuria and a renal mass. The authors review the literature on this uncommon presentation. The title also highlights amenorrhea as a clue to the diagnosis. Recognizing these features may help clinicians consider this rare diagnosis when evaluating a renal mass. The report is aimed at improving awareness of an unusual clinical presentation.

pmid-8284872.summary_ja: 精巣がんに対する精巣摘除術の11年後に後腹膜腫瘍を生じた症例報告。原発の精巣腫瘍は純粋な絨毛癌で、後腹膜腫瘍は絨毛癌を伴わない胎児性癌と推定された。化学療法と後腹膜リンパ節郭清により完全寛解が得られた。精巣がんの晩期再発か、性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の原発かの鑑別は困難であると論じている。
pmid-8284872.summary_en: This case report describes a patient who developed a retroperitoneal tumor eleven years after orchiectomy for testicular cancer. The primary testicular tumor was pure choriocarcinoma, while the retroperitoneal lesion was likely embryonal carcinoma without choriocarcinoma foci. Complete remission was achieved with combination chemotherapy and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. The authors note that it is difficult to determine whether the retroperitoneal tumor is a late recurrence of testicular cancer or a primary extragonadal germ cell tumor.

pmid-8289453.summary_ja: 1985年から1991年に播種性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の63例を後方視的に検討した。初回シスプラチン併用化学療法で完全奏効は38%だった。41%に外科的切除を行い、平均30か月の観察で75%が無病状態であった。進行例の救援化学療法は5例に行われ、手術を加えて救済できたのは1例のみだった。
pmid-8289453.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 63 patients with disseminated testicular germ cell tumors treated with initial cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy between 1985 and 1991. Complete response was seen in 38%, and 41% underwent adjunctive surgical resection, including intraoperative radiation in two seminoma patients. Salvage chemotherapy was given to five patients with progression, and only one was salvaged by surgery. Disease-free status was achieved in 75% at a mean follow-up of 30 months.

pmid-8289455.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法中に、血清腫瘍マーカーが正常なまま後腹膜の転移巣が増大した4例を報告した。growing teratoma syndromeの典型的な臨床像を示す。全例で外科的切除が行われ、術後6〜24か月の無病生存が得られた。
pmid-8289455.summary_en: This short case series describes four patients with growing teratoma syndrome, in which enlarging metastatic masses containing mature teratoma appeared during chemotherapy for nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. All masses were retroperitoneal and grew despite normal serum tumor markers. Surgical excision was performed in all four patients, with disease-free survival from 6 to 24 months afterward.

pmid-8291972.summary_ja: 小児の仙尾部奇形腫4例を報告した。典型的な腫脹を示す例は診断が容易である一方、血管腫を伴う例や尾状付属物を示す例、肛門皮膚瘻を示す例では診断が難しかった。直腸診と適切な画像検査、特にコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)が診断に有用であり、臨床的疑いを高く持つことが重要と結論づけた。
pmid-8291972.summary_en: This report describes four children with sacrococcygeal teratoma. Two neonates had obvious or subtle sacral swelling, one had a tail-like appendage at the natal cleft, and one had an anocutaneous fistula with partial sacral agenesis. The authors emphasize that a careful rectal examination combined with imaging, such as computed tomography, is needed to diagnose less obvious cases, which require a high index of clinical suspicion.

pmid-8293405.summary_ja: 軍の医療センター7施設で精巣腫瘍の黒人患者66例を後方視的に検討した。予後、左右差、非セミノーマの発症年齢は一般集団と同様であった。一方、間質性腫瘍がやや多く、セミノーマの発症年齢は若く、白人と比べて診断が遅れていた。シスプラチン併用化学療法により生存率が改善した。
pmid-8293405.summary_en: This multicenter retrospective review of 66 Black patients with testicular tumors from military medical centers compared their features with the general population. Prognosis, side distribution, and age of onset for nonseminoma were similar, but interstitial tumors were slightly more common, seminoma presented at a younger age, and diagnosis was delayed compared with White patients. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy improved survival in this population.

pmid-8297725.summary_ja: 培養細胞87株の培養上清中のPLAPおよびPLAP様物質を測定し、胚細胞腫瘍を含む腫瘍細胞での発現を評価した。新たな免疫放射定量法(IRMA)は従来の酵素免疫測定法より高い検出率と再現性を示した。PLAP様物質の異所性発現は過小評価されており、腫瘍マーカーとしての有用性は抗原量で再評価すべきだと結論づけている。
pmid-8297725.summary_en: This study measures placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP) and PLAP-like material in culture media from 87 neoplastic and normal cell lines, including germ cell and non-germ cell tumours. A new immunoradiometric assay (IRMA) detected PLAP in 46% of epithelial and germ cell cultures, versus 33% with the conventional enzymatic assay (IAEA). The IRMA was more robust, with lower coefficients of variation. The authors conclude that ectopic expression of non-enzymatic PLAP-like genes is more common than previously recognized, and that PLAP's utility as a tumour marker should be re-evaluated using antigen-mass assays rather than enzyme activity.

pmid-8302019.summary_ja: 多くの臓器の癌と奇形癌は、分化が成熟段階で停止した組織特異的幹細胞に由来するという仮説を提示したレビュー。腫瘍の分化度は未分化幹細胞の割合と成熟停止の段階で決まる。奇形癌で得られた知見は他臓器の癌にも適用でき、細胞傷害性治療に代わる分化誘導療法の可能性を示唆する。
pmid-8302019.summary_en: This review proposes that carcinomas of many organs, and teratocarcinomas, arise from tissue-determined stem cells whose differentiation is arrested at a maturation stage. The degree of tumour differentiation depends on the proportion of undifferentiated stem cells, the stage of arrest, and the ability of some cells to escape it. The authors argue that teratocarcinomas, long studied as a model, are unique only in the potential of their stem cells, and that insights from embryonic regulation could support therapies that redirect malignant stem cells toward normal differentiation as an alternative to cytotoxic treatment. The abstract provided is truncated.

pmid-8307082.summary_ja: 一側の精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対して精巣摘除術を受けた患者が、3年後に反対側に第二の原発性精巣がんを発症した症例報告です。初回手術時の対側精巣生検は陰性でした。生検陰性でも後から胚細胞腫瘍が生じ得ることを示しています。
pmid-8307082.summary_en: This brief case report describes a patient who was found to have a second primary testicular cancer three years after orchiectomy for the first tumor. The contralateral testis had a negative biopsy at the time of the first surgery. The title points to the limitation of a negative contralateral biopsy, which does not exclude later development of a testicular germ cell tumor. The abstract reports only this single patient.

pmid-8307507.summary_ja: 19歳女性の右卵巣腫瘍で、高カルシウム血症を呈した症例です。切除された腫瘍は典型的なディスジャーミノーマ(未分化胚細胞腫)で、術後にカルシウム値は正常化しました。若年女性で高カルシウム血症を伴う卵巣腫瘍として、本腫瘍が2番目に多いことを指摘しています。
pmid-8307507.summary_en: This case report describes a 19-year-old woman with a right ovarian tumor, abdominal swelling, polydipsia and polyuria, and serum calcium of 12.2 mg/dl. After salpingo-oophorectomy, the tumor was a typical dysgerminoma and calcium normalized postoperatively. The authors note that dysgerminoma is the second most common ovarian neoplasm associated with hypercalcemia in young women, after small cell carcinoma of the hypercalcemic type. They emphasize that pathologists should be aware of this to avoid diagnostic confusion on microscopy. The paper also briefly reviews the literature.

pmid-8308927.summary_ja: 男性の胚細胞腫瘍171検体で染色体マーカーi(12p)を解析した研究です。異常核型の約8割で認められ、非セミノーマで多く見られました。正中線腫瘍の7例は胚細胞腫瘍と再分類されました。i(12p)は診断的、また予後的な意義を持つ可能性があると結論づけています。
pmid-8308927.summary_en: This study evaluated the i(12p) isochromosome as a marker of male germ cell tumors in 171 evaluable tumor samples from 150 men, and tested whether it could diagnose germ cell origin in 28 midline tumors of uncertain histogenesis. i(12p) was found in about 79% of abnormal karyotypes, more often in nonseminomas than seminomas. Cytogenetic failure was associated with complete chemotherapy response. Copy number of i(12p) did not affect outcome. FISH detected i(12p) in tumors where karyotype failed, and seven midline tumors were reclassified as germ cell tumors.

pmid-8308995.summary_ja: 米国小児科学会の前思春期精巣腫瘍登録から、新生児の精巣腫瘍22例を検討しました。卵黄嚢腫瘍が最多で、ほとんどの患者は無病でした。化学療法導入前に卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断された1例は転移性疾患で死亡しています。陰嚢内腫瘤の鑑別診断として本疾患を考慮すべきと述べています。
pmid-8308995.summary_en: This registry review analyzed 338 prepubertal testis tumors collected by the American Academy of Pediatrics since 1980, focusing on 22 tumors in neonates under one month old. Yolk sac tumors were most common, followed by gonadal stromal tumors and juvenile granulosa cell tumors, with gonadoblastoma and teratoma less frequent. Preoperative AFP levels ranged widely. Most of the 18 children with follow-up had no evidence of disease, while one child with yolk sac tumor treated before chemotherapy died of metastatic disease. The authors recommend considering neonatal testis tumors in the differential diagnosis of a scrotal mass.

pmid-8311655.summary_ja: 性腺外奇形腫6例に含まれる膵組織を免疫染色で解析し、胎児および成人の膵と比較しました。奇形腫内の膵組織には成熟した膵島が見られる一方、胎児・新生児膵に似た広範な膵島過形成(nesidioblastosis)も認められました。異常な分化がホルモン産生不全につながる可能性を示唆しています。
pmid-8311655.summary_en: This study analyzed six extragonadal teratomas containing pancreatic tissue and compared their neuroendocrine cells with fetal and adult pancreas. Immunohistochemistry for insulin, glucagon, somatostatin, pancreatic polypeptide and other markers was performed. All six teratomas had mature-appearing islets with beta, alpha, delta, and PP cells, along with widespread nesidioblastosis resembling late fetal and neonatal pancreas. Alpha and delta cell proportions were increased in several cases, indicating immaturity. Abnormal differentiation may cause deficient hormone production, which the authors suggest.

pmid-8314305.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞株Tera 2を用い、MMP-2の発現調節を検討した研究です。未分化で腫瘍形成能を持つ細胞はMMP-2活性が低く、レチノイン酸による分化誘導でMMP-2発現が著明に増加しました。悪性形質との関連を示す他モデルとは対照的な結果で、臨床ではなく細胞生物学的な知見です。
pmid-8314305.summary_en: This study examined matrix metalloproteinase-2 (MMP-2) regulation in Tera 2 human embryonal carcinoma cells. Undifferentiated, tumorigenic cells produced low MMP-2 activity, which was not altered by bFGF or TPA. Retinoic acid-induced differentiation markedly increased MMP-2 expression and type IV collagenase activity, while TIMP-1 and TIMP-2 expression was largely unchanged. Unlike many models where collagenase activity tracks malignancy, this pattern suggests MMP-2 upregulation reflects differentiation. The work is cell-biological rather than clinical.

pmid-8587840.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍190例に対する修正Einhorn法による化学療法の成績を報告した研究です。胎児性癌組織型とマーカー陰性例で成績が良好でした。一次治療抵抗性または再発の112例では奏効率53.6%で、完全奏効例の平均寛解期間は37か月でした。第三選択療法の寛解率は24.5%でした。
pmid-8587840.summary_en: This Hungarian report describes 190 patients with germ cell testicular tumours treated with a modified Einhorn chemotherapy scheme, with the best responses in embryonal histology and marker-negative patients. A second cohort of 112 patients with primary resistance or relapse received salvage combination chemotherapy including cisplatin, with a 53.6% response rate. Complete responders had a mean remission of 37 months versus 6.1 months for partial responders. Third-line therapy achieved remission in 24.5%, and the authors conclude that salvage regimens and metastasectomy offer long-term survival to a minority.

pmid-8737555.summary_ja: 1969〜1987年にジョードプルで記録された精巣腫瘍100例をWHO分類で後方視的に検討した研究です。単一組織型の胚細胞腫瘍が76%を占め、セミノーマと胎児性癌が多くみられました。停留精巣に生じた例が5例あり、混合型では奇形癌が優勢でした。地域的な疫学・病理像の報告です。
pmid-8737555.summary_en: This review of 100 testicular tumours recorded at Jodhpur from 1969 to 1987 classified cases by WHO histologic typing. Tumours accounted for 2.57% of male genital malignancies, peaking in the third and fourth decades with right-sided predominance. Five cases arose in undescended testes. Germ cell tumours of a single histologic type made up 76%, with seminoma (34%) and embryonal carcinoma (28%) most common, while teratocarcinoma predominated in mixed-type tumours. The study provides a regional epidemiologic and pathologic description.

pmid-9050490.summary_ja: 良性卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫38例を、腹腔鏡手術19例と開腹手術19例で後方視的に比較した研究です。腹腔鏡群では術中破裂が多かったものの、入院期間は有意に短くなりました。平均11か月のフォローアップで重篤な合併症はありませんでした。腹腔鏡下の治療は安全で費用対効果も高いと結論づけています。
pmid-9050490.summary_en: This retrospective comparison included 38 women with benign ovarian cystic teratomas (dermoids), 19 treated laparoscopically and 19 by laparotomy, matched for age, gravidity, parity, and lesion size. Laparoscopy produced more intraoperative ruptures but a significantly shorter hospital stay. Cystectomy with ovarian preservation was usual. After a mean follow-up of 11 months, no severe chemical peritonitis or persistent pelvic pain occurred in the laparoscopy group. The authors conclude that laparoscopic management is safe, cost effective, and speeds recovery.

pmid-9050499.summary_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫内の毛髪を腹腔鏡下に除去するための新しい器具を紹介した報告です。テフロン製で、先端6cmが溝付きのテーパー形状になっています。毛髪の塊の中で回転させると、毛髪が先端に絡みつき容易に引き出せます。腹腔鏡手術中の奇形腫内容物の扱いの課題に対応するものです。
pmid-9050499.summary_en: This short report describes a new laparoscopic instrument for removing hair from ovarian dermoid cysts. The Teflon device is 35 cm long and 9 mm in diameter, with a distal 6 cm tapered segment bearing longitudinal and transverse grooves. When rotated in the hair mass, the hair adheres to the tapered portion and can be withdrawn easily. The instrument addresses a practical problem of intraoperative handling of mature teratomas during laparoscopic surgery.

pmid-9050501.summary_ja: 完全型アンドロゲン不応症(46,XY)の20歳女性に対し、性腺悪性腫瘍のリスクから予防的に腹腔鏡下性腺摘出を行った症例報告です。左性腺に8mmの潜在性セミノーマが見つかりました。術後の腫瘍マーカーは正常で、転移は認められませんでした。摘出時は回収バッグの使用を推奨しています。
pmid-9050501.summary_en: A 20-year-old woman with complete androgen resistance (46,XY) underwent prophylactic laparoscopic gonadectomy because of the increased risk of gonadal malignancy. Pathology revealed an occult 8-mm seminoma in the left gonad, along with Sertoli cell hamartomas and Müllerian remnants. Postoperative tumor markers were normal, and CT and chest radiographs showed no metastatic disease. The authors recommend using retrieval bags during removal to avoid dissemination of potentially malignant cells from occult tumors.

pmid-9050536.summary_ja: 良性卵巣類皮嚢腫に対する新しい腹腔鏡下吸引法を紹介した報告です。切開を延長せず、ダグラス窩を開放せずに虚脱した嚢壁を除去できます。10例で良好な結果が得られ、嚢内容物の腹腔内への漏出はほとんどないか皆無でした。
pmid-9050536.summary_en: This brief report describes a new laparoscopic aspiration technique for benign ovarian dermoid cysts. The method allows removal of the collapsed cyst wall without extending laparoscopic incisions or opening the pouch of Douglas. One author used the technique in 10 patients with good effect and minimal or no spillage of cyst contents into the peritoneal cavity. It is presented as a practical approach for dermoid management that avoids enlarged incisions.

pmid-9073691.summary_ja: 急性骨盤痛と付属器腫瘤を有する妊娠中の2例に対し腹腔鏡手術を行った報告である。1例は大型の良性嚢胞性奇形腫、もう1例は傍卵管嚢胞に伴う卵管捻転であった。両例で嚢腫摘出術を行い、後者では卵管を温存した。適切な手技と悪性腫瘍の除外を前提に、妊娠中期における付属器腫瘤の腹腔鏡下摘出は実施可能と考察されている。
pmid-9073691.summary_en: This report describes two pregnant women with adnexal masses and acute pelvic pain who underwent operative laparoscopy during pregnancy. One had a large benign cystic teratoma and the other had fallopian tube torsion secondary to a paratubal cyst. Cystectomy was performed in both, and the tube was conserved in the second case. The authors conclude that, with proper technique and careful exclusion of malignancy, laparoscopy can be a feasible option for removing adnexal masses during the second trimester of pregnancy.

pmid-9073707.summary_ja: 生殖年齢の女性37例を対象に、4〜8cmの良性嚢胞性奇形腫の腹腔内からの摘出法を2群で比較した前向き非ランダム化試験である。袋に入れて摘出した群は牽引法より摘出時間が有意に短く、内容物の漏出や創部合併症も少なかった。腹腔鏡手術は安全かつ有効で、袋を用いた摘出法が有利と結論づけている。
pmid-9073707.summary_en: This prospective non-randomized trial compared two methods of removing enucleated benign cystic teratomas (4 to 8 cm) laparoscopically in 37 reproductive-age women. Group A extracted cysts by traction through an extended incision, while group B placed cysts in a plastic bag for extraction through a trocar site. Bag extraction was markedly faster, with fewer spillage events and wound complications, and similar operating time and hospital stay. The authors conclude that laparoscopy is safe and effective and that bag extraction is preferable.

pmid-9073749.summary_ja: 1992〜1993年に良性卵巣類皮嚢腫49個に腹腔鏡手術を行った44例を検討した。術前診断の多くは内診と経膣超音波検査で正しく得られた。大半の症例で卵巣が温存され、閉経後女性では付属器切除が行われた。検査した20例中11例でCA 19-9の上昇がみられたが、重篤な合併症はなかった。良性類皮嚢腫に対する腹腔鏡治療は安全かつ有効と結論している。
pmid-9073749.summary_en: This study reviews 44 women who underwent laparoscopic surgery for 49 benign ovarian dermoid cysts in 1992 and 1993. The diagnosis was correct preoperatively in most cases by pelvic examination and vaginal ultrasound. Ovarian preservation was achieved in most patients, while postmenopausal women underwent adnexectomy. CA 19-9 was elevated in 11 of 20 patients tested. Complications were minor. The authors conclude that laparoscopic management of benign dermoid cysts is safe and effective.

pmid-9073771.summary_ja: 1991〜1993年にローマの9施設で、組織学的に良性嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された67例に手術的腹腔鏡手術を行った。92.5%は腹腔鏡下に完遂され、5例は開腹術へ移行した。大半は卵巣温存療法で、7例では卵巣摘出術が行われた。少なくとも3か月のフォローアップで再発例はなかった。類皮嚢腫に対し、手術的腹腔鏡手術は開腹術の有効な代替法と結論づけている。
pmid-9073771.summary_en: Sixty-seven patients with histologically confirmed benign cystic teratoma treated by operative laparoscopy at nine centers in Rome from 1991 to 1993 are reported. Laparoscopy was completed in 92.5% of cases, with five converted to laparotomy. Conservative surgery was performed in most patients, while ovariectomy was required in seven. No recurrences were observed in patients followed for at least 3 months. The authors conclude that operative laparoscopy is a valid alternative to laparotomy for dermoid cysts.

pmid-9205440.summary_ja: 18歳の妊婦が出生前スクリーニングで母体血清AFPの著明な上昇を指摘された。妊娠20.5週の病期分類目的の開腹術で、卵黄嚢腫瘍とGrade 3の未熟奇形腫からなる卵巣の混合型胚細胞腫瘍と診断された。シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンの3コースを受け、第2コースまでにAFPは正常化した。健康な児が満期で出生した。著者らは、AFPの上昇が悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の徴候となりうると述べ、重大な胎児毒性はみられなかったとしている。
pmid-9205440.summary_en: An 18-year-old pregnant woman had markedly elevated maternal serum AFP detected during antenatal screening. Staging laparotomy at 20.5 weeks' gestation revealed a mixed germ cell tumor of the ovary, comprising endodermal sinus tumor and grade 3 immature teratoma. She received three courses of cisplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin, with AFP normalizing by the second course. A healthy infant was delivered at term. The authors suggest that elevated AFP may signal malignant ovarian germ cell neoplasms, and no major fetal toxicity was seen.

pmid-9205463.summary_ja: 化学療法後も残存または増大した卵巣腫瘤を有する20〜22歳の女性3例を報告する。治療前は全例が未熟奇形腫であった。腫瘍マーカーは終始正常で、切除された腫瘤には悪性成分のない成熟奇形腫が認められた。全例が診断後6〜31か月の時点で無病であった。化学療法後の増大は必ずしも悪性の進行を示さないが、閉塞などの合併症予防のため切除すべきと結論している。
pmid-9205463.summary_en: This report describes three women aged 20 to 22 years with persistent or growing masses after chemotherapy for ovarian germ cell malignancies, all of whom had immature teratomas before treatment. Tumor markers remained normal throughout, and resected masses contained mature teratoma without malignant elements. All patients were disease-free 6 to 31 months after diagnosis. The authors conclude that growth after chemotherapy does not necessarily indicate progression, especially with normal markers, but masses should be resected.

pmid-9419766.summary_ja: 正常胎盤の各妊娠週数、胞状奇胎、原発性絨毛癌、JEG-3絨毛癌細胞におけるBCL-2発現を比較した研究である。BCL-2は正常胎盤の合胞体栄養膜細胞で最も強く、絨毛癌では弱かった。JEG-3細胞をcAMPで処理するとBCL-2は約2倍に上昇し、p53とは逆相関を示した。絨毛癌でのBCL-2発現の低さがアポトーシスへの感受性を高める可能性が考察されている。
pmid-9419766.summary_en: This study examines BCL-2 expression during trophoblast differentiation, comparing normal placenta at various gestational ages with hydatidiform moles, primary choriocarcinoma, and JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cells. BCL-2 was most prominent in the syncytiotrophoblast of normal placenta and was weak in choriocarcinoma. Cyclic AMP treatment of JEG-3 cells raised BCL-2 about twofold, and an inverse relation with p53 was observed. The authors propose that low BCL-2 in choriocarcinoma may make these cells more susceptible to apoptosis.

pmid-7514999.summary_ja: NUCC-3絨毛癌細胞株を胎盤モデルとして用い、フォリスタチンがGnRH刺激によるヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の分泌とサブユニットmRNA発現を抑制することを示した。作用は転写速度の低下によるもので、mRNAの安定性には影響しなかった。プロテインキナーゼC経路が関与し、妊娠中の胎盤でのhCG産生調節に重要な役割を果たす可能性が示唆された。
pmid-7514999.summary_en: This study used the NUCC-3 choriocarcinoma cell line as an in vitro placental model to examine how follistatin regulates GnRH-stimulated hCG secretion and hCG subunit mRNA. Follistatin suppressed GnRH-induced hCG secretion and mRNA levels, largely by reducing transcription via the protein kinase C pathway rather than altering mRNA stability. The findings suggest follistatin may modulate placental hCG production during pregnancy.

pmid-7517121.summary_ja: 多能性ヒト奇形癌細胞株Tera 2が分泌するインスリン様成長因子を解析した。培養上清には標準型7kD IGF-IIと、生化学的に異なる大型IGF-II変異体が含まれ、いずれも細胞増殖を促進した。IGF結合蛋白質1型の共分泌がIGF-IIの作用を抑制し、自己分泌性増殖は観察されなかった。
pmid-7517121.summary_en: This study characterized insulin-like growth factors secreted by the pluripotent human teratocarcinoma cell line Tera 2. Conditioned medium contained canonical 7 kD IGF II and a biochemically distinct large IGF II variant, both of which supported cell proliferation. Despite potential autocrine growth, co-secretion of IGF binding protein-1 appeared to inhibit IGF II effects, so autocrine growth was not observed.

pmid-7527246.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のJEG-3細胞を用い、hCGのα鎖(αCG)遺伝子の発現誘導を検討した。cAMPにより約10倍、酪酸ナトリウムとの併用では約25倍の発現上昇が認められた。栄養膜由来と非栄養膜由来の細胞株における誘導パターンは、従来考えられていたほど明確に異ならないと結論された。
pmid-7527246.summary_en: This study examines induction of the chorionic gonadotropin alpha-subunit (alpha CG) gene in JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cells compared with HeLa cervical carcinoma cells. cAMP raised alpha CG mRNA about 10-fold, and adding sodium butyrate or TPA increased this to roughly 25-fold. Butyrate combined with cycloheximide also induced expression, and gel shift assays showed altered transcription factor binding. The authors conclude that induction patterns by butyrate and cAMP are less distinct between trophoblast and nontrophoblast lines than previously thought.

pmid-7772748.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞をモデルに、レチノイン酸(RA)とcAMPによる内胚葉分化を解析した。RA+cAMPでは壁側卵黄嚢様細胞が生じ、RA単独では原始内胚葉を経て分化した。2つの異なる分化経路が提案されている。胚発生における内胚葉形成の研究に位置づけられる。
pmid-7772748.summary_en: F9 embryonal carcinoma cells served as a model for endoderm formation during mammalian embryogenesis. Retinoic acid (RA) alone or RA plus cAMP was used to induce differentiation. SSEA-3, a marker of primitive and visceral endoderm, was assessed. RA plus cAMP produced SSEA-3-negative cells with parietal yolk sac endoderm ultrastructure. RA alone produced SSEA-3-positive primitive endoderm that later became parietal endoderm. The authors propose two distinct differentiation pathways toward parietal yolk sac-like cells.

pmid-7803624.summary_ja: ヒト栄養膜細胞と絨毛癌由来のBeWo細胞におけるVEGF受容体flt-1の発現と活性化を検討した。妊娠初期および満期の胎盤では、細胞性栄養膜細胞と絨毛外栄養膜細胞に強いflt mRNA発現が認められた。VEGF165はBeWo細胞のDNA合成とMAPキナーゼのリン酸化を用量・時間依存的に促進した。内皮細胞以外でのfltの存在を初めて示し、着床期の栄養膜細胞増殖へのVEGFの関与を示唆している。
pmid-7803624.summary_en: This study examined vascular endothelial growth factor receptor flt-1 in human trophoblast and in BeWo choriocarcinoma cells. In situ hybridization showed high flt mRNA in cytotrophoblast and extravillous trophoblast in first-trimester and term placentas. BeWo cells expressed flt and KDR, and VEGF165 stimulated thymidine incorporation and MAP kinase phosphorylation in a dose- and time-dependent manner. The authors report the first demonstration of flt on non-endothelial cells in vivo and propose a role for VEGF in trophoblast growth at implantation.

pmid-7811394.summary_ja: 胎盤由来の栄養膜細胞と絨毛癌細胞株JEG-3およびJARにおけるグルコース取り込みの速度論を比較した。取り込みは速く飽和性を示し、絨毛癌細胞は栄養膜細胞の約2倍のグルコースを取り込んだ。ミカエリス・メンテン式よりヒル係数を加えた式でよく説明された。主題は胎盤のグルコース輸送であり、絨毛癌株は比較モデルとして用いられている。
pmid-7811394.summary_en: Transport kinetics of 3-O-methylglucose were measured in trophoblast cells isolated from term placentas and in JEG-3 and JAR choriocarcinoma cell lines. Uptake was rapid and saturable, and choriocarcinoma cells took up about twice as much glucose as primary trophoblasts. Non-Michaelis-Menten kinetics were better described by a Hill-type equation with a Hill coefficient near 1.1 to 1.4, indicating cooperative or allosteric behavior. The study mainly addresses placental glucose transport, with choriocarcinoma lines serving as comparative models.

pmid-7889109.summary_ja: BeWo絨毛癌細胞において、シグナル伝達経路がhCG分泌をどう制御するかを解析した研究である。PMAとコレラ毒素はそれぞれ用量依存的にhCG分泌を増加させ、併用で相乗効果を示した。二次元電気泳動でPKAおよびPKC基質の候補タンパクのリン酸化変化も同定された。腫瘍マーカーhCGを指標とするが、腫瘍臨床を扱うものではなく境界的である。
pmid-7889109.summary_en: This study investigates how signal transduction pathways regulate human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) secretion in BeWo human choriocarcinoma cells. Phorbol ester (PMA) and cholera toxin each increase hCG secretion dose-dependently, and together they act synergistically. Calcium ionophore A23187 has little effect. Two-dimensional gel analysis identifies phosphorylation changes in candidate protein kinase A and protein kinase C substrates. Cell proliferation is unaffected. The choriocarcinoma line serves as the experimental system, while hCG, a germ cell tumor marker, is the measured output, making the paper borderline relevant.

pmid-7937597.summary_ja: 子宮内膜器官培養系を用い、絨毛癌細胞株3種（BeWo、Jeg-3、JAr）のスフェロイドの接着と浸潤能を比較した。Jeg-3は接着率52%で間質への浸潤が最も強く、BeWoは上皮を貫通したが間質浸潤はなかった。JArは接着が少なかった。絨毛癌細胞株は栄養膜モデルとして用いられており、妊娠性疾患患者は対象ではない。
pmid-7937597.summary_en: This study developed a three-dimensional organ culture model using pre-cultured human endometrium to compare attachment and invasion by spheroids of three choriocarcinoma cell lines (BeWo, Jeg-3, JAr). All lines invaded in a general chick heart fragment assay, with JAr the most aggressive. In the endometrial model, Jeg-3 showed the highest attachment (52%) and stromal invasion, BeWo attached (37%) and penetrated the epithelium without stromal invasion, and JAr showed minimal attachment (12%). The choriocarcinoma lines serve as trophoblast models, and patients with gestational disease were not studied.

pmid-7960243.summary_ja: ヒト奇形癌由来細胞NCCITとマウス奇形癌由来細胞株の糖脂質抗原を比較した基礎研究です。ヒト細胞は伸長したグロボ系糖脂質を発現し、マウス細胞株の間でも違いが見られました。発生段階の異なる胚性外胚葉を反映する可能性が示唆されています。臨床的な腫瘍の解析ではありません。
pmid-7960243.summary_en: This study compared globo-series glycolipid antigens in the human teratocarcinoma-derived cell line NCCIT and five murine teratocarcinoma-derived cell lines. Human NCCIT embryonal carcinoma cells expressed extended globo-series glycolipids recognized by SSEA-3 and SSEA-4 antibodies, while murine lines differed in SSEA-4 and Forssman antigen expression. The findings suggest that murine EC cells mirror different developmental stages of the embryonic ectoderm. Glycolipid patterns in normal mouse embryos were also examined. The work is largely developmental and glycobiological rather than clinical.

pmid-7984043.summary_ja: ヒト奇形癌由来のNTERA2細胞株と、レチノイン酸で誘導したニューロン集団・非ニューロン集団からcDNAライブラリーを作製した研究。ニューロンではPおよびE-カドヘリンの転写産物が減少し、プリオンタンパク質は増加していた。プリオン感染の研究系としての有用性が示唆された。腫瘍の臨床的解析ではなく、細胞分化の研究である。
pmid-7984043.summary_en: This study built cDNA libraries from the human teratocarcinoma-derived NTERA2 line and two retinoic acid-induced derivatives: a neuronal population and a non-neuronal population. Expression analysis showed that P- and E-cadherin transcripts were down-regulated while prion protein transcripts were up-regulated in neurons. The authors propose these cells as a system for studying human prion infection and as a source of neuron-specific genes. The focus is neural and non-neural differentiation of a stem-like cell line rather than the clinical behavior of germ cell tumors.

pmid-8002011.summary_ja: マウス胚性癌細胞株PCC4を45℃で30分間熱ショックすると、細胞が大型化して分化し、段階特異的胚抗原の発現が変化しました。熱ショック後30分以内に細胞内pHの変化も検出されています。熱ショックタンパク質の誘導動態も検討されています。本研究は腫瘍や患者ではなく細胞生物学が中心のため、GCTへの関連性は判断が難しいと考えます。
pmid-8002011.summary_en: This study examines heat-shock-induced differentiation of the mouse embryonal carcinoma line PCC4. Exposure to 45 degrees C for 30 minutes triggered morphological differentiation, with cells becoming large and well spread with lower nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios. Differentiation coincided with loss of stage-specific embryonic antigen 1 and gain of antigen 3. Intracellular pH changes were detected within 30 minutes of heat shock using a fluorescent probe. The authors also characterized the kinetics of heat shock protein induction. Because the work uses an embryonal carcinoma line for cell biology rather than studying tumors or patients, its relevance to germ cell tumor care is uncertain.

pmid-8005555.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株BeWoとJarを用い、17β-ヒドロキシステロイド脱水素酵素（17β-HSD）の発現と活性を比較した研究。両株で1.3kbと2.2kbのmRNAを検出し、主要な種類は株により異なった。BeWoは酵素活性とタンパク質が豊富であった。一方Jarは2.2kb mRNAが主体であるにもかかわらず、活性やタンパク質はほぼ検出されなかった。翻訳阻害の可能性が示唆されている。
pmid-8005555.summary_en: This study uses two human choriocarcinoma cell lines, BeWo and Jar, as a model system to investigate 17 beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase (17β-HSD). Northern blotting identified 1.3 and 2.2 kb mRNA species, with the predominant transcript differing between the lines. BeWo cells showed abundant protein and significant enzyme activity. Jar cells had very low activity and undetectable immunoreactivity despite high levels of the 2.2 kb mRNA. The authors suggest that multiple upstream AUGs and stop codons may impair translation of this transcript.

pmid-8070357.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のJEG-3細胞を用い、PPAR刺激薬やレチノイドによるhCG分泌と遺伝子発現の調節を検討した基礎研究である。クロフィブラートは細胞増殖を抑制しhCG分泌を低下させた。臨床研究ではなく、栄養シグナルへの応答を示す体外実験の報告である。
pmid-8070357.summary_en: This basic study uses JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cells to examine how peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor (PPAR) activators and retinoids regulate hCG secretion, CG subunit gene expression and cell growth. Clofibric acid suppressed growth and increased p53, and reduced CG secretion, while retinoic acids increased CG expression but this effect was blunted by clofibric acid. The findings suggest trophoblast-derived cells respond to nutrient-sensing pathways. It is an in vitro endocrine study rather than a clinical study of the disease.

pmid-8070393.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来JEG-3細胞におけるEGFのhCG分泌調節機構を検討した基礎研究である。EGFはhCGサブユニットmRNAを安定化させてhCG分泌を増加させ、hCG/LH受容体mRNAは転写抑制により減少させた。臨床研究ではなく、細胞株を用いた体外での分子機構の解析である。
pmid-8070393.summary_en: This basic study examines how epidermal growth factor (EGF) regulates hCG secretion in JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cells. EGF increased hCG secretion by stabilizing hCG alpha and beta mRNAs, a tyrosine kinase-dependent process, while reducing hCG/LH receptor mRNA through transcriptional inhibition. It also stabilized the receptor protein. The work is an in vitro molecular study using a choriocarcinoma cell line as a model, not a clinical study of the disease.

pmid-8080727.summary_ja: マウスの胎児-母体境界組織と正常ヒト胎盤、絨毛癌細胞株JARにおけるnm23発現を比較した。nm23はJARで正常胎盤より高く、絨毛癌細胞では抗転移機能を持たないことが示唆された。サイトカインはJARでは効果がなかった。本研究の主題は妊娠組織であり、絨毛癌は副次的な対象である。
pmid-8080727.summary_en: This study examined nm23 mRNA expression in mouse fetal-maternal interface tissues across gestation. It also compared normal human term placenta with the highly metastatic choriocarcinoma line JAR. nm23 was higher in JAR than in normal placenta, and cytokines and PGE2 modulated nm23 in the melanoma control B16F10 but not in JAR. The findings suggest nm23 lacks anti-metastatic function in choriocarcinoma cells. However, the main focus is on gestational tissues rather than choriocarcinoma.

pmid-8120003.summary_ja: ラット絨毛癌由来のRcho-1細胞を用い、トロホブラスト巨細胞への分化に伴うP450scc遺伝子の転写活性化を解析しました。分化に伴いプロゲステロン産生とP450scc発現が大きく上昇しました。主題は腫瘍そのものではなく正常トロホブラストのステロイド産生で、腫瘍由来細胞株は実験系として用いられています。
pmid-8120003.summary_en: This study examines transcriptional activation of P450scc, the cholesterol side-chain cleavage enzyme, during trophoblast giant cell differentiation. The authors use Rcho-1 cells, derived from a transplantable rat choriocarcinoma, as an in vitro differentiation model. Progesterone production and P450scc expression rose roughly 100-fold as cells differentiated, and an 894 bp 5' upstream promoter fragment reproduced endogenous expression in stable transfectants. The focus is normal trophoblast steroidogenesis, with the tumor-derived line serving as the experimental system.

pmid-8126073.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞株P19ECをニューロン、グリア細胞、線維芽細胞へ分化させる過程で、トロンボスポンジン1(TSP1)とTSP2の発現を検討した。両者は分化に伴い誘導され、TSP1は線維状に細胞外基質様の沈着を示し、TSP2は細胞に結合したまま存在した。沈着パターンの違いから、神経形成における異なる役割が示唆された。本細胞系は発生研究のモデルとして有用と結論されている。
pmid-8126073.summary_en: This study examined expression of thrombospondin 1 (TSP1) and TSP2 during in vitro differentiation of the murine embryonal carcinoma line P19EC into neurons, glia, and fibroblasts. Both TSPs were induced upon differentiation, with TSP1 forming fibrillar extracellular matrix deposits and TSP2 remaining cell-associated. Their distinct deposition patterns suggest different roles in neurogenesis. The authors propose P19EC cells as a valuable model for studying TSP function during neural development, rather than as a clinical germ cell tumor study.

pmid-8205724.summary_ja: マウス胚性幹細胞、胎児性癌細胞およびその分化誘導細胞におけるFGF受容体4種の遺伝子発現とスプライシングバリアントを検討した。FGF-R2とFGF-R3は両細胞の分化に伴い発現が増加した。スプライシングの様式も分化段階で異なり、胚性細胞型に特異的な受容体の発現が発生に応じて制御されることを示した。
pmid-8205724.summary_en: This study examines expression of the four fibroblast growth factor receptor genes and their splice variants in murine embryonic stem cells, embryonal carcinoma cells, and their differentiated derivatives. FGF-R2 and FGF-R3 increase upon differentiation of both cell types, and splicing patterns differ by differentiation state. The results show developmental regulation of receptor expression specific to embryonic cell types, rather than a focus on tumor biology.

pmid-11578342.summary_ja: 肺転移を伴う43歳女性の絨毛癌症例で、市販のhCG測定キットが高用量フック効果により偽低値を示し、診断が遅れた。不要な子宮摘出と肺生検が行われた経緯が報告されている。この分析上の問題の詳細と回避法が記述され、正確なhCG測定の重要性が強調されている。
pmid-11578342.summary_en: This case report describes a 43-year-old woman with extensive lung metastases from choriocarcinoma who underwent an unnecessary hysterectomy and lung biopsy. The diagnosis was delayed because a commercial hCG assay gave a falsely low result due to the high-dose hook effect. The authors describe this analytical phenomenon in detail and outline methods to avoid it. Accurate hCG measurement is essential for diagnosing and managing this potentially rapidly fatal but curable tumor.

pmid-11578366.summary_ja: 混合型を含む卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍41例を後方視的に検討した。全例が減量手術を受け、VACまたはPVBによる補助化学療法の有無は問わなかった。病期I・IIは5年・10年生存率が約80%と良好であったが、病期III・IVはほとんどが2年以内に死亡した。若年者には温存手術に続く化学療法が推奨されている。
pmid-11578366.summary_en: This retrospective review analyzed 41 patients with ovarian endodermal sinus tumor, including pure tumors and those combined with dysgerminoma or immature teratoma. All were treated with cytoreductive surgery, with or without adjuvant VAC or PVB chemotherapy. Outcomes were favorable in stage I or II disease, with 5- and 10-year survival around 80%, whereas most stage III or IV patients died within two years. Aggressive surgery did not improve stage I outcomes, and postoperative chemotherapy was essential. Conservative surgery followed by chemotherapy is recommended for young patients.

pmid-12797305.summary_ja: 手術で確認された嚢胞性奇形腫39例の経腟超音波像を後方視的に検討した。純粋な嚢胞性から高エコー性まで6種類のエコーパターンが認められた。82%の腫瘍で高度の高エコー域がみられた。術前予測に有用な場合がある一方、悪性腫瘍との鑑別は困難とされている。
pmid-12797305.summary_en: This study retrospectively reviewed transvaginal ultrasound findings in 39 surgically confirmed cystic teratomas. Six distinct echo patterns were identified, ranging from purely cystic to densely echogenic. Dense echogenic areas were present in 82% of tumors. Although the sonographic appearance may allow accurate preoperative prediction, the variable patterns make it difficult to distinguish cystic teratomas from malignant tumors.

pmid-21573475.summary_ja: 1953〜1992年にノルウェーで報告された妊娠性絨毛癌115例を後方視的に検討した。発生率に時間的傾向はみられなかったが、病期分布と生存率は後期に改善した。5年生存率は57.9%から94.8%へ上昇した。病期が進むほど生存率は低下し、多変量解析で病期は有意な予後因子であった。
pmid-21573475.summary_en: This population-based retrospective study of 115 Norwegian patients with gestational choriocarcinoma spanned 1953 to 1992. Incidence showed no temporal trend, but stage distribution and survival improved in the later period. Five-year survival rose from 57.9% to 94.8% between the two periods. Survival declined with advancing FIGO stage, with 5-year rates of 93.5%, 80.0%, 64.1%, and 26.7% for stages I through IV. Stage was a significant prognostic factor on multivariate analysis, whereas age was not.

pmid-21573569.summary_ja: 本研究は、複数の胎児性癌(EC)細胞株に対し、レチノイン酸とcAMP上昇薬の分化誘導能を比較した。分化の程度はEndo A、コラーゲンIV、組織プラスミノゲン活性化因子などの段階特異的マーカーのmRNA量で評価された。cAMP上昇薬単独では完全な分化は得られなかった。細胞株ごとに反応は異なり、分化の程度はcAMP上昇薬の種類と評価したマーカーによって変化した。EC細胞の分化誘導剤への反応の不均一性が示された。
pmid-21573569.summary_en: This study compared retinoic acid (RA) and cAMP-elevating agents for inducing differentiation of several embryonal carcinoma (EC) cell lines. Differentiation was assessed by mRNA levels of stage-specific markers, including Endo A, collagen IV, and tissue plasminogen activator. cAMP-elevating agents alone could not achieve complete differentiation. The response differed among cell lines, and the degree of differentiation depended on both the type of cAMP-elevating agent and the marker examined. The results highlight heterogeneity in EC cell responses to differentiation-inducing agents.

pmid-27519747.summary_ja: JAR絨毛癌多細胞スフェロイドのヒト子宮内膜上皮細胞単層への接着を定量するin vitroモデルを構築した。JAR細胞はヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)とプロゲステロンを分泌していた。遠心力による接着アッセイで、RL95-2への接着が最も強く、AN3-CAには接着しなかった。RL95-2では上皮細胞間への浸潤が24時間後も続いた。絨毛癌細胞の接着特性は子宮内膜細胞株ごとに異なり、着床の分子機構解析の基盤となる。
pmid-27519747.summary_en: This study established an in vitro model to quantify attachment of JAR human choriocarcinoma multicellular spheroids to human endometrial epithelial cell monolayers. JAR spheroids secreted hCG and progesterone. Attachment, measured with a centrifugal adhesion assay, was greatest for RL95-2 cells and intermediate for HEC-1A and KLE cells, and JAR spheroids did not attach to AN3-CA cells. At 5 hours, choriocarcinoma cells began to intrude between RL95-2 epithelial cells, and this penetration persisted at 24 hours only with RL95-2. The model reveals differences in adhesive properties among endometrial lines and may help study molecular interactions in implantation.

pmid-32138449.summary_ja: 31歳無症状女性の卵巣未熟奇形腫の症例報告で、改変Thurlbeck-Scully法によりgrade 2と判定された。腫瘍内の成熟神経組織の中に、中心動脈を伴う腺下垂体組織が認められた。免疫細胞化学では成長ホルモン、プロラクチン、ACTH、hCGのαサブユニットが陽性、TSH、FSH、LHは陰性だった。周囲組織では視床下部由来ペプチド等が陰性で、腺下垂体の発生はこれらのペプチドに依存しないと考察された。
pmid-32138449.summary_en: This case report describes a 31-year-old asymptomatic woman with an ovarian immature teratoma, graded as grade 2 by the modified Thurlbeck-Scully system. The tumor contained adenohypophyseal tissue with a central arteriole, situated within mature neural tissue. Immunocytochemistry showed positive staining for growth hormone, prolactin, adrenocorticotropin, and alpha-subunit hCG, but not for TSH, FSH, or LH. Adjacent tissue lacked staining for several hypothalamic and posterior pituitary peptides, which the authors interpret as evidence that adenohypophyseal development is independent of these peptides.

pmid-37281439.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌(EC)細胞と胚性幹細胞の無血清培地での増殖要件を検討した。PCC3細胞はアクチビンAが無いと3日以内に崩壊し、増殖・生存に必要だった。P19、AT805、F9細胞は無血清でも増殖し、アクチビンAの影響は細胞株により異なった。白血病抑制因子を加えるとES細胞株とPSA-1細胞も増殖した。PCC3細胞はEC/ES細胞の増殖制御研究に有用な栄養要求変異体と考えられた。
pmid-37281439.summary_en: This study examined growth requirements of murine embryonal carcinoma (EC) and embryonic stem cells in serum-free medium. PCC3 EC cells required activin A to grow or survive; without it, they disintegrated within 3 days. P19 and AT805 cells grew without activin A, with slight facilitation by its addition, while F9 growth was somewhat inhibited by activin A. ES cell lines and PSA-1 EC cells grew in serum-free medium when leukemia inhibitory factor was added. The authors propose PCC3 cells as a nutritional mutant useful for studying growth regulation of EC and ES cells.

pmid-37282221.summary_ja: マウス初期胚と胎児性癌細胞株F9におけるアクチビン受容体II型(ActR-II)遺伝子発現を解析した。ActR-IIは成熟卵子で発現し、2細胞期に低下後、外胚葉と内胚葉が形成される胚6日目で強く活性化された。F9細胞では、レチノイン酸が内胚葉分化の過程でActR-II mRNAを誘導し、その作用はタンパク質合成を必要とせず直接的だった。全トランス型レチノイン酸が9-シス型より有効だった。cAMPアナログは追加的な誘導を示さなかった。
pmid-37282221.summary_en: This study examined expression of the activin receptor type II (ActR-II) gene in pre- and post-implantation mouse embryos and in F9 embryonal carcinoma cells, used as a model of embryonic development. ActR-II was expressed in mature oocytes, decreased at the two-cell stage, and was strongly activated by day 6, when ectoderm and endoderm form. Retinoic acid induced ActR-II mRNA during endodermal differentiation of F9 cells, directly and without new protein synthesis, with all-trans RA more effective than 9-cis RA. A cyclic AMP analogue did not further enhance expression. The authors conclude that activin signaling in mammalian development may be mediated by increased receptor expression.

pmid-7504459.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のBeWo細胞は2種類のアルカリホスファターゼを発現する。本研究は酪酸とcAMPによる胚細胞型アルカリホスファターゼの誘導を、熱安定性の違いを利用して解析した。酪酸は96時間後に約35倍の活性誘導を示し、mRNAも増加させた。cAMP類は小さな誘導にとどまるが、併用で相乗効果が見られた。cAMPは酪酸とは異なる機序でmRNAレベルで制御すると考えられた。
pmid-7504459.summary_en: BeWo choriocarcinoma cells express two alkaline phosphatase isoenzymes. This study examined how sodium butyrate and cyclic AMP induce germ-cell alkaline phosphatase activity, using heat stability to distinguish isoenzymes. Butyrate induced activity about 35-fold after 96 hours and increased germ-cell alkaline phosphatase mRNA. Dibutyryl cAMP and other cAMP-elevating agents induced smaller increases, and combining butyrate with cAMP produced synergistic induction. The findings suggest that cAMP regulates this isoenzyme at the mRNA level through a mechanism distinct from butyrate.

pmid-7504978.summary_ja: 進行期の非セミノーマ性精巣がん33例を対象に、予後因子を診療録から後ろ向きに検討しました。3年全生存率は76%で、症状期間の長さ、初回治療不応、後腹膜の巨大病変、肺病変の大きさ、マーカーの持続高値が予後不良因子でした。
pmid-7504978.summary_en: This chart review of 33 patients with advanced nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy assessed prognostic factors. The 3-year overall survival was 76%. Symptom duration over 16 weeks, poor initial response, bulky retroperitoneal disease, larger lung involvement, and persistently elevated beta-hCG or AFP after the second chemotherapy course all predicted poor outcome. Initial complete responders had a 93% survival rate. The authors conclude that these clinical and marker-based indicators identify patients with a poor prognosis.

pmid-7505421.summary_ja: 胚細胞成分(卵黄嚢腫瘍と絨毛癌)を伴う直腸腺癌の症例報告で、文献上初めての報告とされています。AFPとhCGが著明に上昇し、肝転移に化学療法が行われましたが、治療開始1週間後に致死的な肝出血を来しました。
pmid-7505421.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with rectal adenocarcinoma containing germ cell elements, specifically endodermal sinus tumor and choriocarcinoma, believed to be the first such case in the literature. Serum alpha-fetoprotein and human chorionic gonadotropin were markedly elevated, and immunoperoxidase staining localized the markers to the neoplastic tissue. Extensive hepatic metastases developed and were treated with chemotherapy. One week after treatment began, a massive fatal hepatic hemorrhage occurred.

pmid-7505557.summary_ja: 生後4か月の男児に発生した胃奇形腫の症例報告です。出生時から腫瘤があり、急速な増大を機に受診しました。腫瘍は完全切除され、退院後も良好に経過していると推定されています。画像診断の進歩により、症状出現前の早期手術が可能になると述べられています。
pmid-7505557.summary_en: This case report describes a 4-month-old boy with gastric teratoma, a very rare and usually benign tumor of childhood. A mass was noted at birth, but the infant remained asymptomatic until rapid growth prompted hospital presentation. The tumor was successfully excised and the child remained well after discharge. The authors note that in industrialized countries, prenatal or early postnatal imaging facilitates diagnosis and earlier surgery before symptoms appear. The report underscores the value of early surgical management.

pmid-7505886.summary_ja: 1982～1992年に精巣胚細胞腫瘍250例へPVB療法を行った10年間の経験報告です。病期II、IV、IIIなど病期別に成績が検討されました。完全奏効率は69～93%で、再発は各群で数例にとどまりました。薬剤関連死は4%でした。
pmid-7505886.summary_en: This report summarizes a 10-year experience with PVB (cisplatin, vinblastine, bleomycin) chemotherapy in 250 patients with germ cell testicular tumors treated from 1982 to 1992. Outcomes were stratified by clinical stage, including stage II patients receiving primary retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy and advanced stage III and IV patients receiving chemotherapy with surgical resection of residual metastases. Complete response rates ranged from 69 to 93 percent depending on stage, with relapses in a small number of patients per group. Drug-related deaths occurred in 4 percent of patients.

pmid-7506242.summary_ja: 1981～1989年に播種性精巣がんの病期IV 59例にPVB療法を行った報告です。完全寛解は58%、全奏効率は78%でした。セミノーマで最も良好な反応が得られ、5年生存率は全体で53%でした。予後不良群にはより強力な化学療法が必要と結論されています。
pmid-7506242.summary_en: This study reports outcomes of 59 patients with stage IV disseminated testicular cancer treated with at least five courses of cisplatin, vinblastine and bleomycin (PVB) from 1981 to 1989. Histology included seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, teratocarcinoma and mixed tumors. Complete remission was achieved in 58 percent and the overall response rate was 78 percent. Seminoma patients had the best response. The 5-year survival was 53 percent overall, 88 percent for complete responders and 10 percent for partial responders. The authors conclude that poor-risk patients need more aggressive regimens.

pmid-7506484.summary_ja: Schinzel-Giedion症候群の男児に悪性の仙尾部奇形腫が生じた症例報告です。同症候群での悪性腫瘍は、肝芽腫に続き2例目とされます。まれな胎児性腫瘍が2種類みられたことから、悪性腫瘍のリスクが本症候群の特徴の一つである可能性が提起されています。
pmid-7506484.summary_en: This report describes a boy with Schinzel-Giedion syndrome who developed a malignant sacrococcygeal teratoma, a previously unreported association. The authors note this is only the second reported malignancy in this syndrome, after a hepatoblastoma in an earlier case. Because two uncommon embryonal tumors have now occurred in patients with this rare syndrome, the authors propose that malignancy risk may be an intrinsic component of Schinzel-Giedion syndrome. The report is brief and focuses on the clinical and genetic association.

pmid-7506867.summary_ja: 23か月の乳児に発生した転移性精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例である。6か月後に血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)が再上昇し、単発性の肺転移が出現した。シスプラチンなどを含むCOMPE療法4コースで、AFPは正常化し肺転移も消失した。5年間無病で身体発育も正常であり、Stage III の乳児精巣がんにはシスプラチンを含む積極的な化学療法が有用と考えられると報告している。
pmid-7506867.summary_en: This report describes a 23-month-old boy with metastatic infantile yolk sac tumor of the testis. Serum AFP rose six months after orchiectomy and a solitary lung metastasis developed. After four courses of chemotherapy with cisplatin, vincristine, methotrexate, peplomycin and etoposide (COMPE), AFP normalized and the lung metastasis disappeared. He has remained disease-free for five years with normal growth, suggesting aggressive cisplatin-containing chemotherapy may be useful in stage III infantile testicular cancer.

pmid-7507475.summary_ja: ラット卵黄嚢腫瘍から、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)を産生する細胞株NMT-1を樹立し、その性状を解析した。細胞は単層で増殖し、倍加時間は約16時間であった。移植ではすべてのラットに腫瘍が生着し、リンパ行性転移を認めた。組織像と生物学的性状は原腫瘍を再現しており、転移研究のモデルとしての有用性が示された。
pmid-7507475.summary_en: The authors established NMT-1, a rat yolk sac tumor cell line producing alpha-fetoprotein, from a tumor in Wistar rats. The cells grew as an epithelioid monolayer with a doubling time of about 16 hours, and showed defined radiation sensitivity and cell-cycle distribution. Inoculation produced tumors in all rats with lymphatic metastases to several nodal basins and to liver, lung and kidney. The tumor reproduced the histology and behavior of the original, providing a model for studying metastasis.

pmid-7507767.summary_ja: 初回化学療法および救援化学療法に抵抗性の原発性縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の症例である。外科的切除と、タンデムの自家骨髄移植を行った後、初めて完全寛解に至った。初回移植から19か月後も無病状態を維持している。難治性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍で長期無病生存が得られた報告は少ないと述べている。
pmid-7507767.summary_en: This report describes a patient with primary mediastinal non-seminomatous germ cell tumor refractory to initial and salvage chemotherapy. After surgical resection and tandem autologous bone marrow transplantation, he achieved a first complete remission. Nineteen months after the first transplant he remained without evidence of disease. The authors note that long-term disease-free survival with currently available salvage regimens has not been reported in refractory mediastinal germ cell tumors, making this case notable.

pmid-7508500.summary_ja: 1972年から1990年に治療された良性新生児仙尾部奇形腫36例を検討した。6例(22%)に再発を認め、うち3例は良性再発、3例は悪性再発であった。悪性再発は当初成熟良性と報告された腫瘍で、血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)が著明に高値であった。全例で完全切除を含む集学的治療が行われた。組織学的に良性でも生後2年の間に再発しうるため、3年以上の厳重なフォローアップを推奨している。
pmid-7508500.summary_en: This series reviews 36 patients with benign neonatal sacrococcygeal teratoma treated between 1972 and 1990. Six patients (22%) had recurrence: three benign local recurrences and three malignant recurrences, the latter originally reported as mature benign tumors with markedly elevated serum AFP. All recurrences were treated with multimodal therapy including complete excision. The authors conclude the tumor, though histologically benign, can recur during the first two years of life and recommend at least three years of close follow-up.

pmid-7508501.summary_ja: 1970年から1992年に1施設で経験した小児縦隔奇形腫15例を検討した。新生児6例を含み、多くは呼吸窮迫で発症し、術前の確定診断は得られなかった。組織学的には成熟2例、未熟成分を含むもの10例、悪性3例であった。新生児例はいずれも未熟奇形腫で、前縦隔腫瘍には正中胸骨切開が良好な視野を与えた。縦隔奇形腫は稀で術前診断が困難であると結論している。
pmid-7508501.summary_en: This review analyzes 15 children with mediastinal teratoma seen at one hospital between 1970 and 1992, including six newborns. Most presented with respiratory distress and none had a definite preoperative diagnosis. Histologically, two were mature, ten had immature elements and three were malignant; the malignant tumors occurred in patients over 12 years and all died within six months. All neonatal tumors were immature. Median sternotomy gave excellent exposure of anterior mediastinal tumors.

pmid-7508531.summary_ja: 18歳男性の精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍(胎児性癌・奇形腫・卵黄嚢腫瘍)の症例である。化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節切除で成熟奇形腫を認め、その後6か月で後腹膜腫瘤が出現した。後腹膜リンパ節郭清により、腸型腺癌への悪性転化を伴う奇形腫と診断された。補助化学療法としてEAP療法を施行し、21か月無再発で生存している。
pmid-7508531.summary_en: This case report describes an 18-year-old man with a mixed germ cell tumor of the testis (embryonal carcinoma, teratoma and yolk sac tumor). A retroperitoneal lymph node resected after chemotherapy showed mature teratoma. Six months after further chemotherapy a retroperitoneal mass appeared, and dissection revealed teratoma with malignant transformation to enteric adenocarcinoma. Adjuvant EAP chemotherapy was given and the patient remained alive without recurrence for 21 months. Flow cytometry showed aneuploidy in all tumor components.

pmid-7509106.summary_ja: 未分化型セミノーマ11例と典型的セミノーマ15例を比較した。核分裂像の数と割合は強く相関し、PCNA標識率とも相関した。サイトケラチン、ビメンチン、PLAP、β-hCG、AFP、c-mycの免疫染色パターンは両群で有意差がなく、未分化型は増殖活性の高いセミノーマである可能性が示唆された。
pmid-7509106.summary_en: This study compared 11 anaplastic seminomas with 15 typical seminomas. Mitotic count and mitotic rate correlated strongly, and both correlated with the PCNA labeling index. Immunostaining for cytokeratin, vimentin, PLAP, beta-hCG, AFP, and c-myc did not differ significantly between the two groups. No immunohistochemical or clinicopathologic parameter reliably distinguished anaplastic from typical seminoma, suggesting that anaplastic seminoma may simply be seminoma with high proliferative activity.

pmid-7510076.summary_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍7例の印象標本による組織学的・細胞学的所見を解析した。組織像は4型に分類され、内胚葉洞型が最も多かった。細胞像では立方状細胞が最も多く、次いで紡錘形細胞が認められた。紡錘形細胞の由来についても考察され、凍結標本の印象細胞診は術中迅速診断に有用とされた。
pmid-7510076.summary_en: Imprint histology and cytology were analyzed in seven patients with yolk sac tumor. Histologic patterns were classified into four types, with the endodermal sinus pattern most common, followed by the polyvesicular vitelline pattern. Cytology showed four patterns, with cuboidal cells most frequent and spindle-shaped cells next. The authors proposed possible origins for these cell types. They concluded that imprint cytology of rapidly frozen specimens is sufficient for intraoperative rapid diagnosis.

pmid-7512366.summary_ja: 男性胚細胞腫瘍202例のうち、i(12p)陰性の26例の核型を解析した。12p13の再構成は陰性例の35%に認められ、陽性例では3%であった。両群とも12p由来コピー数の増加がみられ、胚細胞腫瘍の発生に重要な異常と考えられた。
pmid-7512366.summary_en: Karyotypes of 26 i(12p)-negative male germ cell tumors, selected from 202 cases, were analyzed. Nonrandom rearrangements most often involved 12p13, seen in 35% of i(12p)-negative tumors versus 3% of i(12p)-positive tumors. Chromosome 12 painting revealed extra 12p segments in marker chromosomes. Both groups showed increased 12p copy number without clinical or biological differences, suggesting that increased 12p copy number is a specific and important aberration in germ cell tumor development.

pmid-7515845.summary_ja: 上顎に原発した性腺外卵黄嚢腫瘍の小児症例を報告した。ブレオマイシン、シスプラチン、エトポシドによる併用化学療法で完全寛解が得られ、3年後も無病で経過している。頭頸部の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍でも、標準的な化学療法が有効であることを示す症例である。
pmid-7515845.summary_en: A child with primary extragonadal yolk sac tumor of the maxilla was reported. The patient received combination chemotherapy with bleomycin, cisplatin, and etoposide and achieved complete remission. The patient has remained disease free for three years. The case shows that extragonadal germ cell tumors can arise in the head and neck region and respond to standard germ cell tumor chemotherapy.

pmid-7516075.summary_ja: 27歳男性が喀血と肺陰影の急速な増大で受診した。原発の精巣がんは自然退縮していたが、hCG産生性の精巣がんの肺転移と判明した。治療前に呼吸不全となり、治療開始48時間後に死亡した。尿妊娠検査が早期診断に有用であることが強調されている。
pmid-7516075.summary_en: A 27-year-old man presented with haemoptysis and lung shadowing that enlarged dramatically over three weeks. He was found to have pulmonary metastases from chorionic gonadotropin-producing testicular cancer whose primary tumor had regressed spontaneously. He developed respiratory failure before treatment and died 48 hours after treatment began. The authors emphasize that the urinary pregnancy test can accelerate diagnosis and treatment in such cases.

pmid-7677934.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の連続臨床試験538例を見直した。従来量のエトポシド併用化学療法を受けた患者のうち2例(0.37%)に二次性白血病が生じた。発生率は低く、治療の利益は危険性を上回るが、慎重なフォローアップが必要とされる。
pmid-7677934.summary_en: This review of serial germ cell tumor trials included 538 patients who received conventional-dose etoposide (cumulative 1500 to 2000 mg/m2) with cisplatin plus ifosfamide or bleomycin. Two patients (0.37%) developed secondary leukemia, and additional hematologic abnormalities were noted in patients treated outside trials. The authors conclude that the risk is low and does not change the risk-benefit ratio of etoposide-based chemotherapy, but careful follow-up is needed.

pmid-7678716.summary_ja: 51種類のモノクローナル抗体を用い、正常卵巣18例と卵巣腫瘍138例のマーカー発現を比較した研究です。TAG-72は胚細胞腫瘍を性索腫瘍や漿液性腫瘍から区別するのに有用でした。卵巣癌関連抗原は、卵黄嚢腫瘍を除く胚細胞腫瘍ではほとんど発現していませんでした。
pmid-7678716.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study compared 51 monoclonal antibody markers across 18 normal ovarian samples and 138 ovarian tumors, including germ cell tumors. Vimentin and simple keratins were common, while TAG-72 distinguished germ cell tumors and carcinomas from gonadal and serous tumors. Ovarian carcinoma-associated antigens were largely absent from germ cell tumors except endodermal sinus tumors. HLA-I was broadly expressed, and HLA-DR was heterogeneous in epithelial tumors. These markers help differentiate ovarian tumor types diagnostically.

pmid-7678749.summary_ja: 本監査では、転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療後に再発した29例（セミノーマ7例、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍22例）を解析した。血清のhCGとAFPの測定が最も重要なフォローアップ手段で、患者の55%で再発の最初の指標となった。胸部X線はほとんど有用でなく、CTは24%で最初の異常所見となった。再発1例の検出費用は、集中的フォローアップで約4,500ポンド、定期的CTでは約12,880ポンドであった。
pmid-7678749.summary_en: This audit analyzed 29 patients who relapsed after treatment for metastatic testicular germ cell tumors, including 7 seminomas and 22 nonseminomatous tumors. Serum hCG and AFP estimation was the most important follow-up tool, first indicating relapse in 55% of patients, while chest radiographs rarely helped. CT of the chest and abdomen was the first abnormal investigation in 24% and was especially useful in patients with residual abnormalities. Intensive follow-up cost about 4,500 pounds per relapse detected, and regular CT cost about 12,880 pounds per relapse detected.

pmid-7679314.summary_ja: 予後良好な播種性精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対し、EP療法とPVB療法を後方視的に比較した単一施設研究です。完全奏効率はEPが91%、PVBが100%で、全生存期間は同程度でした。再発はEP群5例、PVB群1例で、PVB群の無再発生存期間が高い傾向を示しました。初回治療でのブレオマイシン省略は慎重に行うべきと結論づけています。
pmid-7679314.summary_en: This single-institution retrospective study compared etoposide plus cisplatin (EP) with cisplatin, vinblastine, and bleomycin (PVB) in patients with good-prognosis disseminated testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. Complete response rates were 91% with EP and 100% with PVB, and overall survival was similar. Relapses occurred in five EP patients and one PVB patient, and recurrence-free survival tended to be higher with PVB (P = 0.054). Pulmonary and cutaneous toxicity occurred only with PVB. The authors caution against omitting bleomycin in first-line therapy.

pmid-7679655.summary_ja: 進行期(IIC～IV期)の精巣セミノーマ36例に減量PVB療法を行った研究です。完全寛解は33例中32例(96.9%)で、観察期間中に再発例はありませんでした。事前に放射線療法を受けた患者も15例含まれていました。進行精巣セミノーマの初回治療として安全で有効と結論づけています。
pmid-7679655.summary_en: This Turkish study treated 36 patients with stage IIC-IV testicular seminoma using reduced-dose PVB chemotherapy. Most had typical seminoma, and hCG was elevated in 19 patients. Fifteen had received prior radiotherapy. Of the 33 patients who completed treatment, 32 (96.9%) achieved complete remission, and no relapse occurred during follow-up. The authors conclude that reduced-dose PVB can be a safe and successful primary treatment for advanced testicular seminoma.

pmid-7680083.summary_ja: 縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍由来の多能性細胞株NCCITを解析した研究です。セミノーマと胎児性癌の混合的な特徴を示し、hCGとAFPを産生します。レチノイン酸処理で増殖が抑制され、体細胞系譜へ分化しました。セミノーマと非セミノーマ性腫瘍の関係を研究するモデルとして有用と提案しています。
pmid-7680083.summary_en: This study characterized NCCIT, a developmentally pluripotent human cell line derived from a mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor, with hybrid seminoma and embryonal carcinoma features. The cells produce hCG and AFP and are hyperdiploid with structural aberrations. Retinoic acid inhibited growth and induced differentiation into keratin-, GFAP-, and neurofilament-positive somatic cells, with loss of stem cell markers. The authors propose NCCIT as a model for studying the relationship between seminoma and nonseminomatous tumors.

pmid-7680214.summary_ja: 3歳半の女児に生じた縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍(肺・骨・肺門リンパ節転移あり)の症例報告です。7か月の化学療法後に上行大動脈由来の残存腫瘤が認められ、切除したところ心膜内の良性嚢胞性奇形腫と判明しました。心膜内奇形腫と縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍の併存は極めて稀とされ、その病因が考察されています。
pmid-7680214.summary_en: This case report describes a 3.5-year-old girl with a mediastinal endodermal sinus tumor with pulmonary, bone, and hilar lymph node metastases. After seven months of chemotherapy, CT showed a residual mass arising from the ascending aorta. Surgical resection revealed a benign cystic teratoma within the pericardium. The authors note that this combination of intrapericardial teratoma and mediastinal endodermal sinus tumor is probably unique, and discuss its possible etiology.

pmid-7680553.summary_ja: 本研究はヒト胎児性癌細胞株Tera-2をレチノイン酸で分化誘導した際のFGF受容体(FGFR)発現とシグナル伝達の変化を検討した。未分化細胞は4種類すべてのFGFRを発現するが、分化によりFGFR-4は消失し、FGFR-2とFGFR-3は低下した。K-FGFの結合も著明に減少し、FGF刺激による遺伝子発現応答も分化後に変化した。
pmid-7680553.summary_en: This study examines how fibroblast growth factor receptor (FGFR) expression and FGF-induced signaling change when Tera-2 human embryonal carcinoma cells are differentiated with retinoic acid. Undifferentiated cells express all four FGFRs. Differentiation abolishes FGFR-4 mRNA and reduces FGFR-2 and FGFR-3, while FGFR-1 remains unchanged. Binding of K-FGF decreases substantially. FGF-stimulated expression of c-fos, c-jun, and junB also shifts after differentiation, indicating altered growth-factor responses.

pmid-7680555.summary_ja: マウスおよびヒトの胎児性癌細胞、マウス胚性幹細胞、ヒト胚細胞腫瘍を対象に、FGF受容体の発現とFGFによる増殖調節を比較した。マウス胚性幹細胞の分化ではFGFR1〜3が増加し、ヒト胎児性癌細胞ではFGFR2が低下しFGFR4が維持された。血清非含有培地で、aFGF・bFGF・kFGFは増殖を促進したが、KGFは増殖に影響しなかった。ヘパリンの作用には種差が認められた。
pmid-7680555.summary_en: This study compares fibroblast growth factor (FGF) receptor expression and FGF-driven growth in mouse and human embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells, mouse embryonic stem (ES) cells, and human germ cell tumours. In mouse ES cells, FGFR1-3 are upregulated during differentiation, whereas in human EC cells FGFR2 declines and FGFR4 persists. Acidic FGF, basic FGF, and K-FGF stimulate growth in serum-free medium, while KGF does not affect growth. Heparin effects differ between human and mouse cells.

pmid-7680893.summary_ja: 本研究では、両側性または家族性の胚細胞腫瘍患者32例と孤発例2例について、生殖細胞系列のTP53変異を調べた。腫瘍15例では体細胞変異とヘテロ接合性の消失(LOH)を解析し、12例では免疫組織化学によりTP53タンパク質を評価した。生殖細胞系列および体細胞のTP53変異は検出されなかった。解析可能な5例中1例でLOHが認められ、TP53タンパク質の増加を示す腫瘍はなかった。著者らは、TP53の変化がGCTの素因や発症に寄与する可能性は低いと結論づけている。
pmid-7680893.summary_en: This study screened 32 patients with bilateral or familial germ cell tumors and two with sporadic tumors for germline TP53 mutations. Fifteen tumors were analyzed for somatic mutations and loss of heterozygosity (LOH), and twelve were assessed for TP53 protein by immunohistochemistry. No germline or somatic TP53 mutations were detected. LOH occurred in one of five informative cases, and no tumors showed increased TP53 expression. The authors conclude that TP53 alterations are unlikely to contribute to GCT predisposition or development.

pmid-7681654.summary_ja: 19年間に治療された頸部奇形腫の乳児13例を後方視的に検討した。新生児3例は気道閉塞のため緊急手術を要し、他の10例は準緊急手術を受けた。術後に副甲状腺機能低下症と甲状腺機能低下症を合併した1例では補充療法を要した。手術死亡はなかったが、全例が経過の途中でフォローアップから脱落した。早期手術により二次的な悪性転化を回避できるとされる。
pmid-7681654.summary_en: A retrospective review of 13 infants with cervical teratomas treated over 19 years. Three neonates with airway obstruction required emergency surgery, and ten others underwent urgent operation. One patient developed postoperative hypoparathyroidism and hypothyroidism requiring replacement. No surgical deaths occurred, but all patients were lost to follow-up after a time. The authors note that early operation prevents secondary malignant transformation of these mostly benign teratomas.

pmid-7682032.summary_ja: 27歳男性の左精巣純粋型絨毛癌の症例で、精巣摘除術後に肺および傍大動脈リンパ節への転移を認めた。PVB療法4コース後に肺病変は41.9%縮小した。その後COMPE化学療法7コースで部分奏効を得た。残存病変は切除され、壊死と黄色肉芽腫性線維化が確認された。1年後も明らかな病変を認めなかった。
pmid-7682032.summary_en: A 27-year-old man with pure choriocarcinoma of the left testis, found after orchiectomy, had pulmonary and para-aortic lymph node metastases. After four PVB courses, pulmonary lesions regressed by 41.9%. Subsequent COMPE chemotherapy (cisplatin, vincristine, methotrexate, peplomycin, etoposide) produced a partial response after seven courses. Residual lung and retroperitoneal masses were resected, showing necrosis and xanthogranulomatous fibrosis, with no evidence of disease one year later.

pmid-7682154.summary_ja: ホジキン病の放射線療法後に精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍を異時性に発症した例と、ホジキン病と同時に発症した例を報告。前者はシスプラチン併用化学療法と後腹膜リンパ節郭清後に8年間寛解、後者は化学療法後14か月無病生存。若年男性では両方の悪性腫瘍を念頭に置くべきと結論づけている。
pmid-7682154.summary_en: This report describes two men with testicular cancer and Hodgkin disease. One developed metachronous nonseminomatous germ cell tumor two years after radiotherapy for Hodgkin disease. The other had synchronous disease with elevated AFP and hCG. The metachronous patient received five cycles of cisplatin-based chemotherapy and retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy and remained in remission for 8 years. The synchronous patient received cisplatin, etoposide, and doxorubicin and was disease-free at 14 months. The authors advise considering both malignancies in young men with atypical disease distribution.

pmid-7682284.summary_ja: 染色体が正常な姉妹2例が4か月の間に相次いで卵巣の悪性胚細胞腫瘍を発症した。一方はディスジャーミノーマ、他方は絨毛癌成分が目立つ混合性腫瘍であった。性腺異形成を伴わない家族性発症は稀であり、家族歴の聴取の重要性を示唆している。
pmid-7682284.summary_en: This report describes two sisters with normal female karyotypes who developed malignant ovarian germ cell tumors within a four-month period. One had a dysgerminoma and the other a mixed tumor with prominent choriocarcinomatous elements. Familial germ cell tumors are typically linked to gonadal dysgenesis, so occurrence in sisters with normal chromosomes is rare. The case suggests that familial clustering of ovarian germ cell tumors can occur without karyotypic abnormality, and it underlines the value of taking a family history.

pmid-7682952.summary_ja: ヒト胚細胞腫瘍由来の胎児性癌細胞の表面炭水化物抗原が、糖脂質と糖タンパク質のどちらに存在するかをPDMPで検討。PDMPは糖脂質抗原のみを抑制し、分化したヒト胎児性癌細胞ではSSEA1の免疫優位な形態を糖タンパク質が担うことが示唆された。
pmid-7682952.summary_en: This study examined carbohydrate antigens on human and mouse embryonal carcinoma cells, using PDMP, an inhibitor of glucosylceramide synthase, to determine whether they reside on glycolipids or glycoproteins. PDMP suppressed glycolipid antigens but not glycoprotein antigens. SSEA1 was expressed on both glycolipids and glycoproteins. PDMP resistance suggested that glycoproteins carry the immunodominant form of SSEA1 on the surface of differentiated human EC cells. The findings clarify the distribution of surface differentiation antigens in human germ cell tumor cells.

pmid-7683015.summary_ja: 卵巣未分化胚細胞腫にシスプラチン・ビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシン療法を行った症例で、一過性の皮質盲と痙攣が生じた。若年女性では妊孕能温存を考慮した保存的治療が適応となり、化学療法の毒性と利益の比較が重要と指摘している。
pmid-7683015.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with ovarian dysgerminoma treated with cisplatin, vinblastine, and bleomycin, who developed transient cortical blindness and seizures that may have been related to the chemotherapy. The authors note that ovarian dysgerminoma is the most common ovarian malignancy in young women and that conservative treatment is appropriate for women who wish to preserve fertility. They argue that the survival benefit of modern regimens must be weighed against serious toxicity.

pmid-7684319.summary_ja: 血管新生阻害剤TNP-470を絨毛癌細胞株などの培養細胞とヌードマウスで評価。絨毛癌細胞株は卵巣癌や子宮内膜癌の細胞株より低濃度で増殖が抑制された。GCH-1(m)細胞では30 mg/kgで肺転移が強く抑制され、転移治療への応用が期待されると結論づけた。
pmid-7684319.summary_en: This study evaluated the angiogenesis inhibitor TNP-470 in eight human cell lines, including three choriocarcinoma lines, and in nude mice. All lines showed growth inhibition, and the choriocarcinoma lines were far more sensitive than ovarian and endometrial cancer lines. In vivo, TNP-470 suppressed growth of GCH-1(m) and NUC-1 tumors. At 30 mg/kg it markedly reduced lung metastasis of GCH-1(m) cells and decreased tumor capillary growth. The authors suggest TNP-470 may be a promising treatment for metastasis.

pmid-7684595.summary_ja: 1979年から1991年に性腺外胚細胞腫瘍56例にシスプラチン併用化学療法を施行した長期成績の報告である。セミノーマ例の完全寛解率は94%、非セミノーマ例は37%であった。BEP療法はVAB-6より優れ、マーカー高値は予後不良因子であった。現行の病期分類では治療成績を十分予測できないと結論している。
pmid-7684595.summary_en: This 1979–1991 series of 56 patients with extragonadal germ cell tumors treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy reports long-term outcomes. Complete remission rates were 94% for seminomatous and 37% for nonseminomatous tumors. Seminomatous histology predicted better response, and BEP induction outperformed VAB-6. Nonseminomatous patients with marker levels above 2000 ng/ml had worse prognosis. The authors conclude that current staging systems poorly predict treatment outcome.

pmid-7685094.summary_ja: ヒト絨毛癌株BeWo細胞をフォルスコリンで分化・融合させた際の、ホスファチジルセリン抗原の発現変化を免疫組織化学的に検討した研究である。治療前後で反応するエピトープが変化し、栄養膜細胞の分化に関与する可能性が示された。絨毛癌細胞株を用いた研究である。
pmid-7685094.summary_en: The authors examined phosphatidylserine epitope expression in the human choriocarcinoma line BeWo during forskolin-induced differentiation and fusion. Untreated cells expressed one PS epitope strongly, and forskolin shifted reactivity toward a second PS-reactive antibody epitope. A cardiolipin-type antibody did not bind. The findings suggest altered PS expression may be critical for cytotrophoblast differentiation and placental development, with implications for pregnancy loss.

pmid-7685239.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌の組織でEGFおよびEGF受容体の発現を免疫組織化学で比較した研究である。良性から悪性へ進むにつれて発現は低下し、侵入奇胎はその中間を示した。EGFは自己分泌・傍分泌的に作用し、その発現低下が栄養膜細胞の悪性転化に関与する可能性が示された。
pmid-7685239.summary_en: Immunoperoxidase staining compared EGF and EGF receptor expression across hydatidiform mole, invasive mole, and choriocarcinoma tissues. Most moles stained intensely, most choriocarcinomas weakly, and invasive moles were intermediate. Expression decreased with progression from benign to malignant trophoblastic disease. The authors suggest EGF acts in an autocrine-paracrine manner, and that reduced EGF signaling accompanies the malignant transformation of trophoblasts.

pmid-7685586.summary_ja: 縦隔原発の進行絨毛癌の26歳男性に対し、PVeBV療法で完全寛解を得た後、末梢血幹細胞移植を併用した大量化学療法を施行した症例報告である。造血回復は速やかで、24か月間再発を認めなかった。進行絨毛癌に対する本治療法の有用性が示唆される。
pmid-7685586.summary_en: A 26-year-old man with advanced mediastinal choriocarcinoma with cervical, mediastinal, and bilateral lung metastases achieved complete remission after three courses of PVeBV chemotherapy. Because recurrence risk was high, peripheral blood stem cells were collected and high-dose chemotherapy with PBSC transplantation was given. Hematopoietic recovery was rapid, and the patient remained free of recurrence for 24 months. The case shows the potential of this approach for advanced choriocarcinoma.

pmid-7685624.summary_ja: i(12p)を欠く精巣胚細胞腫瘍3例において、第12染色体由来のマーカー染色体を検討した。2例では、アクロセントリック染色体(13番または14番)の着糸点を含む部分が12p上に転座した二動原体染色体が見られた。3例目でも13qが同様の再構成に関与したと考えられた。12p上の遺伝子増幅が胚細胞腫瘍の発生における重要な段階であることを示唆する所見である。
pmid-7685624.summary_en: This study examined chromosome 12-derived markers in three testicular germ cell tumors lacking i(12p). Two markers were dicentric chromosomes in which the centromere-containing part of an acrocentric chromosome (13 or 14) had translocated onto 12p. In the third tumor, 13q was probably involved in a similar rearrangement. The findings suggest that amplification of genes on 12p is a significant step in germ cell tumor development.

pmid-7685748.summary_ja: 1960～1991年に病期I・IIの精巣セミノーマ350例が精巣摘除術後に放射線療法を受けた。1984年の方針変更前後で比較した。5年無再発率は病期I 97%、病期IIA 87%だった。病期IIAでは左鎖骨上窩への再発が目立ち、予防的照射の必要性が示唆された。
pmid-7685748.summary_en: This study compared outcomes of 350 patients with stage I or II testicular seminoma who received post-orchiectomy radiation at M.D. Anderson between 1960 and 1991, before and after 1984 policy changes. The changes included CT for retroperitoneal nodes, abandonment of elective mediastinal radiation, and reclassification of small abdominal adenopathy as stage IIA. Five-year freedom from relapse was 97% for stage I and 87% for IIA. Stage IIA relapses occurred mainly in the left supraclavicular region.

pmid-7685750.summary_ja: 5臓器の148腫瘍について、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)の型を免疫組織化学的に判別した。卵黄嚢型AFPは卵黄嚢腫瘍、胎児性癌、充実性奇形腫などで認められた。肝型AFPは肝細胞癌や肝芽腫などで認められた。68例の血清分析結果は染色所見と一致した。AFP型は腫瘍の組織発生の推定に有用である。
pmid-7685750.summary_en: This study used immunohistochemistry to classify alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) by type in 148 tumors from various organs. Yolk sac-type AFP was found in yolk sac tumors, embryonal carcinomas, solid teratomas, and several adenocarcinomas. Hepatic-type AFP appeared in hepatocellular carcinomas, hepatoblastomas, and some teratomas. Serum analyses of 68 patients were consistent with the staining results. The AFP type helps infer tumor histogenesis.

pmid-7686444.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍患者の血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)について、フコシル化およびグルコサミニル化の指標を測定した。フコシル化指数は胚細胞腫瘍で99%と、肝細胞癌や良性肝疾患より有意に高かった。胚細胞腫瘍でのAFP糖鎖の特徴はグルコサミニル化より、フコシル化にあることが示された。
pmid-7686444.summary_en: This study measured fucosylation and glucosaminylation indices of alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) in serum from germ cell tumor patients and compared them with hepatocellular carcinoma, metastatic liver cancer, and benign liver disease. The fucosylation index was markedly higher in germ cell tumors (99%) than in the comparison groups. Glucosaminylation was also elevated relative to HCC and benign disease but similar to liver metastases. Fucosylation is the characteristic AFP glycosylation feature of germ cell tumors, potentially aiding differential diagnosis.

pmid-7687081.summary_ja: 生後1か月の男児の精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍症例について報告した。根治的精巣摘除術後、AFPは低下したものの6か月間わずかに高値が続いた。文献検索で、生後8か月までは乳児のAFPが生理的に高値であることが判明した。乳児では年齢別の基準値を考慮すべきであることを強調している。
pmid-7687081.summary_en: The authors describe a one-month-old boy with a testicular yolk sac tumor treated by radical orchiectomy. His AFP level fell after surgery but stayed mildly elevated for six months, initially suggesting residual tumor. A literature review showed that AFP normally remains elevated during the first eight months of life. Recognizing these higher age-specific reference ranges is important for using AFP as a tumor marker in infants.

pmid-7687123.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のJAR細胞について、灌流系を用いてhCGの分泌を検討した。自発的なhCG放出は48分周期の周期的パターンを示した。GnRHや高濃度KClは即時のhCG放出を誘導し、GnRHの反復投与では遅延性の放出が見られた。絨毛癌細胞はhCG分泌調節の研究に有用なトロホブラストモデルである。
pmid-7687123.summary_en: This study examined hCG secretion from JAR choriocarcinoma cells using a superfusion system. Spontaneous hCG release showed a periodic pattern with a 48-minute interval. GnRH and high potassium both triggered immediate hCG release, and repeated GnRH produced delayed release. The authors interpret these results in terms of hormone storage granules and cell-to-cell interactions. JAR cells serve as a trophoblast model for studying hCG regulation.

pmid-7687259.summary_ja: 生後2週間の乳児の肝絨毛癌のMR所見を報告した。肝左葉の大きな腫瘤と右葉の子宮内病変様の結節が認められた。周辺部はT1・T2強調像で高信号を示し、亜急性出血が示唆された。両腫瘤は造影後に周辺部が増強された。母体のβ-hCGと骨盤CTは正常であった。
pmid-7687259.summary_en: This report presents the MR findings of hepatic choriocarcinoma in a two-week-old infant. The imaging showed two heterogeneous masses, a large left hepatic lesion and a daughter nodule in the right lobe. Peripheral hyperintensity on T1- and T2-weighted images suggested subacute hemorrhage, and the central portions were hypointense on T1 and bright on T2. Both masses showed peripheral enhancement after gadolinium. The mother had normal beta-hCG levels and a normal pelvic CT.

pmid-7687459.summary_ja: 本研究は男性胚細胞腫瘍31例(セミノーマ19例、非セミノーマ性12例)を対象に、11番染色体短腕11p13および11p15のヘテロ接合性消失を解析しました。解析可能な症例の40%で欠失が認められ、父由来の欠失が多く見られました。11p上の腫瘍抑制遺伝子の不活化が精巣がんの発生に関与することが示唆されました。
pmid-7687459.summary_en: This study examined loss of heterozygosity at chromosome 11p loci in 31 male germ cell tumors, including 19 seminomas and 12 nonseminomas. Allelic loss at 11p13 or 11p15 was found in 40% of informative tumors, with paternal losses predominating in the cases where parental origin was identified. The findings suggest that inactivation of one or more tumor suppressor genes on 11p contributes to the development of testicular cancer.

pmid-7687549.summary_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で再発リスクの高い43例に対し、精巣摘除術後にシスプラチンを用いた2サイクルの補助化学療法を行った前向き試験です。治療を完遂した41例中40例(97.5%)が中央値42か月の観察で再発を認めませんでした。フォローアップが困難な症例では、後腹膜リンパ節郭清や待機観察の代替になり得ると示唆されています。
pmid-7687549.summary_en: This prospective trial treated 43 patients with high-risk clinical stage I non-seminomatous germ cell tumors, defined by vascular invasion, pT greater than 1, or embryonal carcinoma, with two cycles of cisplatin-based adjuvant chemotherapy after orchiectomy. After a median follow-up of 42 months, 40 of the 41 patients who completed treatment remained relapse-free. The authors propose this approach as an alternative to surveillance or retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, particularly when follow-up is unreliable.

pmid-7688871.summary_ja: 進行性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の13例に、精巣摘除術を行う前にPVB化学療法を実施した報告です。5例は化学療法のみで完全奏効し、8例の残存腫瘤は外科的に切除されましたが、いずれも組織学的に生存腫瘍は認められませんでした。遅延精巣摘除では、残存生存腫瘍3例、壊死・線維化組織5例、成熟奇形腫5例が確認されました。
pmid-7688871.summary_en: Thirteen patients with advanced germ cell testicular cancer received PVB chemotherapy before orchiectomy. Five achieved complete response with chemotherapy alone, while eight kept residual masses that were surgically resected and showed no viable tumor histologically. Delayed orchiectomy found residual viable tumor in three patients, necrotic or fibrotic tissue in five, and mature teratoma in five. The authors recommend early intensive chemotherapy without primary tumor histology to manage life-threatening metastatic symptoms.

pmid-7689033.summary_ja: シスプラチン感受性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞株833Kと、その耐性株64CP9を対象に、FISH法で染色体12の分布を解析した研究です。染色体12由来のクロマチンが複数の染色体に異所的に見られ、異所性の核小体形成体(NOR)を伴っていました。この分布の違いがシスプラチン耐性と関連するかは不明とされています。
pmid-7689033.summary_en: This study used FISH with alpha satellite and whole chromosome painting probes to examine chromosome 12 in a cisplatin-sensitive testicular germ cell tumor cell line (833K) and its cisplatin-resistant derivative (64CP9). Chromosome 12-derived chromatin appeared on several acrocentric and nonacrocentric chromosomes, often as satellite-like regions with ectopic nucleolar organizing regions. The authors note that these distribution differences may or may not relate to cisplatin resistance.

pmid-7689366.summary_ja: 32歳男性の後腹膜原発胎児性癌の症例報告です。精巣は正常でしたが、頸部および鼠径リンパ節の急速な腫大とαフェトプロテイン(AFP)・ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の高値を認めました。シスプラチン、ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシンによるPVB化学療法で著明な腫瘍縮小が得られ、治療後2年間再発はありません。
pmid-7689366.summary_en: This report describes a 32-year-old man with primary embryonal carcinoma of the retroperitoneum, a very rare extragonadal presentation. He presented acutely with enlarged cervical and inguinal lymph nodes and markedly elevated AFP and hCG, while the testes were intact. Systemic PVB chemotherapy with cisplatin, vinblastine, and bleomycin produced remarkable tumor regression, and no recurrence was observed two years later.

pmid-7689921.summary_ja: 縦隔原発の胚細胞腫瘍98例を30年間にわたり後方視的に検討した。成熟奇形腫は切除のみで治癒し、セミノーマは手術や放射線療法で良好な成績を示した。非セミノーマ性腫瘍ではシスプラチン併用化学療法で生存が改善したが、非胚細胞性の固形腫瘍や血液悪性腫瘍の発生が課題として残った。
pmid-7689921.summary_en: This single-institution review of 98 patients with mediastinal germ cell tumors over 30 years categorizes histology as mature teratoma, immature teratoma, seminoma, and malignant nonseminomatous GCT. Mature teratomas were cured by resection alone, and seminomas responded well to surgery with or without radiotherapy. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy improved outcomes in nonseminomatous disease, although later non-germ-cell malignancies and hematologic disorders emerged as a concern.

pmid-7690705.summary_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍を対象に、AFPとhCGの有用性を8年間にわたり検討した。前半の4年間では、マーカー値とリンパ節転移や治療反応の相関を病期別に評価し、80〜92%の正確度が得られた。後半では病期分類にマーカーを組み込み、マーカー上昇を伴う病期IMの3年生存率は、正常マーカーの病期Iより低かった。治療後もマーカーが高値のままの例は予後不良であった。
pmid-7690705.summary_en: This eight-year institutional experience evaluates serum AFP and hCG in nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis. In the first period, marker status was retrospectively correlated with nodal positivity and treatment response, with 80 to 92 percent accuracy by stage. In the second period, markers were incorporated into staging, and stage IM patients had poorer 3-year survival than stage I patients with normal markers. Persistently raised markers after treatment predicted very poor survival.

pmid-7690731.summary_ja: 46,XY核型をもつ21歳の表現型女性で、異形成性性腺に悪性奇形腫が発生した1例を報告した。腫瘍内にはディスジャーミノーマ、胚様体に隣接する卵黄嚢腫瘍、絨毛癌の成分が混在していた。対側性腺は線維血管性の索状組織で、性腺芽細胞腫は認められず、異形成性性腺に新生的に発生したと考察された。性腺異形成症における混合組織型を示す単症例報告である。
pmid-7690731.summary_en: A 21-year-old phenotypic female with a 46,XY karyotype developed a malignant teratoma within a dysgenetic gonad.
