The tumor contained dysgerminoma, yolk sac tumor adjacent to embryoid bodies, and choriocarcinoma elements. The contralateral gonad was a fibrovascular streak, and no gonadoblastoma was identified, which the authors interpret as de novo tumor development in a dysgenetic gonad. This single case illustrates mixed germ cell histology in gonadal dysgenesis.

pmid-7690985.summary_ja: hCGおよびhCGβの臨床的応用を総説し、妊娠関連疾患と精巣がんにおけるマーカーとしての役割をまとめた。高感度免疫測定法により、子宮外妊娠、胞状奇胎、絨毛癌などの診断に寄与する。精巣がんでは、多くのセミノーマが遊離hCGβのみを分泌するため、hCGとhCGβの両方の測定が治療やフォローアップに推奨される。膀胱・膵臓・胆道がんにおけるhCGβの有用性は議論中とされる。
pmid-7690985.summary_en: This review summarizes the clinical use of hCG and its beta subunit as markers in pregnancy-related disorders and testicular cancer. Sensitive immunometric assays detect hCG in normal individuals and aid in diagnosing ectopic pregnancy, hydatidiform mole, and choriocarcinoma. For testicular cancer, measuring both hCG and free hCGβ is recommended for guiding treatment and follow-up, since many seminomas secrete only hCGβ. The authors also note that the roles of hCGβ in bladder, pancreatic, and biliary cancers are debated.

pmid-7691042.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍に対し鼠径部から精巣摘除術と後腹膜・腸骨リンパ節への放射線療法を受けた37歳男性が、6か月後に左恥骨の骨融解と軟部腫瘤で再発した。生検で精巣がんと一致する組織所見が確認された。PEB化学療法（シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシン）と放射線療法により腫瘍は大きく縮小し、再生検では線維化のみでがん細胞は認められなかった。患者は無病生存中である。
pmid-7691042.summary_en: A 37-year-old man previously treated with orchiectomy and retroperitoneal and iliac nodal radiotherapy for a right testicular tumor presented with left pubic bone osteolysis and a soft-tissue mass. Biopsy confirmed a recurrence consistent with his prior testicular cancer. PEB chemotherapy (cisplatin, etoposide, bleomycin) with radiotherapy produced marked tumor regression, and repeat biopsy showed only fibrosis without viable cancer. The patient remained alive without evidence of disease.

pmid-7691050.summary_ja: 進行期または再発の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍17例に、PVB療法（シスプラチン、ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシン）を4サイクル施行した。17例中12例（70.5%）で奏効が得られ、そのうち11例は完全奏効であった。完全奏効の3例はセカンドルック手術で病変を認めなかった。毒性は中等度で、治療関連死が1例あった。PVB療法は進行期および再発例に有効な併用療法であると結論された。
pmid-7691050.summary_en: This study reports 17 patients with advanced or relapsed ovarian germ cell tumors treated with four cycles of cisplatin, vinblastine, and bleomycin (PVB). Overall, 12 of 17 (70.5 percent) responded, 11 with complete response, and three complete responders underwent second-look surgery with no residual disease. Histologies included dysgerminoma, yolk sac tumor, and immature teratoma. Common toxicities were nausea, myelosuppression, and mucositis, with one treatment-related death. The authors conclude that PVB is effective and moderately toxic.

pmid-7691391.summary_ja: 性腺の胚細胞腫瘍患者9例で、腫瘍の進行・再発や残存がないにもかかわらず血清AFPが上昇した症例を報告した。上昇は化学療法薬や抗てんかん薬などの薬剤、ウイルス、アルコールによる肝機能障害に起因すると考えられた。いずれの症例にも悪性腫瘍の活動を示す臨床的・手術的所見はなかった。AFPの上昇を安易に腫瘍の再発と解釈せず、不必要な治療を避けるべきと注意喚起している。
pmid-7691391.summary_en: This report describes nine patients with gonadal germ cell tumors whose serum AFP was elevated without tumor progression, recurrence, or residual disease. The elevations were attributed to liver dysfunction caused by drugs such as chemotherapy or antiepileptics, viral infection, or alcohol. None had clinical or surgical evidence of active malignancy. The authors caution that AFP rises can reflect liver damage, so they should be interpreted carefully to avoid unnecessary treatment.

pmid-7691711.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌8例と胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍3例を免疫組織化学とフローサイトメトリーで比較した研究です。絨毛癌はヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)陽性が多く、PSTTはヒト胎盤性ラクトゲン陽性が主体でした。全症例が二倍体で、マーカーや倍数性は臨床転帰と相関せず、悪性トロホブラスト腫瘍の予後予測には限界があると結論づけています。
pmid-7691711.summary_en: This study compared eight gestational choriocarcinomas and three placental-site trophoblastic tumors using immunohistochemistry and flow cytometry. Choriocarcinomas showed abundant hCG in syncytiotrophoblasts, whereas PSTTs were predominantly positive for human placental lactogen. One PSTT resembled choriocarcinoma in its staining pattern. All tumors were diploid, and no marker, ploidy, or S-phase measure correlated with clinical outcome. The authors conclude that these tools may be ineffective for predicting the biologic behavior of malignant trophoblastic tumors.

pmid-7692620.summary_ja: 31歳男性の右上葉に発生した、肺原発の純粋な卵黄嚢腫瘍の初めての症例報告です。手術前に血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)が上昇しており、肺区域切除と術後の併用化学療法を行いました。術後13か月の時点で健在で、AFPは正常範囲に戻っています。性腺外に発生する胚細胞腫瘍の重要な例です。
pmid-7692620.summary_en: The authors describe the first reported case of a pure primary yolk sac tumor of the lung, in a 31-year-old man. The tumor arose in the right upper lobe, and serum alpha-fetoprotein was elevated before surgery. Treatment consisted of pulmonary segmentectomy followed by postoperative combination chemotherapy. At 13 months after surgery, the patient was alive and well with a normal AFP concentration. The report highlights that extragonadal germ cell tumors can arise primarily in the lung and that AFP is useful for monitoring disease.

pmid-7692725.summary_ja: 雌性単為発生の卵巣奇形腫と雄性単為発生の完全胞状奇胎の組織を用い、刷り込み遺伝子H19とIGF2の発現を解析した研究です。卵巣奇形腫では両遺伝子とも発現が見られず、胞状奇胎では単核栄養膜細胞で両者が共発現していました。逆向きの刷り込みには二親性ゲノムが必要かもしれないと考察しています。
pmid-7692725.summary_en: Human uniparental conceptions, namely gynogenetic ovarian teratomas and androgenetic complete hydatidiform moles, were used to examine the imprinted genes H19 and IGF2. In normal pregnancies, each gene is expressed from only one parental allele. In gynogenetic teratomas neither gene was expressed, while in androgenetic moles both were expressed from the paternal genome, in mononuclear trophoblast. The authors suggest that a biparental genome may be required for proper reciprocal IGF2/H19 imprinting, or that biparental expression reflects normal patterns in some cell types.

pmid-7692755.summary_ja: 新生児期に仙尾部奇形腫と診断された6例が、後に卵黄嚢腫瘍を含む悪性腫瘍を再発した小児胚細胞腫瘍の報告です。初回腫瘍の再検討で5例中4例に微小な卵黄嚢腫瘍の病巣が見つかりました。新生児期は血清AFPが生理的に高値をとるため、この病巣の検出が重要と結論づけています。
pmid-7692755.summary_en: This Pediatric Oncology Group and Children's Cancer Group study reports six children whose sacrococcygeal teratomas were diagnosed in the newborn period and later developed recurrent malignancy, such as pure yolk sac tumor or teratoma with yolk sac elements. Review of the original slides found microscopic yolk sac tumor foci in four of five tumors. Four children responded to therapy, one died, and one was lost to follow-up. Because neonatal serum AFP may be physiologically high, the authors stress that detecting such foci is important.

pmid-7692949.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の切除と化学療法の9か月後に骨髄異形成症候群を発症した14歳女児の症例です。骨髄細胞と原発腫瘍の両方に8番染色体トリソミーと12p等染色体が認められました。両者は共通のクローン起源を持つと強く示唆され、胚細胞腫瘍と血液腫瘍の関連を考えるうえで示唆的です。
pmid-7692949.summary_en: A 14-year-old girl developed myelodysplastic syndrome nine months after surgical resection and chemotherapy for an ovarian germ cell tumor. Her marrow cells showed trisomy 8 and an isochromosome 12p, a marker the authors describe as appearing unique to germ cell tumors. The same two abnormalities were detected in her original tumor by fluorescence in situ hybridization on paraffin-embedded tissue. This finding strongly suggests that the tumor and the myelodysplasia shared a common clonal origin.

pmid-7693955.summary_ja: 予後不良の進行性胚細胞腫瘍の男性28例を対象とした第II相試験です。血清腫瘍マーカーの消失が遅延した22例に、大量カルボプラチンとエトポシドおよび自家骨髄移植を追加しました。反応評価可能な27例中15例(56%)が完全奏効に達し、大量化学療法は忍容性が良好でした。ランダム化試験が必要と結論づけています。
pmid-7693955.summary_en: This phase II trial treated 28 men with poor-risk advanced germ cell tumors using cisplatin-based VAB-6 chemotherapy. Twenty-two patients with slow serum tumor marker clearance received high-dose carboplatin and etoposide plus autologous bone marrow transplantation. Fifteen of 27 assessable patients (56%) achieved complete response, and 16 (57%) were alive. High-dose therapy was well tolerated. The authors conclude that the regimen is feasible when marker half-life predicts cisplatin resistance, and that randomized trials are warranted.

pmid-7694512.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の近年の進展をまとめた総説です。卵黄嚢腫瘍の肝様型・腺型、未熟奇形腫と類皮嚢腫の関係、単一胚葉性奇形腫を取り上げています。卵巣甲状腺腫の診断の難しさと悪性の判定基準も論じられています。さらに内分泌症候群や傍腫瘍症候群など、胚細胞腫瘍の非典型的な臨床像が整理されています。
pmid-7694512.summary_en: A review of ovarian germ cell tumors highlighting recent developments. It covers hepatoid and glandular subtypes of yolk sac tumor, the relationship between immature teratomas and dermoid cysts, and monodermal teratomas. Struma ovarii diagnostic challenges and malignancy criteria are discussed, along with carcinoid variants and rare primary ovarian neuroectodermal and sebaceous tumors. Unusual clinical features, including endocrine syndromes, paraneoplastic syndromes, autoimmune hemolytic anemia, and Meigs' syndrome, are summarized.

pmid-7901063.summary_ja: 20年間に治療された卵巣甲状腺腫16例(悪性2例、良性14例)を後方視的に検討しました。卵巣腫瘍の1.0%、胚細胞腫瘍の4%を占めていました。悪性例は病期IA期およびIC期で、転移能が低いことから若年者では保存的手術が支持されると結論づけています。術前や凍結切片での悪性判定は難しいことも示されています。
pmid-7901063.summary_en: A retrospective institutional review of 16 struma ovarii cases over 20 years, including 2 malignant and 14 benign tumors. Struma ovarii represented 1.0% of ovarian neoplasms and 4% of germ cell tumors. Malignant cases were stage IA and IC with low-grade behavior. Preoperative and frozen-section diagnosis of malignancy proved difficult, leading to radical surgery in two benign cases. The authors conclude that low metastatic potential supports conservative surgery in young patients desiring fertility preservation.

pmid-7903940.summary_ja: 4か月の男児が、無症候性の左停留精巣と右側腹部腫瘤で受診した。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で石灰化を伴う後腹膜腫瘍が認められた。手術標本の組織学的検討で、対側の停留精巣に原発した成熟奇形腫と診断された。極めてまれな症例であり、停留精巣の乳児では腹腔内悪性腫瘍の除外のため慎重な診察が必要であると著者らは強調している。
pmid-7903940.summary_en: A 4-month-old boy presented with an asymptomatic undescended left testis and a right-sided abdominal mass. Computed tomography showed a calcified retroperitoneal tumour. Surgical histology revealed a mature primary teratoma arising in the contralateral undescended testis, an exceptionally rare finding. The authors emphasise that infants with undescended testis should be carefully examined to exclude intra-abdominal malignant tumours.

pmid-7904873.summary_ja: 32年間下腹部腫瘤を有した87歳女性が開腹術を受け、捻転を伴う21cmの左卵巣類皮嚢腫が判明した。病理では出血性梗塞、粘液性嚢胞腺腫、腫瘍内の結核が確認された。子宮内膜、両側卵巣、卵管、大網にも結核が認められた。手術と薬物療法により経過は良好であった。類皮嚢腫内の結核は、合併症が生じるまで長期間無症状のことがあると著者らは述べている。
pmid-7904873.summary_en: An 87-year-old woman with a 32-year history of a lower abdominal mass underwent laparotomy, revealing a 21-cm left ovarian dermoid cyst complicated by torsion. Pathology showed a haemorrhagic infarct, a coexisting mucinous cystadenoma and tuberculosis within the tumour. Tuberculosis was also found in the endometrium, both ovaries, oviducts and omentum. Recovery was uneventful after surgery and medical treatment. The authors note that tuberculosis in a dermoid cyst may remain silent for years unless complications occur.

pmid-7906703.summary_ja: 膵頭部領域に類皮嚢腫を有する26歳女性に対し、根治的膵頭十二指腸切除術が施行された。6年間のフォローアップで再発は認められていない。診断および手術の過程を詳細に記載し、関連文献を概説している。性腺外に生じた類皮嚢腫という稀な症例である。
pmid-7906703.summary_en: A 26-year-old woman with a dermoid cyst in the region of the pancreatic head was treated with radical pancreatoduodenectomy. She has remained free of recurrence at 6-year follow-up. The authors describe the diagnostic and surgical procedures and review the relevant literature. This extragonadal location of a dermoid cyst is rare.

pmid-7909185.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患26例と正常胎盤5例を対象に、免疫組織化学で細胞増殖マーカー(PCNA)とP53蓄積を検討した。絨毛癌と完全・部分胞状奇胎はいずれもPCNAが高値で、増殖活性は同等であった。P53蓄積は絨毛癌と完全胞状奇胎でのみ認められ、部分胞状奇胎や正常胎盤では認められなかった。著者らは、P53遺伝子変異は真の栄養膜性腫瘍に特異的であると結論づけている。
pmid-7909185.summary_en: This study compared cell proliferation (PCNA) and p53 overaccumulation in 26 gestational trophoblastic disease cases and five normal placentae using immunohistochemistry. PCNA was high in choriocarcinomas and in complete and partial hydatidiform moles, suggesting comparable proliferative activity. p53 overaccumulation occurred only in choriocarcinomas and complete moles, not in partial moles or normal placentae. The authors conclude that p53 mutation marks true trophoblastic neoplasia.

pmid-7951513.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のBeWo細胞を用い、DNA合成阻害薬が胎盤関連遺伝子の発現に与える影響を検討した。アフィジコリンおよびDONはメトトレキサートと同様にc-mycを抑制したが、hCGα発現は誘導せず、コレステロール側鎖切断酵素の誘導はメトトレキサートとDONに限られた。c-myc抑制だけでは、メトトレキサートによる胎盤関連遺伝子の変化を説明できないことが示された。
pmid-7951513.summary_en: This study examined how DNA synthesis inhibitors affect gene expression in BeWo choriocarcinoma cells. Methotrexate and hydroxyurea were previously shown to induce placental genes while suppressing c-myc. Aphidicolin and DON also reduced c-myc expression and changed cell morphology like methotrexate. However, only methotrexate and DON stimulated cholesterol side-chain cleavage enzyme, and no agent induced hCG alpha. The authors conclude that c-myc downregulation alone cannot explain the full set of placental gene changes induced by methotrexate.

pmid-7974858.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者の血清LD-1測定において、溶血による汚染が測定値を上昇させる影響を検討した。血清ヘモグロビン1 mg/Lあたり約0.1 U/Lの見かけ上のLD-1上昇が認められ、44例の解析では補正により中央値が24 U/L低下した。腫瘍マーカーの評価には、血清ヘモグロビン濃度に基づく補正が必要であると提言している。
pmid-7974858.summary_en: This study examined how hemolysis contamination affects measurement of serum lactate dehydrogenase isoenzyme 1 (LD-1) in patients with testicular germ cell tumors. In seven control patients, each 1 mg/L of serum hemoglobin added about 0.1 U/L of apparent LD-1. Applying this correction to a previously reported cohort of 44 patients would lower median LD-1 by 24 U/L. The authors recommend correcting LD-1 values using serum hemoglobin, because hemolysis can otherwise produce misleadingly high tumor marker readings.

pmid-8062028.summary_ja: 胎児仙尾部奇形腫(SCT)の総説である。出生前・周産期の合併症リスクが高く、自然経過や病態生理は出生後診断例と異なることが近年明らかになった。予後は病態生理学的事象の予測と認識、そして適切な産科的・外科的管理に依存する。一部の症例では胎児期の腫瘍切除が唯一の生存の機会となりうる。
pmid-8062028.summary_en: This review describes fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT), which carries high risk of prenatal and perinatal complications. The authors note that the natural history and pathophysiology of fetal SCT differ from postnatally diagnosed SCT and have only recently been defined. Outcomes depend on anticipating and recognizing pathophysiologic events and providing optimal obstetric and surgical management. In selected fetuses, in utero resection of the tumor may be the only chance of survival.

pmid-8080478.summary_ja: 精巣がんと腎細胞癌が同時に認められた3症例を報告した短報である。二つの異なる腫瘍が併存することは稀である。各症例の臨床像を示し、このような重複悪性腫瘍の管理について考察している。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者を評価する際には、第二の原発腫瘍の可能性を考慮する必要性を示している。
pmid-8080478.summary_en: This report describes three patients with testicular cancer who also had renal cell carcinoma. The combined presentation of two separate neoplasms is considered rare. The authors describe the clinical features of these cases and discuss how such dual malignancies should be managed. The paper is a short case series that highlights the need to consider a second primary tumor when evaluating patients with germ cell tumors of the testis.

pmid-8093980.summary_ja: アンドロゲン不応症候群の若年女性に、骨盤内の停留精巣から発生した純粋セミノーマの症例報告である。症候群の生化学的・内分泌学的異常と停留精巣の組織像を文献的に概説した。XY核型のこれらの患者では性腺の悪性転化リスクが高く、診断と治療管理の重要性を強調している。
pmid-8093980.summary_en: This case report describes a young woman with androgen insensitivity (testicular feminization) syndrome who developed a pure seminoma in an undescended intrapelvic testis. The authors review the biochemical and endocrine abnormalities causing the syndrome, along with the light-microscopic features of undescended testes. They emphasize that these patients, with XY karyotype, have an increased risk of malignant transformation of the gonad, and they discuss diagnosis and therapeutic management.

pmid-8094763.summary_ja: セミノーマ10検体において、ICAM-1およびMHC抗原の発現と腫瘍浸潤単核細胞を免疫組織学的に検討した。ICAM-1は7検体、MHCクラスIは9検体で発現が認められた。未分化型では両抗原とも検出されず、抗原発現はリンパ球浸潤と相関しなかった。宿主の抗腫瘍反応に寄与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-8094763.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined ICAM-1 and MHC antigen expression in ten seminomas, along with tumor-infiltrating mononuclear cells. ICAM-1 was detected in seven and MHC class I in nine specimens, while MHC class II was absent. Expression did not correlate with clinical or pathological factors, and anaplastic seminoma lacked both antigens. Lymphocyte infiltration was marked but did not match antigen levels. The authors suggest these molecules may aid antitumor immunity.

pmid-8095117.summary_ja: 両側精巣固定術の18年後に精巣腫瘍を発症した症例で、反対側の鼠径リンパ節に転移を認めた。陰嚢部の手術により新たなリンパ管路が形成され、リンパ節転移のパターンが変化する可能性が示唆された。単一症例のため、機序は推測にとどまる。
pmid-8095117.summary_en: A 28-year-old man developed a testicular tumor and an inguinal lymph node metastasis on the contralateral side 18 years after bilateral orchiopexy. The authors suggest that scrotal surgery may create new lymphatic channels that alter the pattern of nodal metastasis. This is a single case, so the mechanism is inferred rather than proven.

pmid-8095495.summary_ja: 免疫マウスの脾細胞から、胎児性癌F9細胞に対する細胞傷害性T細胞を誘導した。CD4陽性T細胞の関与のもと、TCRαβ陽性のダブルネガティブT細胞が得られた。これらはMHC非拘束性に複数の腫瘍細胞を傷害し、F9細胞と他の腫瘍に共通する抗原を認識していた。
pmid-8095495.summary_en: The authors induced cytotoxic T cells from immune mice against murine embryonal carcinoma F9 cells. They identified TCR alpha-beta-positive CD4-CD8- double-negative cytotoxic T lymphocytes whose induction required CD4+ T cells. These cells killed various tumor cells in an MHC-unrestricted manner, recognizing a shared antigen on F9 and other tumors rather than minor histocompatibility antigens. The study provides insight into immune recognition of embryonal carcinoma cells.

pmid-8096954.summary_ja: スコットランド西部の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍440例を対象に、予後因子を解析した。診断時の進展度、診断時期、治療施設が独立した予後因子であった。治療を集約した施設は、プロトコル治療を調整してもなお生存成績が良好であった。治療の集約化が予後を改善することが示唆された。
pmid-8096954.summary_en: A population-based audit of 440 men with non-seminomatous germ cell tumours in west Scotland (1975-1989) examined prognostic factors. Extent of disease at diagnosis, diagnosis period and treatment unit were independent predictors of survival. The unit treating most patients, including the poorest-prognosis group, had the best survival, even after adjusting for protocol treatment. Centralisation of treatment appears to improve outcome beyond protocol therapy alone.

pmid-8097468.summary_ja: 性腺および性腺外の胚細胞腫瘍を対象に、分子細胞遺伝学的解析を行った。i(12p)は精巣胚細胞腫瘍に特徴的であるが、i(12p)陰性例を含むすべての腫瘍で12p異常が認められた。過剰な12p配列はすべて片親性由来であり、胚細胞腫瘍の発生に共通の機序が関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-8097468.summary_en: Molecular cytogenetic analysis of gonadal and extragonadal germ cell tumours examined chromosome 12p abnormalities. The i(12p) anomaly is typical of testicular GCTs, but all tumours studied, including i(12p)-negative cases, showed 12p abnormalities causing overrepresentation of short-arm sequences. These supernumerary 12p sequences were of uniparental origin, suggesting a shared mechanism in GCT development.

pmid-8099460.summary_ja: ヌードマウスの腹腔内に異種移植したヒト奇形癌細胞から、胚様体様構造物が形成された。種特異的なin situハイブリダイゼーションにより、中心部はヒト腫瘍細胞、外層はマウス細胞であることを示した。胚様体の定義を満たさないため、キメラスフェロイドと命名された。
pmid-8099460.summary_en: Human teratocarcinoma cells were xenografted intraperitoneally into nude mice, forming embryoid body-like structures. In situ hybridization with species-specific probes showed human tumor cells centrally and mouse cells forming an outer layer. The authors term these bispecies structures chimeric spheroids, which do not meet the definition of embryoid bodies.

pmid-8100442.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍におけるP糖タンパク（Pgp）とGSTP1-1の発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。化学療法抵抗性の強い非セミノーマ性腫瘍では両者の発現が多く見られた。ウェスタンブロットでは、セミノーマは奇形腫よりもGSTP1-1が少なかった。これらが精巣がんの薬剤耐性に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-8100442.summary_en: Immunohistochemistry compared P-glycoprotein and GSTP1-1 expression in testicular germ cell tumours. Non-seminomatous tumours, which are more chemoresistant, frequently expressed both proteins. Western blotting showed lower GSTP1-1 in seminoma than in teratoma. The authors suggest these proteins may contribute to drug resistance in testicular cancer.

pmid-8101690.summary_ja: 精巣固定術の14年後に左精巣腫瘍を発症した21歳男性の症例である。胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、絨毛癌の混合型で、PEB化学療法後に腫瘍マーカーは正常化した。後腹膜リンパ節郭清では胎児性癌のみが認められ、10か月のフォローアップで再発はなかった。
pmid-8101690.summary_en: A 21-year-old man developed a left testicular tumour 14 years after bilateral orchiopexy. Imaging showed inguinal and para-aortic lymph node metastases, and the tumour was a mixture of embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumour and choriocarcinoma. After PEB chemotherapy, tumour markers normalised. Retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy showed only embryonal carcinoma, and no recurrence was seen at ten months of follow-up.

pmid-8102616.summary_ja: 自然流産、部分胞状奇胎、完全胞状奇胎、絨毛癌の計125例の絨毛組織におけるPCNAの発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。絨毛癌ではPCNA指数が有意に高く、胞状奇胎は流産と区別できなかった。PCNA指数は、奇胎妊娠から持続性妊娠性絨毛性疾患への進展予測には有用でないと結論された。
pmid-8102616.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined proliferating cell nuclear antigen (PCNA) in 125 trophoblastic tissues, including spontaneous abortions, partial and complete hydatidiform moles, and choriocarcinomas. Choriocarcinomas showed significantly higher PCNA indices than the other groups, while moles could not be distinguished from abortions. PCNA indices did not predict progression of molar pregnancy to persistent gestational trophoblastic disease, so the authors concluded that PCNA has limited value for predicting progression.

pmid-8104387.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍28例を対象に、PCNAの免疫染色とAgNOR染色を行った。PCNA陽性率とAgNOR数は組織型により異なり、絨毛癌で最も高値だった。純粋セミノーマでは病期II〜III群が病期I群より高値を示したが有意差はなかった。両指標には有意な相関があり、精巣腫瘍の増殖活性の指標として有用と結論された。
pmid-8104387.summary_en: This study applied PCNA immunostaining and argyrophilic nucleolar organizer region (AgNOR) staining to 28 testicular tumors. PCNA positivity and AgNOR counts varied by histology, highest in choriocarcinomas, and were also measured in seminomas, embryonal carcinomas, teratomas, and yolk sac tumors. In pure seminomas, stage II to III tumors showed higher values than stage I, though not significantly. PCNA positivity correlated significantly with AgNOR number, suggesting both are useful markers of proliferative activity in testicular tumors.

pmid-8108292.summary_ja: 生後2か月の男児に発生した巨大な肝絨毛癌の症例報告である。治療開始前に腫瘍からの出血により死亡した。乳児期の原発性または転移性絨毛癌の既報20例がレビューされている。胎盤は組織学的に検査されておらず、肝原発か胎盤由来の潜在性絨毛癌からの転移かは不明とされた。剖検では肺にも結節状の転移が確認された。
pmid-8108292.summary_en: This report describes a 2-month-old boy with a huge choriocarcinoma of the liver who died of tumor hemorrhage before treatment. The authors review the 20 previously reported cases of primary or metastatic choriocarcinoma in infancy. The placenta had not been examined histologically, so the origin remains unclear: either a primary liver tumor or a metastasis from an occult placental choriocarcinoma. Autopsy also showed nodular lung metastases.

pmid-8110488.summary_ja: 播種性胚細胞腫瘍の25例で、大量化学療法（シスプラチンとエトポシド）に伴う感染症を検討した。90治療サイクルのうち61サイクル（68%）で発熱と白血球減少がみられた。発熱エピソードの54%で微生物学的原因が特定された。菌血症は12例の14エピソードで認められ、その57%がグラム陽性好気性菌であった。
pmid-8110488.summary_en: This study investigated infections in 25 patients with disseminated germ cell tumors treated with high-dose cisplatin and etoposide, which caused severe myelosuppression. Of 90 treatment cycles, 61 (68%) had fever and leukopenia. A microbiological cause was identified in 54% of febrile episodes. Bacteremia occurred in 14 episodes in 12 patients, and gram-positive aerobic bacteria accounted for 57% of those. The study characterized bacterial, viral, and fungal infections in this high-risk group.

pmid-8110490.summary_ja: 進行胚細胞腫瘍77例に対し、GM-CSFを併用したシスプラチン・エトポシド・イホスファミド(PEI)療法を段階的に用量増量した第I/II相試験。最大耐用量は3週ごとの4コースで、完全寛解は65%、全生存期間(全生存率)は80%。用量制限毒性は粘膜炎、腸炎、血小板減少で、GM-CSFによる用量強度の増加は限定的であった。
pmid-8110490.summary_en: In this phase I/II study, 77 patients with advanced germ cell tumours received a stepwise dose-escalated regimen of cisplatin, etoposide and ifosfamide (PEI) with GM-CSF support. The maximally tolerated dose was reached at P 30 mg/m2, E 200 mg/m2 and I 1.6 g/m2 for 5 days every 21 days, for four cycles. Sixty-five percent achieved complete remission and 12% achieved marker normalisation with unresectable residual disease. Median follow-up was 27 months, with 80% overall survival. Dose-limiting toxicities were mucositis, enteritis and thrombocytopenia.

pmid-8112657.summary_ja: 甲状腺濾胞癌に類似した広範な転移を伴う悪性ストルマカルチノイドの1例報告。通常は良性の経過をたどる稀な卵巣腫瘍で、カルチノイド成分の転移を伴う悪性例は文献上1例のみである。臨床、組織、免疫組織化学的所見を示し、卵巣甲状腺腫との関係を考察している。
pmid-8112657.summary_en: A malignant strumal carcinoid of the ovary is reported, with widespread metastases resembling a well-differentiated thyroid follicular carcinoma. Strumal carcinoid is a rare ovarian tumour that usually behaves benignly, and only one previous malignant case with metastasis of the carcinoid component has been documented. The authors describe clinical, histological and immunohistochemical findings and discuss its relationship to struma ovarii.

pmid-8122181.summary_ja: 1968～1990年に治療した未分化セミノーマ10例と精母細胞性セミノーマ7例の後方視的解析。全例が病期Iで、精巣摘除術後に16例が放射線療法を受けた。平均98か月の追跡で15例が無病生存中であった。病期I非純粋型セミノーマの治療は組織学的分化度ではなく進展範囲に基づくべきと提案している。
pmid-8122181.summary_en: This retrospective analysis reviewed 10 patients with anaplastic seminoma and 7 with spermatocytic seminoma treated at a single centre between 1968 and 1990. All had stage I disease after orchiectomy. Sixteen received adjuvant radiotherapy. At a mean follow-up of 98 months, 15 patients were alive without evidence of disease. The authors suggest that stage I non-pure seminoma management should depend on disease extent rather than histological differentiation, and call for randomised trials of surveillance.

pmid-8135674.summary_ja: 1965～1988年に絨毛性疾患で治療された542例の検討。269例が妊孕性を温存し、198例が治療後に妊娠した。児の発育と精神神経発達は概ね正常で、絨毛性疾患に対する化学療法の安全性を示すとしている。侵入奇胎と絨毛癌が対象である。
pmid-8135674.summary_en: This study of 542 patients treated for trophoblastic disease from 1965 to 1988 found that 269 preserved fertility, including 240 with invasive mole and 29 with choriocarcinoma. Of these, 198 conceived after treatment, with 74.5% term live births. Four malformations (1.32%) were found. Growth and psychoneurological development of children followed to age 7 showed no marked abnormalities, supporting the safety of chemotherapy for trophoblastic disease.

pmid-8135909.summary_ja: 精巣の奇形癌および胎児性癌に由来する肺の転移性成熟奇形腫の7症例を報告している。原発腫瘍には胎児性癌に加え未熟奇形腫の成分を伴うものもあり、肺転移は精巣摘除術時またはその数か月から数年後に出現した。全例が開胸術と結節切除の前に化学療法または放射線療法を受けた。多くはフォローアップ中に病変のない状態を保ったが、1例は敗血症により死亡したとみられる。著者らはこの異例の転移様式について考察している。
pmid-8135909.summary_en: This report describes seven cases of metastatic mature teratoma in the lung arising from testicular teratocarcinoma and embryonal carcinoma. The primary tumors contained embryonal carcinoma with mature and immature teratoma components, and pulmonary metastases appeared at orchiectomy or months to years afterward. All patients received chemotherapy or radiation therapy before thoracotomy and resection of the nodules. Most remained free of disease at follow-up, although one patient died, apparently of sepsis. The authors discuss this unusual metastatic pattern.

pmid-8139215.summary_ja: 子宮底部から発生し骨盤腔へ進展した、性腺外の未熟奇形腫の稀な症例報告である。三胚葉由来の成分と未熟な神経上皮、軟骨、横紋筋、肝組織を認め、組織学的にgrade 3と分類された。単純子宮全摘術の後にVAC併用化学療法を2コース施行し、術後5年まで再発はみられなかった。
pmid-8139215.summary_en: A rare case of extragonadal immature teratoma arising primarily in the uterus is described. The tumor grew from the uterine fundus into the pelvic cavity and contained ectodermal, mesodermal, and endodermal components, with immature neuroepithelium, cartilage, striated muscle, and hepatic tissue. It was histologically classified as grade 3. Treatment consisted of total hysterectomy followed by two courses of VAC combination chemotherapy. The patient had no evidence of recurrence at five years after surgery.

pmid-8143614.summary_ja: ノルウェーの精巣がん患者17例の腫瘍と血液DNAについて、K-rasおよびN-rasの点突然変異を解析した。セミノーマの2例(病期I、II)にK-ras codon 12の変異を認めたが、N-rasや白血球DNAの変異はなかった。ras遺伝子活性化の役割を明らかにするには、より大規模な検討が必要とされた。
pmid-8143614.summary_en: This study examined K-ras-2 and N-ras point mutations in tumor and blood DNA from 17 Norwegian testicular cancer patients. Two K-ras codon 12 mutations were found in two seminoma tumors, at stage I and stage II, while no N-ras mutations or white blood cell mutations were detected. The authors state that a larger sample is needed to clarify the role of ras activation in testicular cancer.

pmid-8144861.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞においてヒドロキシウレアがヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)のα鎖遺伝子を誘導し、c-mycを抑制する機序を検討した。cAMP/プロテインキナーゼA経路の阻害剤3種はいずれもhCG α誘導を抑制せず、c-myc抑制も回復させなかった。ヒドロキシウレアはPKA経路とは独立に遺伝子発現を促進すると結論された。
pmid-8144861.summary_en: This study examined how hydroxyurea induces hCG alpha gene expression and suppresses c-myc in choriocarcinoma cells. Three inhibitors of the cAMP/protein kinase A pathway failed to block hCG alpha induction. Blocking this pathway also did not reverse c-myc suppression. The authors conclude that hydroxyurea stimulates gene expression independently of protein kinase A, and that c-myc suppression alone is insufficient to induce hCG alpha.

pmid-8150905.summary_ja: 原発性不妊の36歳女性に生じた、卵巣甲状腺腫由来の腹膜播種性甲状腺組織(転移性卵巣甲状腺腫症)の症例を報告した。体外受精を3周期施行後、卵巣の腫大した「卵胞」に対してホルモン治療が行われたが、実際には甲状腺濾胞であった。良性の甲状腺腫症は悪性腫瘍と混同すべきでないと強調されている。
pmid-8150905.summary_en: This report describes metastatic ovarian strumosis, a condition of peritoneal implants of mature thyroid tissue arising from struma ovarii, in a 36-year-old woman with primary infertility. After three in-vitro fertilization cycles with ovarian stimulation, she received six months of hormonal treatment for persistent enlarged ovarian follicles, which were later found to be thyroid follicles. The authors stress that benign strumosis should not be confused with malignancy, and they note that malignant struma ovarii is very rare.

pmid-8152873.summary_ja: 生後3か月の女児にみられた、肝・肺・腋窩リンパ節への転移性絨毛癌の症例を報告した。乳児期の転移性絨毛癌は稀で、これまでの報告は15例とされる。CTおよびカラードプラ・デュプレックス超音波検査で、大きな血管腔を有する病変が確認された。
pmid-8152873.summary_en: This report describes metastatic choriocarcinoma in a 3-month-old female infant with hepatic, pulmonary, and axillary lymph node metastases. The authors note that metastatic choriocarcinoma is unusual in infancy, with only about fifteen cases previously reported, and that it is thought to arise from placental metastases. Computed tomography and sonography with color and duplex Doppler showed several lesions with large vascular channels.

pmid-8153729.summary_ja: 後縦隔に生じた先天性縦隔奇形腫の症例報告である。縦隔奇形腫は大半が前縦隔に生じるため、本例は稀な部位である。生後41日の女児で、生後6日から進行性黄疸と敗血症を認めた。超音波検査とコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で多房性の右後縦隔腫瘤が確認され、細針吸引生検で奇形腫と診断された。
pmid-8153729.summary_en: This case report describes a 41-day-old girl with a posterior mediastinal teratoma, an unusual location since most mediastinal teratomas are anterior. She presented at six days of age with progressive jaundice and septicemia. Chest radiography revealed a right mediastinal mass, and ultrasound and CT confirmed a multiloculated lesion in the right posterior mediastinum. Fine needle aspiration biopsy confirmed teratoma.

pmid-8157326.summary_ja: インドの単一施設で1980年から1990年に診断された性腺奇形腫206例の後方視的病理学的検討である。内訳は卵巣182例、精巣24例。卵巣病変の大半は類皮嚢腫27例を含む嚢胞性成熟奇形腫で、精巣病変の大半は充実嚢胞性かつ未熟型であった。発症のピークは両部位とも第3の年代であった。本研究は卵巣と精巣の奇形腫の組織学的差異を示している。
pmid-8157326.summary_en: A retrospective pathology series of 206 gonadal teratomas diagnosed at a single Indian institution from 1980 to 1990. 182 were ovarian and 24 testicular. Most ovarian lesions were cystic mature teratomas, including 27 dermoid cysts, while most testicular lesions were solid-cystic and immature. Peak incidence was in the third decade of life for both sites. The study highlights histological differences between ovarian and testicular teratomas.

pmid-8159935.summary_ja: 同時性両側精巣セミノーマの1例。片側精巣摘除術に加え、対側腫瘍と所属リンパ節に放射線療法を行った。過去20年の文献では両側精巣摘除術と術後放射線療法の報告は14例のみである。選択された患者では精巣温存的な治療選択肢となりうるが、長期成績は未確立である。
pmid-8159935.summary_en: Case report of synchronous bilateral testicular seminoma managed with unilateral orchiectomy plus radiotherapy to the contralateral tumor and lymph nodes. The authors review the literature: only 14 similar cases treated with bilateral orchiectomy and adjuvant radiotherapy were reported over 20 years. This case suggests a testis-sparing approach with radiotherapy may be an option for selected patients, though long-term outcomes remain to be established.

pmid-8177827.summary_ja: 妊娠17〜19週の連続超音波検査で急速に増大した胎児頸部奇形腫の出生前症例。急速な増大は攻撃的な腫瘍を示唆し、両親の妊娠中絶の決断につながった。病理組織学的にgrade 3の未熟性が確認された。腫瘍サイズに伴う嚥下障害や気道閉塞のため周産期罹患率は高い。
pmid-8177827.summary_en: Prenatal case report of a rapidly growing fetal cervical teratoma detected by serial mid-trimester sonography between 17 and 19 weeks gestation. The rapid early growth indicated an aggressive tumor, which guided the parents' decision to terminate the pregnancy. Histopathology showed grade 3 immaturity. The authors note malignant transformation is rare, but perinatal morbidity is high because tumor size can impair swallowing and cause airway obstruction.

pmid-8179552.summary_ja: Endopouchを用いて腹腔鏡下に卵巣摘出術を行った卵巣類皮嚢腫の6例。内容物の漏出を防ぎ、創の拡大も不要であった。手術時間は60〜90分。全例48時間以内に退院し、疼痛は軽度で合併症はなかった。良性卵巣奇形腫に対する安全な術式と考えられる。
pmid-8179552.summary_en: Report of six patients with ovarian dermoid cysts treated with laparoscopic oophorectomy using an Endopouch retrieval bag. The pouch prevented spillage and avoided the need to enlarge incisions. Operations lasted 60 to 90 minutes. All patients were discharged within 48 hours with minimal pain and no complications, supporting laparoscopic removal as a safe approach for benign ovarian teratomas.

pmid-8179558.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎後に持続した妊娠性絨毛性疾患の3例を、経膣超音波検査とカラードップラー法で評価した。血流増加を伴う微小な筋層内病変を検出し、単剤化学療法後にβ-hCG低下とともに縮小した。1例では付随的に見つかった付属器腫瘤が成熟卵巣奇形腫と判明した。診断と治療モニタリングに有用である。
pmid-8179558.summary_en: Three patients with persistent gestational trophoblastic disease after a molar pregnancy were evaluated with high-resolution transvaginal sonography and colour Doppler, which detected small myometrial lesions with increased flow. Single-agent chemotherapy was given, and the lesions shrank as beta-hCG fell after an initial lag. In one patient, an incidental adnexal mass proved to be a mature ovarian teratoma. The study supports these imaging tools for diagnosis and monitoring.

pmid-8200366.summary_ja: 1977年から1989年にワルシャワの腫瘍学研究所で治療を受けた妊娠性絨毛性疾患178例の後方視的検討である。34例で手術と化学療法が併用され、非転移性疾患よりも転移性疾患で多く用いられた。手術の主な適応は化学抵抗性であった。併用療法を受けた非転移性および予後良好な転移性の患者は全員治癒した。高リスクの播種性疾患では手術の有益性は限定的である。
pmid-8200366.summary_en: Retrospective review of 178 gestational trophoblastic disease patients treated at a Warsaw cancer institute from 1977 to 1989. Combined surgery and chemotherapy was used in 34 patients, more often in metastatic disease than non-metastatic disease. Chemoresistance was the main indication for surgery. All non-metastatic and good-prognosis metastatic patients receiving combined therapy were cured, supporting adjuvant surgery in these groups. Surgical benefit is limited in high-risk disseminated disease.

pmid-8214253.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生頻度上昇や、停留精巣などの危険因子を総説しています。前駆病変である精細管内胚細胞腫瘍から浸潤性腫瘍に至る過程を整理し、セミノーマ、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、絨毛癌、成熟奇形腫の組織像を解説しています。臨床病期I非セミノーマに対する経過観察の適否を、胎児性癌の割合や脈管侵襲から論じています。
pmid-8214253.summary_en: This review covers testicular germ cell neoplasia, including its rising incidence and risk factors such as cryptorchidism and prior tumor history. It describes intratubular germ cell neoplasia as the common precursor, seminoma as its invasive derivative, and the histologic features of embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, choriocarcinoma, and mature teratoma. It also discusses whether surveillance is appropriate for clinical stage I nonseminomatous tumors, depending on embryonal carcinoma proportion and lymphovascular invasion.

pmid-8214257.summary_ja: 性分化疾患のある小児・思春期患者102例の精巣を検討し、未分類型の精細管内胚細胞腫瘍(IGCN)が6%に認められたと報告しています。性腺異形成での頻度が高く、本研究の6例では浸潤性胚細胞腫瘍はみられませんでした。思春期の3例では性腺芽細胞腫を伴い、文献例では浸潤性腫瘍の併存例もみられました。
pmid-8214257.summary_en: This study reviewed 102 children and adolescents with intersex states and found intratubular germ cell neoplasia unclassified in 6% of testes. IGCN was most common in gonadal dysgenesis, and no invasive germ cell tumor was present in the six cases here. Atypical germ cells stained for placental alkaline phosphatase, and three pubertal cases had associated gonadoblastoma. A literature review of 36 cases gave a median age of 13 years and noted concomitant invasive tumors in some dysgenesis and androgen insensitivity cases.

pmid-8214265.summary_ja: 44歳の臨床的に甲状腺機能正常な女性で、偶発的に見つかった卵管内の0.2cmの甲状腺組織のみからなる良性奇形腫(卵管甲状腺腫)を報告しています。同側卵巣には0.1cmの卵巣甲状腺腫がみられ、卵管と卵巣の両方に甲状腺組織が併存した初の症例です。胚細胞が生殖隆起への移動経路で停滞して生じたと考察しています。
pmid-8214265.summary_en: The authors report a 44-year-old clinically euthyroid woman with an incidental 0.2 cm struma salpingis, a benign teratoma composed entirely of thyroid tissue in the fallopian tube. The ipsilateral ovary contained a 0.1 cm struma ovarii, and the contralateral ovary had a 7.0 cm mucinous cystadenoma. This is described as the second report of struma salpingis and the first with concurrent thyroid tissue in both tube and ovary. The authors propose that it arises from germ cells arrested along the migratory path toward the genital crest.

pmid-8214501.summary_ja: 在胎30週で出生した新生児が、咽頭の大きな奇形腫による急性の呼吸道閉塞を呈した症例報告です。喉頭鏡で喉頭を確認できず、気管チューブが誤って食道へ盲目的に挿入されました。その結果、腫瘤が前方へ偏位して閉塞が解除されました。希少な性腺外奇形腫の気道管理が主題です。
pmid-8214501.summary_en: This case report describes a 30-week-gestation newborn who presented with acute respiratory obstruction from a large pharyngeal teratoma. Laryngoscopy could not visualize the larynx, and a tracheal tube was unintentionally passed blindly into the esophagus. This inadvertent placement relieved the obstruction by displacing the mass anteriorly. The focus is airway management in this rare extragonadal teratoma.

pmid-8216132.summary_ja: 骨盤内腫瘤の術前評価で、血清腫瘍マーカーCA 125の限界を論じた報告です。甲状腺組織からなる奇形腫の一型である良性卵巣甲状腺腫の2例で、CA 125が上昇していました。CA 125の上昇が必ずしも悪性を示すわけではないことを示しています。
pmid-8216132.summary_en: The report discusses limits of CA 125 when evaluating a pelvic mass. Two cases of benign struma ovarii, a teratoma subtype composed of thyroid tissue, showed elevated CA 125, indicating that a raised value may not reliably signal malignancy. The title highlights ascites as a related complicating factor in this setting.

pmid-8221556.summary_ja: 17か月の男児に生じた、肝臓の嚢胞性奇形腫と上皮性肝芽腫の合併例の報告です。画像検査では奇形腫が疑われましたが、血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)が著明に高値でした。完全切除後37か月時点で生存し、健康を保っています。未分化な肝前駆細胞からの分岐分化で生じたと考察されています。
pmid-8221556.summary_en: This case report describes a 17-month-old boy with a combined liver tumor consisting of a benign cystic teratoma adjoining an epithelial hepatoblastoma. Imaging suggested an intrahepatic teratoma, but serum alpha-fetoprotein was markedly elevated. Complete surgical resection was performed, and the child remained alive and well 37 months later. The authors propose that the tumor arose from divergent differentiation of a single uncommitted hepatic precursor cell. The report is notable because this combination had not previously been described.

pmid-8221570.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍33例におけるメタロチオネイン(MT)の発現を免疫組織化学で評価し、臨床経過と比較した研究です。セミノーマはMT染色が弱いか陰性でしたが、多くの非セミノーマは強く染色されました。進行期の非セミノーマほど染色が強い傾向がありました。MTがシスプラチン耐性に関与する可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-8221570.summary_en: This study examines metallothionein (MT) expression by immunohistochemistry in 33 primary testicular germ cell tumor specimens, correlated with clinical course. MT is considered a possible contributor to cisplatin resistance. Seminomas stained weakly or not at all regardless of stage, whereas most nonseminomas stained heavily, and more advanced nonseminomas tended to stain more strongly. The authors conclude that MT may play a role in chemoresistance in germ cell tumors and that further studies are warranted to clarify this relationship.

pmid-8222831.summary_ja: 妊娠中の24歳女性の肺結節に対し、胸部超音波検査とカラードプラ血流画像を用いて評価した症例報告です。多発する低エコー性の胸膜下結節が認められ、血流は豊富でした。超音波ガイド下穿刺吸引により、転移性肺絨毛癌と確定診断されました。
pmid-8222831.summary_en: This report describes chest ultrasound and color Doppler flow imaging of a pulmonary nodule in a 24-year-old pregnant woman presenting with dyspnea and hemoptysis. The ultrasonogram showed multiple hypoechoic subpleural nodules, which had high vascularity and high blood flow on color Doppler. Ultrasound-guided percutaneous needle aspiration confirmed metastatic pulmonary choriocarcinoma. The case highlights the value of ultrasonography and Doppler imaging in characterizing metastatic choriocarcinoma nodules in the lung before tissue diagnosis.

pmid-8223679.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の脂肪成分を評価するMR脂肪抑制法を、CTおよび病理所見と比較した研究である。8例で、SPIRおよびDixon法を用いた脂肪抑制MRは、CTと同様に嚢胞内の脂肪を正確に検出した(8/8)。卵巣腫瘍のMRIで脂肪が疑われる場合は、脂肪抑制シーケンスを追加すべきだと結論づけている。少数例による初期の画像診断研究である。
pmid-8223679.summary_en: This study evaluated MR fat suppression techniques (SPIR and Dixon sequences) for characterizing fat within ovarian mature cystic teratomas, comparing them with CT and pathology. In eight cases, MR fat suppression detected intracystic fat as accurately as CT (8/8). The authors conclude that fat-suppressed MR sequences should be performed when fat is suspected on standard MR imaging of ovarian tumors. The work is a small early imaging-comparison study focused on diagnosis of a common benign germ cell tumor.

pmid-8229571.summary_ja: 1979年から1990年に当院で治療した18歳未満の小児卵巣腫瘤91例を後方視的に検討した研究である。良性72例のうち奇形腫が最多で、悪性19例の大半は胚細胞腫瘍(14例)であった。症状では良悪性を区別できず、悪性例は年齢が高く腫瘤径が大きかった。超音波検査は受けた54例全例で診断的であった。小児卵巣腫瘤の臨床像を概観し、胚細胞腫瘍が主要な悪性群であることを示す。
pmid-8229571.summary_en: This retrospective review examined 91 pediatric patients under 18 treated for ovarian masses at one hospital from 1979 to 1990. Seventy-two had benign disease, most often teratomas, and 19 had malignant tumors, mainly germ cell tumors (14 cases). Symptoms could not distinguish benign from malignant lesions, though malignant cases were older and had larger masses. Ultrasound was diagnostic in all 54 patients who underwent it. The study provides a clinical overview of ovarian masses in children, with germ cell tumors as the major malignant subgroup.

pmid-8231062.summary_ja: 41歳女性の左卵巣良性嚢胞性奇形腫に発生したストルマ性カルチノイドの症例報告である。充実性腫瘤は甲状腺濾胞様構造を伴う索状カルチノイドで、Grimelius染色で銀親和性顆粒が確認された。甲状腺組織の証明により確定診断された。奇形腫由来の稀な卵巣腫瘍であり、単胚葉性奇形腫の一型として卵巣胚細胞腫瘍に分類される。
pmid-8231062.summary_en: This case report describes a 41-year-old woman with a strumal carcinoid arising within a benign cystic teratoma of the left ovary. The solid tumor was a trabecular carcinoid associated with thyroid follicle-like structures. Grimelius staining showed argyrophil granules in tumor cells. The diagnosis was confirmed by identifying thyroid tissue. The case highlights a rare teratoma-derived ovarian neoplasm, a monodermal teratoma that is classified among ovarian germ cell tumors.

pmid-8231978.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍は98%以上が悪性であるのに対し、卵巣胚細胞腫瘍は約97%が良性である差を、ゲノムインプリンティングで説明する仮説を提示した論文である。配偶子形成中に性別特異的に付くエピジェネティックな刻印が、父性由来の成長促進と母性由来の成長抑制のバランスを生むと論じる。実証研究ではなく理論的考察である。
pmid-8231978.summary_en: This hypothesis paper proposes that genomic imprinting explains why testicular germ cell tumors are malignant in over 98% of cases, while ovarian germ cell tumors are benign in about 97%. Sex-specific epigenetic imprints on paternal and maternal genomes during gametogenesis balance growth-promoting paternal effects with growth-limiting maternal effects. The authors argue that differences in normal imprinting patterns of male and female germ cells may account for the contrasting clinical behavior of gonadal germ cell tumors. It is a theoretical review rather than an empirical study.

pmid-8233302.summary_ja: プラチナ製剤既治療の予後不良な悪性腫瘍27例に、エトポシドとシクロホスファミドの固定用量に漸増カルボプラチンを組み合わせた大量化学療法(CARBOPEC)と自家骨髄移植を行った治療研究である。対象は胚細胞腫瘍15例と卵巣癌8例などであった。奏効率は55%、完全奏効率は45%で、主な毒性は消化管症状であった。治療抵抗性の胚細胞腫瘍患者の一部は無病生存した。
pmid-8233302.summary_en: This treatment study gave 27 patients with poor-prognosis, previously platinum-treated malignancies the CARBOPEC regimen, combining fixed-dose etoposide and cyclophosphamide with escalating carboplatin, followed by autologous bone marrow transplantation. Patients included 15 with germ cell tumors and 8 with ovarian carcinoma. The overall response rate was 55%, with complete response in 45%. Main toxicity was gastrointestinal, and several patients with refractory germ cell tumors remained disease-free. Five patients were alive without evidence of disease, supporting further evaluation of intensified therapy.

pmid-8235792.summary_ja: 妊娠歴のない46歳女性が貧血と肝腫瘤で受診し、転移性絨毛癌と診断された。化学療法を行ったものの転移は広範に進行し、患者は死亡した。育児可能年齢の女性の肝腫瘤では絨毛癌を鑑別診断に含めること、またCT・MRI・血管造影所見を相互に照合することの重要性が示された。
pmid-8235792.summary_en: A 46-year-old woman with no history of pregnancy presented with anemia and a liver mass, which was later diagnosed as metastatic choriocarcinoma. Despite chemotherapy, she developed widespread metastatic disease and died. The report emphasizes that choriocarcinoma should be included in the differential diagnosis of liver masses in women of childbearing age, and that correlating CT, MRI, and angiographic findings is important.

pmid-8236607.summary_ja: 34歳男性が、左精巣の混合型非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍と右精巣の莢膜細胞腫瘍という、組織型の異なる同時性両側精巣腫瘍を呈した。著者らは、これまでの同時性両側例はいずれも両側に胚細胞腫瘍を伴っており、胚細胞腫瘍と対側の非胚細胞腫瘍の同時発生は報告されていなかったと指摘している。
pmid-8236607.summary_en: A 34-year-old man presented with synchronous bilateral testicular tumors of different histologic types: a mixed non-seminomatous germ cell tumor of the left testis and a theca cell tumor of the right testis. The authors note that previous synchronous bilateral cases always involved germ cell tumors on both sides, so the simultaneous occurrence of a germ cell tumor and a contralateral non-germ cell tumor had not been reported before.

pmid-8236611.summary_ja: 臨床病期Aの非セミノーマ性精巣がん患者に対し、腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行した症例報告である。開腹手術は確定的な病期分類と高い治癒率をもたらすが合併症があるため、経過観察が選ばれることもある。腹腔鏡下手術は入院期間と回復時間を短縮し、合併症を減らしつつ開腹手術の利点を保てるとされる。
pmid-8236611.summary_en: This case report describes laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection performed in a patient with clinical stage A nonseminomatous testicular cancer. Open RPLND provides definitive staging and high cure rates but carries morbidity, so observation is chosen in some settings. The authors report that the laparoscopic approach shortens hospital stay and recovery time and reduces morbidity while retaining the staging benefits of the open procedure.

pmid-8240996.summary_ja: 予後良好な胚細胞腫瘍患者を、シスプラチン・エトポシド群（39例）とカルボプラチン・エトポシド群（23例）に分けて比較した。完全奏効率は両群とも87%で同等であったが、カルボプラチン群では再発率が高く（30%対9%）、無病生存者も少なかった。生存率に有意差はなく、著者らはカルボプラチン・エトポシド併用療法がシスプラチン併用療法より劣ると結論した。
pmid-8240996.summary_en: Good-risk germ cell tumor patients were treated with induction cisplatin-etoposide (39 patients) or carboplatin-etoposide (23 patients). Complete response rates were similar (87% in each group). The carboplatin-etoposide group had a higher relapse rate (30% vs 9%) and fewer patients remained NED. Survival did not differ significantly, but the authors conclude that carboplatin-etoposide is inferior to cisplatin-etoposide.

pmid-8242553.summary_ja: 精巣の混合型胚細胞腫瘍では、主要成分である神経芽細胞腫が臨床経過を規定していた。免疫組織化学で神経特異エノラーゼ陽性、電子顕微鏡で微小管と濃染顆粒、フローサイトメトリーで過四倍体の異数性集団が示された。腫瘍は2.5年のフォローアップ中、神経芽細胞腫向けの化学療法に反応した。著者らは、神経芽細胞腫成分の大きい混合型胚細胞腫瘍には速やかかつ積極的な化学療法を推奨している。
pmid-8242553.summary_en: A mixed germ cell tumor of the testis contained a prominent neuroblastoma component that dictated the clinical course. Immunohistochemistry showed neuron-specific enolase positivity, electron microscopy showed microtubules and dense-core granules, and flow cytometry showed a hypertetraploid aneuploid population. The tumor responded to neuroblastoma-directed chemotherapy during 2.5 years of follow-up. The authors recommend prompt and aggressive chemotherapy for mixed germ cell tumors with a large neuroblastoma component.

pmid-8242558.summary_ja: 増殖因子阻害薬スラミンは、臨床到達可能濃度でヒト奇形癌細胞株2種の増殖を抑制した。シスプラチン抵抗性の胚細胞腫瘍患者14例を対象とした第II相試験では、完全奏効・部分奏効は得られなかった。1例では後腹膜腫瘤が変化しないままαフェトプロテイン(AFP)が長期にわたり低下した。著者らは有意な抗腫瘍効果は示されなかったと結論し、他の薬剤の検討を提案した。
pmid-8242558.summary_en: Suramin, a growth-factor inhibitor, suppressed growth of two human teratocarcinoma cell lines in vitro at clinically attainable plasma concentrations. A phase II trial in 14 cisplatin-refractory germ cell tumor patients produced no complete or partial responses. One patient had a prolonged decline in alpha-fetoprotein with an unchanged retroperitoneal mass. The authors conclude that suramin lacked significant antitumor activity and suggest testing other agents.

pmid-8242603.summary_ja: 多色FISH法を用い、特徴的なi(12p)を欠く精巣胚細胞腫瘍11例を解析した。全例に12p異常が認められ、短腕配列の過剰表現が見られた。1例ではクローン進化の所見も得られた。12p異常はi(12p)陰性腫瘍に共通してみられ、i(12p)と同様に腫瘍発生に寄与する可能性があると結論された。
pmid-8242603.summary_en: Using multicolor FISH, the authors examined 11 testicular germ cell tumors lacking the characteristic i(12p) chromosome. All tumors showed chromosome 12p abnormalities with overrepresentation of short-arm sequences, and one tumor showed evidence of clonal evolution. The authors conclude that 12p abnormalities are common in i(12p)-negative tumors and may contribute to tumor development in a manner analogous to i(12p).

pmid-8242627.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株Teraとそのシスプラチン耐性株Tera-CPを比較した。Tera-CPはグルタチオン量とGST活性が高く、白金-DNA結合は低下していた。異種移植腫瘍でもTera-CPは2.8倍耐性であった。グルタチオン/GST解毒系が重要な耐性機序と考えられ、耐性は分化の増加を伴わずに獲得された。
pmid-8242627.summary_en: Using the embryonal carcinoma line Tera and its cisplatin-resistant subline Tera-CP, the authors found that Tera-CP had higher glutathione levels and GST activity and lower platinum-DNA binding. Xenograft tumors showed the same pattern, with Tera-CP tumors 2.8-fold more resistant to cisplatin. The glutathione/GST detoxification system is proposed as an important resistance mechanism, and resistance was induced without increased differentiation.

pmid-8248844.summary_ja: 1968〜1988年に放射線療法を受けた病期I精巣セミノーマ患者64例を対象に、第二原発がんのリスクを検討した。7例(11%)に計8つの二次がんが発生し、20年累積リスクは8.9%であった。照射野内外いずれにも発生しており、治癒した早期セミノーマ患者では低いが有意な固形がんリスクがあると結論づけている。
pmid-8248844.summary_en: This study of 64 patients with stage I testicular seminoma treated with radiotherapy at a single Israeli center from 1968 to 1988 assessed the risk of second primary cancer. Seven patients (11%) developed eight second cancers. Cumulative risk was 2.5%, 5.1%, and 8.9% at 10, 15, and 20 years. Some cancers arose within the irradiated field and others outside it. The authors conclude there is a low but significant risk of solid second cancers in cured early-stage seminoma patients and recommend assessing risk in non-irradiated patients during future surveillance.

pmid-8250292.summary_ja: 男性不妊(乏精子症)を契機に発見されたヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)産生性精巣セミノーマの1例である。高β-hCGと高エストラジオールを示し、免疫染色で異所性hCG産生が確認された。hCG誘導性のライディッヒ細胞過形成が高エストラジオール血症の原因と考えられ、腫瘍摘出後にホルモン値と精巣機能は回復した。
pmid-8250292.summary_en: The authors report a case of hCG-secreting testicular seminoma presenting as male infertility with oligozoospermia. No palpable mass was found; diagnosis rested on hormonal profiling and testicular ultrasound. Serum beta-hCG and 17 beta-estradiol were elevated, with low LH and FSH and normal testosterone. Immunohistochemistry confirmed ectopic hCG production. Hyperestradiolemia was thought to result from hCG-induced Leydig cell hyperplasia via a paracrine mechanism. After tumor removal, sex steroid levels fell and normal testicular function recovered.

pmid-8252490.summary_ja: 乳児期に良性仙尾部奇形腫の手術を受けた45例を成人期まで追跡した。3例に21〜43年後の再発を認め、そのうち1例は粘液性腺がんに悪性化していた。再発は成人期にも起こりうるため、小児期を超えたフォローアップと、再発時の悪性腫瘍の疑いが必要であると結論している。
pmid-8252490.summary_en: The authors followed 45 patients aged 4 to 43 years who had undergone surgery in infancy for benign sacrococcygeal teratoma, to detect late recurrence. Three adults had persistent or recurrent tumors diagnosed 21 to 43 years after initial treatment. Two recurrences were benign, while one was a mucinous adenocarcinoma likely arising from a benign epithelial component, in a patient whose coccyx had not been removed. The authors recommend long-term follow-up beyond infancy and suspicion of malignancy when recurrence is found.

pmid-8253549.summary_ja: 完全胞状奇胎の摘除後に子宮内膜または子宮筋層で中間型トロホブラストの結節が増殖した7例を報告している。患者は性器出血またはヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の軽度上昇で受診した。治療は子宮摘出術、子宮内膜搔爬術、化学療法などであり、1例は絨毛癌を合併していた。1例はフォローアップ中に脱落した。著者らは、これらの結節は胞状奇胎後トロホブラスト性疾患の軽症型を表すと考えている。
pmid-8253549.summary_en: This report describes seven patients who developed multiple nodules of intermediate trophoblast in the endometrium or myometrium after a complete hydatidiform mole was removed. Patients presented with vaginal bleeding or mildly elevated hCG. Treatments included hysterectomy, curettage, and chemotherapy, and one patient also had choriocarcinoma. One patient was lost to follow-up. The authors suggest these nodules represent a mild form of postmolar trophoblastic disease.

pmid-8253550.summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫54例を検討した病理組織学的研究である。増殖性卵巣甲状腺腫41例では悪性所見は確認されず、再発や転移もなかった。悪性卵巣甲状腺腫13例は甲状腺癌の典型的所見を示し、1例で腹膜病変が持続した。悪性と診断する基準を厳格化すべきと提言している。
pmid-8253550.summary_en: This clinicopathologic study reviews 54 struma ovarii cases, divided into 41 proliferative and 13 malignant lesions. Proliferative struma showed densely packed follicles or papillary structures but no unequivocal malignant features, and none developed metastases or recurrence. Malignant struma ovarii displayed classic thyroid carcinoma features, and one patient had persistent peritoneal disease without distant metastases. The authors propose strict criteria for diagnosing malignancy, which would make the diagnosis less frequent.

pmid-8255043.summary_ja: 臨床病期I精巣腫瘍31例を精巣摘除術のみの後に監視療法で管理した成績である。7例(22.5%)が再発し、多くは後腹膜リンパ節で、シスプラチンを用いた化学療法で救済された。後腹膜リンパ節に軽微な異常所見がある症例で再発率が高く、慎重な病期分類と厳密なフォローアップのもとで監視療法は妥当と結論している。
pmid-8255043.summary_en: This study from the Cancer Institute Hospital examined 31 patients with clinical stage I testicular tumors managed by surveillance after orchiectomy alone (22 seminoma, 9 NSGCT). Relapse occurred in 7 patients (22.5%), mostly in retroperitoneal lymph nodes, and all relapsed patients were salvaged with cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Patients with minimal retroperitoneal abnormalities had a higher relapse rate, suggesting surveillance may be inadequate for them. The authors concluded surveillance is valid with careful staging and intensive follow-up.

pmid-8257337.summary_ja: 1981〜1990年に、傍大動脈および/または骨盤リンパ節へ高エネルギー放射線を照射した精巣セミノーマ77例の成績である。10年実測生存率は96.1%で、晩期消化管合併症は9.1%(主に消化性潰瘍)であった。年齢・病期・線量は生存率や晩期合併症に有意な影響を与えなかった。監視療法との関連から補助療法の判断材料を提示している。
pmid-8257337.summary_en: This Australian study reviews 77 patients with stage I or non-bulky stage II testicular seminoma treated with megavoltage radiotherapy to para-aortic and/or pelvic nodes from 1981 to 1990. The 10-year actuarial survival was 96.1%, and late gastrointestinal complications occurred in 9.1%, mainly peptic ulceration. Acute gastrointestinal effects occurred in 90.9% during treatment. Age, stage, and radiation dose did not significantly affect survival or late complications. The findings are discussed relative to surveillance policy to inform decisions about adjuvant treatment.

pmid-8258729.summary_ja: 1983年以降に絨毛癌28例にMOA、MEA、FAの3種の併用化学療法を施行した成績である。多くが寛解に至ったが、再発例も認められた。全生存期間(全生存率)は64%から90%へ向上した。MEAまたはFAでは、全化学療法コースの5〜7%で重度の骨髄抑制が生じた。
pmid-8258729.summary_en: This Japanese study reviews 28 patients with choriocarcinoma treated with MOA, MEA, or FA combination chemotherapy since 1983. Most patients achieved remission, but some relapsed, including 2 of 6 with MOA, 2 of 19 remitters with MEA, and 1 of 6 with FA. Overall survival improved from 64% to 90% after introducing these regimens. Three patients died of disease, and serious myelosuppression occurred in 5-7% of MEA or FA courses.

pmid-8260249.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍のセミノーマ22例と奇形腫10例を対象に、腫瘍浸潤T細胞とMHC抗原発現を免疫組織化学で検討した。両組織型ではほぼ全例でMHCクラスI・IIが欠失していたが、多数の活性化T細胞が浸潤していた。IL-2培養で多くの腫瘍からIL-2依存性T細胞を得た。この矛盾は未解明であり、さらなる検討が必要とされている。
pmid-8260249.summary_en: This study examined immune infiltration in 22 seminoma and 10 teratoma specimens from testicular tumours. Nearly all tumours completely lacked MHC class I and II antigens, yet contained many tumour-infiltrating T lymphocytes, most expressing activation markers. IL-2 culture yielded IL-2-dependent T cells from most tumours. Testis cell lines often lacked class I antigens, and IFN-gamma failed to induce expression. The authors describe this immunological paradox as unexplained and call for further investigation.

pmid-8262299.summary_ja: 正常妊娠、胞状奇胎、絨毛癌の尿中で免疫抑制性30kDa蛋白をラジオイムノアッセイで測定した研究である。絨毛癌では尿中30kDa蛋白/ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)比が胞状奇胎や正常妊娠より有意に高かった。本蛋白は宿主の免疫抑制を介して栄養膜細胞の増殖と浸潤に関与し、絨毛癌での上昇は悪性転化を反映する可能性があると考察している。
pmid-8262299.summary_en: This study measured a 30-kDa immunosuppressive protein in urine by radioimmunoassay in normal pregnancy, hydatidiform mole, and choriocarcinoma. The protein was found in nearly all urine samples and was highest in the first and second trimesters. Its ratio to hCG was markedly elevated in choriocarcinoma compared with hydatidiform mole and normal pregnancy. The authors propose that the protein promotes trophoblast proliferation and invasion by suppressing host immunity, and that rising levels in choriocarcinoma may reflect malignant transformation.

pmid-8262659.summary_ja: 胎仔生殖隆起を成熟マウス精巣に移植し、自然発生腫瘍の有無が異なる2系統で実験的胚細胞腫瘍の初期病変を形態学的に解析した。マウスの上皮内癌はヒトの上皮内癌と著しく異なっていた。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生はヒトとマウスで相違があることが示された。
pmid-8262659.summary_en: Using genital ridge grafting from 12- or 13-day fetuses into adult testes, the authors induced germ cell tumours in two mouse strains, one with and one without spontaneous tumours. Morphological analysis of early lesions showed that experimentally induced carcinoma-in-situ differs considerably from the human counterpart. The findings indicate that testicular germ cell tumour development differs between mice and humans, which limits the mouse model's relevance for human carcinoma-in-situ biology.

pmid-8263346.summary_ja: 1971〜1990年に診断された充実性卵巣腫瘍117例を検討し、胚細胞腫瘍は全体の22.2%を占め上皮性腫瘍に次ぐ頻度であった。未熟奇形腫は若年者に多く、ディスジャーミノーマは6.8%、未熟奇形腫1例で腹膜神経膠腫症を認めた。胚細胞腫瘍の平均年齢は他の群より低かった。
pmid-8263346.summary_en: This study of 117 solid ovarian tumours diagnosed from 1971 to 1990 found that germ cell tumours accounted for 22.2%, the second most common group after epithelial tumours. Immature teratoma was seen in young patients, dysgerminoma made up 6.8% of cases, and one immature teratoma showed gliomatosis peritonei. Most tumours were malignant (83.8%). The average age of germ cell tumour patients was notably lower than in other groups. The paper discusses diagnostic difficulties and prognostic factors.

pmid-8266192.summary_ja: 33歳の原発性不妊症の女性に発生した卵管の良性奇形腫の症例です。シンガポールで報告された初めての症例とされています。性腺外に生じる極めてまれな胚細胞腫瘍の部位であり、臨床的・病理学的特徴を考察しています。良性であっても、不妊を主訴とする女性では、この特異な発生部位を認識することが正確な診断と治療方針の決定に重要であると述べられています。
pmid-8266192.summary_en: This case report describes a 33-year-old woman with primary subfertility who was found to have a benign teratoma of the fallopian tube. It is presented as the first such case reported in Singapore. The authors discuss the clinical and pathological features of benign teratoma arising in the fallopian tube, an extragonadal and very rare site for germ cell tumors. Although the tumor is benign, recognizing this unusual location is important for accurate diagnosis and management in women presenting with infertility.

pmid-8267394.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ21例と正常精巣組織9例について、ホルマリン固定パラフィン包埋標本を用いて核DNA含量とDNAヒストグラム型を解析した研究です。正常精巣では半数体、二倍体、四倍体に対応する3つの細胞集団が認められましたが、多くのセミノーマでは単一型のヒストグラムを示しました。DNAヒストグラムが予後予測因子やグレーディング指標となる可能性が示唆されていますが、さらなる検討が必要とされています。
pmid-8267394.summary_en: This study characterized nuclear DNA content and DNA histogram types in 21 seminomas and 9 normal testicular tissues, using Feulgen-stained formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded samples and image cytometry. Normal testis showed three populations corresponding to haploid, diploid and tetraploid nuclei, whereas most seminomas displayed monomorphic histograms with predominantly G0-G1 nuclei in the 3c-4c range. The authors suggest that DNA histogram analysis might serve as a predictive prognostic marker or grading index, though further studies are needed.

pmid-8267441.summary_ja: 精巣の悪性奇形腫に対して6年前に精巣摘除術を受けた患者の症例報告です。両側肺と1か所の心臓内転移に対し、外科的切除が成功したことを報告しています。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の心臓内転移は極めてまれであり、その外科的治療の役割について考察されています。精巣がんの遅発性再発では心臓病変も念頭に置くべきだと強調されています。
pmid-8267441.summary_en: This case report describes successful surgical resection of bilateral lung and a single intracardiac metastasis from a malignant teratoma of the testis. The patient had undergone orchidectomy six years earlier. Intracardiac metastases from testicular germ cell tumors are very rare, and the authors discuss the role of surgical resection for such metastatic sites. The report highlights that cardiac involvement should be considered in patients with late relapse of testicular cancer.

pmid-8269278.summary_ja: 妊娠中の母親と胎児がそれぞれ未熟奇形腫を有していた症例です。胎児は妊娠38週で頭蓋内の未熟奇形腫と診断され、母親は帝王切開時に卵巣の未熟奇形腫が認められました。多型性DNAサテライト配列を用いたPCR解析により、両腫瘍は独立に発生したことが示されました。また両者ともp53遺伝子の遺伝性変異は認められず、母子で同時に独立した悪性未熟奇形腫が生じた初めての報告とされています。
pmid-8269278.summary_en: This report describes a pregnant woman and her fetus who both had immature teratomas during pregnancy. The fetus had an intracranial immature teratoma diagnosed at 38 weeks, and the mother had an ovarian immature teratoma found at cesarean delivery. PCR analysis of polymorphic DNA satellite sequences showed that the two tumors arose independently, and no inherited p53 mutation was detected. The authors describe this as the first report of simultaneous independent malignant immature teratomas in a mother and child during pregnancy.

pmid-8270052.summary_ja: 1980年から1991年に治療を受けた精巣悪性腫瘍患者1,450例のうち、ステージIIIの非セミノーマ性精巣がん42例を対象とした研究です。化学療法後も残存または進行した病変に対し、延べ44回の胸部外科手術が行われ、43例で切除に成功しました。術後早期の死亡は2例でした。適切な適応を選べば胸部外科治療は妥当であり、転移巣切除術は治療の改善につながる可能性があると結論づけています。
pmid-8270052.summary_en: This single-institution review covers 1,450 patients with malignant testicular tumours treated from 1980 to 1991. It focuses on 42 patients with stage III non-seminoma germ cell testicular cancer who underwent 44 thoracic surgical interventions for residual or progressive disease after combined chemotherapy. Successful resection was achieved in 43 cases, with two early postoperative deaths. Of 40 patients followed for 4 to 130 months, 31 were alive at last follow-up. The authors conclude that thoracic surgery is justified in appropriately selected patients and that metastasectomy may improve management.

pmid-8272163.summary_ja: 1977年から1993年に治療された精巣胚細胞腫瘍530例を後方視的に検討した研究です。両側性の精巣腫瘍は12例(2.26%)で、2例は同時に発生し、10例は初回の精巣摘除術後5.25年(範囲3〜13.5年)で対側に腫瘍が出現しました。両精巣の組織型が異なる場合があることから、既往治療を考慮した個別化治療の必要性を強調しています。両側精巣摘除後のホルモン補充や精巣人工物挿入の可能性にも言及しています。
pmid-8272163.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 530 patients with testicular germ cell tumors treated between 1977 and 1993. Twelve patients (2.26%) had bilateral testicular tumors. Two had simultaneous bilateral tumors with different histologic types, and ten developed a contralateral tumor 5.25 years (range 3-13.5) after orchiectomy for the first. The authors emphasize histologic variability between the testes, the need for individualized therapy considering prior treatment, and the implications of bilateral orchiectomy, including hormone replacement and testicular prosthesis.

pmid-8274095.summary_ja: 絨毛癌の脳転移に伴い腫瘍性動脈瘤を生じた症例報告で、脳血管造影で確認されました。絨毛癌では10〜20%に脳転移が起こるとされ、この報告は12例目にあたります。妊娠可能年齢の女性で脳出血や占拠性病変が生じた場合は本疾患を考慮すべきと強調しています。検査所見や画像所見に加え、化学療法、外科的治療、放射線療法の選択についても論じています。
pmid-8274095.summary_en: This case report describes the twelfth reported patient with cerebral metastasis from choriocarcinoma who developed oncotic aneurysms, confirmed by cerebral angiography. The authors emphasize that intracerebral hemorrhage or a mass lesion in a woman of childbearing age should prompt consideration of this diagnosis. Laboratory and radiological features are discussed, along with therapeutic options including chemotherapy, surgery and irradiation. Cerebral metastases occur in 10 to 20% of patients with choriocarcinoma.

pmid-8276305.summary_ja: 肺および子宮傍組織に転移した絨毛癌の39歳女性の症例です。子宮全摘・両側卵管卵巣摘出後の化学療法でhCG値は9 mIU/mlで横ばいとなりました。LH交差反応を補正すると定量hCGはゼロとなり、化学療法を中止しました。卵巣摘出後に低値のhCGが持続する場合は、LHの交差反応を除外すべきと結論しています。
pmid-8276305.summary_en: A 39-year-old woman with choriocarcinoma metastatic to the lungs and parametrium had hCG levels plateau at 9 mIU/ml after hysterectomy, bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, and chemotherapy. Cerebrospinal fluid hCG was negative. Serum LH measured 135 mIU/ml, causing cross-reactivity in the hCG assay. After correction for LH, quantitative hCG was zero, and chemotherapy was stopped. At 12 months, she remained in complete remission. The authors recommend ruling out LH cross-reactivity when evaluating persistent low hCG titers after oophorectomy.

pmid-8276479.summary_ja: 10歳の女児に発生した腸間膜原発の良性嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告です。良性嚢胞性奇形腫は性腺に最も多い胚細胞腫瘍ですが、性腺外での発生は稀で、腸間膜発生はさらに極めて稀とされています。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍としての発生部位の珍しさを示す報告です。
pmid-8276479.summary_en: A 10-year-old girl presented with a primary benign cystic teratoma arising in the mesentery. The authors note that benign cystic teratomas are the most common germ cell tumors of the gonads but are rare at extragonadal sites, and very rare in the mesentery. This case report documents a mesenteric teratoma in a child, highlighting its unusual location as an extragonadal germ cell tumor. Clinical details beyond the abstract are not provided here.

pmid-8277467.summary_ja: 29歳の兵士に発生した、異なる組織型の異時性両側精巣腫瘍の症例報告です。奇形腫の後にセミノーマが発生するという経過は、両側精巣腫瘍の中でも極めて稀な提示形式とされています。文献レビューを行い、診断上の問題点について考察しています。精巣の胚細胞腫瘍における慎重な組織学的評価の重要性を示唆しています。
pmid-8277467.summary_en: This case report describes a 29-year-old soldier with metachronous bilateral testicular tumours of different histologies: a teratoma followed by a seminoma. The authors note that this sequence is among the rarest presentations of bilateral testicular tumours. The report reviews the literature and discusses the diagnostic problems these cases pose, emphasizing the importance of careful histological evaluation.

pmid-8277474.summary_ja: 1977年から1988年に英国の陸軍病院で扱った精巣腫瘍144例の12年間の検討です。悪性は140例で、3例が性腺外に由来すると考えられました。病期分類の精度と治療プロトコルの向上により、後期には腫瘍死が減少しました。治療成績と予後改善について考察しています。
pmid-8277474.summary_en: This 12-year retrospective review covers 144 patients referred to a British military hospital between 1977 and 1988 with testicular tumours, of whom 140 were malignant. Three malignant lesions appeared extragonadal. Improvements in staging accuracy and treatment protocols are reflected in outcomes: ten tumour deaths occurred overall, but only one in the final three years despite rising caseload. The paper presents clinical presentation, treatment, and results, and discusses advances in treatment and improved prognosis.

pmid-8277490.summary_ja: 2症例の良性と考えられる卵巣嚢腫（類皮嚢腫を含む）を、内視鏡用ポーチを用いて腹腔鏡下に摘出した報告です。腹腔内への漏出のリスクをほとんど伴わずに卵巣病変を摘出できました。類皮嚢腫は成熟奇形腫であり、卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍の一つです。
pmid-8277490.summary_en: This report describes laparoscopic removal of apparently benign ovarian cysts, including dermoid cysts, in two patients using an endoscopic pouch. The pouch allowed extraction of ovarian lesions with little or no risk of intraperitoneal spillage. The authors suggest this technique is a reasonable alternative to traditional approaches for laparoscopic removal of ovarian tumors or cysts and should be considered when laparoscopic treatment is planned. Dermoid cysts are mature ovarian teratomas, a common ovarian germ cell tumor.

pmid-8277492.summary_ja: 妊娠中に腹水様の所見で発見された、卵巣に生じた巨大な良性嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告です。超音波検査、MRI、血管造影で大きな奇形腫が確認され、合併症なく切除されました。妊娠中の付属器腫瘤の稀な提示形式と、周術期管理の重要点を論じています。
pmid-8277492.summary_en: A pregnant woman presented with what appeared to be ascites and was found to have a massive benign cystic teratoma of the ovary, far larger than typical dermoids under 10 cm. Ultrasound, MRI, and angiography demonstrated the large mass, which was resected without complications. This case report highlights an uncommon presentation of an adnexal tumour in pregnancy and discusses important perioperative care considerations for managing such a massive ovarian teratoma during pregnancy.

pmid-8277622.summary_ja: 縦隔腫瘤と肺転移を有する19歳男性の症例です。針生検で未熟奇形腫が認められ、縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍・肺転移と診断されました。シスプラチン併用のPVB療法後、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は正常範囲に低下し、残存腫瘍の切除が行われました。切除検体では線維化・壊死が主体で、一部に未熟奇形腫を認めました。
pmid-8277622.summary_en: A 19-year-old man presented with chest pain, a large mediastinal mass, and bilateral pulmonary nodules. Serum hCG and AFP were markedly elevated. Needle biopsy showed immature teratoma, and he was diagnosed with primary mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor with pulmonary metastasis. Cisplatin-based PVB chemotherapy normalized AFP but hCG only partly normalized. Surgical resection of the residual mediastinal tumor and pulmonary nodules followed, and pathology showed mainly fibrosis and necrosis with partial immature teratoma.

pmid-8277792.summary_ja: クアラルンプール大学病院で1989〜1990年に診断された妊娠性絨毛性疾患39例の病理組織学的検討です。完全奇胎25例、部分奇胎11例、侵入奇胎1例、絨毛癌2例でした。発生頻度は約384妊娠に1例と推定され、インド系女性で発生率が最も高いと報告されています。
pmid-8277792.summary_en: This histopathological study from University Hospital, Kuala Lumpur, reviewed gestational trophoblastic disease diagnosed over two years (1989 to 1990). Among 39 cases, there were 25 complete moles, 11 partial moles, one invasive mole and two choriocarcinomas. Mean ages and ethnic distribution of molar pregnancies were reported, with an estimated incidence of about 1 in 384 pregnancies. Partial moles constituted 30% of molar pregnancies, and the highest prevalence was observed among Indian women, consistent with a prior Singapore study.

pmid-8280484.summary_ja: デンマークの全国規模コホート研究で、臨床病期Iの精巣セミノーマに対し精巣摘除術後に監視のみを行った261例を評価した。19%が再発し、主に傍大動脈リンパ節であった。再発患者の多くは放射線療法を受けた。腫瘤が大きいまたは播種性の再発には化学療法が必要であり、セミノーマ関連死は3例であった。腫瘍径6cm以上は独立した予後因子であり、著者らは大きい腫瘍に対する予防的放射線療法を推奨している。
pmid-8280484.summary_en: This Danish nationwide cohort study of 261 patients evaluated surveillance alone after orchidectomy for clinical stage I testicular seminoma. Relapse occurred in 19 percent, mostly in paraaortic lymph nodes, and most relapsing patients were treated with radiotherapy. Chemotherapy was needed for bulky or disseminated relapse, and there were three seminoma-related deaths. Tumor size of 6 cm or more was an independent prognostic factor, leading the authors to recommend prophylactic radiotherapy for large tumors.

pmid-8281392.summary_ja: 卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫の診断において、化学的脂肪抑制MRIの有用性を19例22病変で検討した研究です。脂肪抑制画像の追加により正診数が17病変から21病変に向上しました。少量の脂肪も検出でき、卵巣奇形腫の画像診断に有用と結論づけられています。
pmid-8281392.summary_en: This study assessed chemical fat-saturation MRI for diagnosing ovarian cystic teratoma in 19 patients with 22 lesions. Adding fat-saturation sequences to conventional T1- and T2-weighted imaging increased correct diagnoses from 17 to 21 of 22 tumors. Fat-saturation images detected small amounts of fat that were missed on conventional sequences. One tumor with minimal fat showed no signal drop and remained undiagnosed. The authors conclude that fat-saturation imaging is valuable for characterizing cystic teratomas of the ovary.

pmid-8282403.summary_ja: 12歳未満の奇形腫小児75例を後方視的に検討しました。仙尾部が49例と最多で、成熟奇形腫は切除のみで良好な早期生存率を示しました。未熟・悪性成分を有する症例はVAC療法などの集学的治療を受け、死亡率は未熟奇形腫20%、悪性奇形腫66.7%でした。
pmid-8282403.summary_en: This retrospective review describes 75 children under 12 years with teratomas, most commonly sacrococcygeal (49 cases). Most tumors contained only mature tissue and were managed with excision alone, with 95% early survival. Patients with immature or malignant components received multiagent chemotherapy (VAC) and sometimes radiotherapy, with mortality of 20% and 66.7%, respectively. Age at presentation was the only prognostic factor besides histology, and the authors stress early recognition and complete surgical excision.

pmid-8283088.summary_ja: 43年間に原発性縦隔腫瘍で手術を受けた628例を、小児106例と成人522例で比較した単施設研究です。奇形腫は小児の19.8%、成人の17.1%を占めました。成人は悪性腫瘍が多く、小児は呼吸困難や緊急手術が多い傾向でした。
pmid-8283088.summary_en: This Japanese institutional series of 628 patients who underwent surgery for primary mediastinal tumors over 43 years compares children (106) with adults (522). Teratoma was a major histology in both groups, accounting for 19.8 percent of pediatric and 17.1 percent of adult cases. Neurogenic tumors predominated in children, while thymoma predominated in adults. Adults had more malignant tumors, and children more often presented with dyspnea and emergency operations.

pmid-8283096.summary_ja: 21歳男性の成人頸部奇形腫の症例報告。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)とMRIで縦隔への進展を認めたが周囲組織への浸潤はなく、201Tlシンチグラフィーで腫瘍への集積を示した。襟状切開と胸骨正中切開を併用して切除し、病理学的に成熟奇形腫と診断された。術後1年7か月の時点で無病生存している。
pmid-8283096.summary_en: This report describes a 21-year-old man with a cervical mature teratoma, a rare neoplasm in adults. CT and MRI showed extension into the mediastinum without invasion of surrounding tissue, and thallium-201 scintigraphy showed uptake in the tumor. The tumor was resected through a collar incision combined with median sternotomy. Histology confirmed mature teratoma. The patient remained disease-free 19 months after surgery.

pmid-8285532.summary_ja: 新生児女児に生じた巨大な眼窩奇形腫の報告。眼窩の著明な拡大と頬骨の偏位、眼窩天蓋の菲薄化を認めたが骨浸潤はなかった。頭蓋顔面アプローチにより腫瘍を完全切除し、病理組織では三胚葉すべての成分を認めた。文献上、確実な先天性眼窩奇形腫は51例のみと報告されている。
pmid-8285532.summary_en: This report describes a newborn girl with a massive orbital teratoma causing marked orbital enlargement, displacement of the zygoma, and thinning of the orbital roof, without bony invasion. A craniofacial approach was used to completely extirpate the tumor. Histology showed derivatives of all three germ cell layers. The authors review the literature, noting only 51 well-documented congenital orbital teratomas, and offer recommendations for definitive treatment.

pmid-8287226.summary_ja: パラフィン包埋組織を用いてDNAフローサイトメトリーと蛍光in situハイブリダイゼーションにより、卵巣未分化胚細胞腫4例の染色体異数性を解析した。腫瘍はほぼ四倍体で、多くの症例で7番と12番染色体が増加していた。このパターンは精巣セミノーマに類似しており、i(12p)マーカーを含め両腫瘍が共通の細胞遺伝学的特徴を持つことが示唆された。
pmid-8287226.summary_en: This study analyzed chromosome aneuploidy in four ovarian dysgerminomas using DNA flow cytometry and fluorescence in situ hybridization on paraffin-embedded tissue. The tumors were near-tetraploid, with frequent gains of chromosomes 7 and 12 and an X chromosome count of three in most cases. The aneuploidy pattern closely resembled that of testicular seminoma, supporting a shared cytogenetic profile, including the i(12p) marker, between these two germ cell tumors.

pmid-8290730.summary_ja: 後腹膜に生じる原発性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍と、精巣原発腫瘍からの転移性（続発性）腫瘍との鑑別について解説している。精巣の超音波検査が重要だが、同時性・異時性病変もありうる。β-hCGとαフェトプロテイン(AFP)は診断とフォローアップに有用で、超音波検査とコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)は局在診断に役立つ。治療は手術、放射線療法、化学療法の併用が一般的である。
pmid-8290730.summary_en: This review explains how to distinguish primary extragonadal germ cell tumors of the retroperitoneum from secondary tumors metastasized from testicular primaries. Careful testicular ultrasound is essential, though synchronous or metachronous lesions can occur. Serum beta-hCG and AFP aid diagnosis and follow-up, while ultrasound and CT help localize tumors. Treatment typically combines surgery, radiotherapy, and chemotherapy.

pmid-8290818.summary_ja: 男性悪性腫瘍の約1%を占める精巣がんについて、若年男性の社会的・心理的影響を含めて概説した看護領域の総説である。早期発見には精巣自己検査が最も有用とされる。手術と化学療法の進歩により、かつて致命的であった本疾患は現在最も治癒可能ながんの一つとなった。血清マーカー、早期診断、治療が管理の鍵である。
pmid-8290818.summary_en: This nursing-oriented review summarizes testicular cancer, noting its rarity among male malignancies yet significant impact on young men. Testicular self-examination is the best available tool for early detection. Historically fatal due to rapid metastasis, testicular cancer is now among the most curable cancers thanks to advances in surgery and chemotherapy. Serum markers, early diagnosis, and treatment are key to management.

pmid-8290928.summary_ja: 51歳男性に膀胱の癌肉腫と精巣セミノーマが同時性に発症した症例報告である。癌肉腫は上皮成分と間葉成分の両方を含むまれな膀胱腫瘍である。尿路上皮系悪性腫瘍と精巣胚細胞腫瘍が同一患者に併存することはまれであり、そのような同時性の病態を認識することには臨床的意義がある。
pmid-8290928.summary_en: This case report describes a 51-year-old man with carcinosarcoma of the bladder and seminoma of the testis occurring synchronously. Carcinosarcoma is a rare bladder neoplasm containing both epithelial and mesenchymal components. The report highlights the uncommon coexistence of a urothelial-type malignancy and a testicular germ cell tumor in the same patient. Recognizing such synchronous presentations is clinically relevant.

pmid-8293618.summary_ja: 卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の一症例で、クエン酸ガリウム67の強い集積が認められたことを報告しています。腹部でガリウム集積異常を示す疾患の一つとして、未分化胚細胞腫を追加すべきだと述べています。単一症例の核医学報告ですが、腹部病変のガリウムシンチグラフィ解釈に有用な知見です。
pmid-8293618.summary_en: A patient with ovarian dysgerminoma showed intense uptake of gallium-67 citrate on scintigraphy. The authors report this finding to add dysgerminoma to the list of abdominal lesions with abnormal gallium-67 accumulation. The brief report emphasizes that clinicians should consider germ cell tumors in the differential when interpreting gallium scans in patients with abdominal abnormalities. It is a single-case nuclear medicine report with limited generalizability but clinically useful for imaging interpretation.

pmid-8293710.summary_ja: 生後20日の新生児で、口腔底に無痛性の腫瘤が生じた症例です。腫瘍は母乳哺育を妨げましたが、哺乳瓶での授乳は可能でした。摘出は容易で、組織学的に奇形腫と診断されました。口腔咽頭奇形腫は英文文献で26例のみの報告があり、先天性口腔腫瘤の鑑別診断に奇形腫を含めるべきだと述べています。
pmid-8293710.summary_en: A healthy 20-day-old neonate presented with a painless oropharyngeal mass on the floor of the mouth. The tumor interfered with breastfeeding but not bottle-feeding. After easy enucleation, histology confirmed teratoma. The authors note that the nasopharynx is the commoner site and that only 26 oropharyngeal teratomas had been reported in the English literature. They emphasize that teratoma should be included in the differential diagnosis of congenital oral growths.

pmid-8293741.summary_ja: 15年間に腹部膨満を主訴に受診した小児の大型卵巣腫瘤15例を後方視的に検討した報告です。漿液性・粘液性嚢胞腺腫、ブレンナー腫瘍、若年性顆粒膜細胞腫瘍などとともに、良性・悪性奇形腫や胎児性癌も含まれます。成人と小児の卵巣腫瘤では画像所見が大きく異なることを示しています。全例で経過は良好でした。
pmid-8293741.summary_en: This retrospective review describes 15 children with large ovarian masses presenting with abdominal swelling over 15 years, all histologically confirmed. Lesions included serous and mucinous cystadenomas, Brenner tumor, juvenile granulosa cell tumors, benign and malignant teratomas, and one malignant embryonal carcinoma. The authors highlight radiological differences between pediatric and adult ovarian masses and illustrate the imaging findings. All patients were well at follow-up. The series includes several germ cell tumor cases.

pmid-8300145.summary_ja: 卵巣の良性嚢胞性奇形腫に悪性変化を認め、二重悪性腫瘍を呈した症例報告です。平滑筋肉腫に上皮内扁平上皮癌を合併していました。卵巣摘出後1年間は良好に経過しています。成熟奇形腫内に肉腫と扁平上皮癌が併存する稀な例であり、卵巣奇形腫の慎重な病理学的検索の重要性を示しています。
pmid-8300145.summary_en: A case report describes malignant change in a benign cystic teratoma of the ovary, with double malignancy. The tumor contained leiomyosarcoma associated with in situ squamous cell carcinoma. The patient remained well for one year after ovariotomy. The report highlights the rare coexistence of sarcomatous and squamous malignant components within a mature teratoma, underscoring the need for careful pathological examination of ovarian teratomas.

pmid-8305146.summary_ja: 46,XY純粋性性腺形成不全の24歳表現型女性例。原発性無月経と両側線状性腺を認めた。予防的性腺摘出を拒否後に骨盤内腫瘤が出現し、両側性腺から性腺芽腫とディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）が確認された。両側性腺摘出・子宮全摘後に放射線療法とホルモン補充を行い、2年後も再発なく良好である。
pmid-8305146.summary_en: A 24-year-old phenotypic female with 46,XY pure gonadal dysgenesis presented with primary amenorrhea and bilateral streak gonads. After refusing prophylactic gonadectomy, she developed a pelvic mass, and histology of both gonads revealed gonadoblastoma and dysgerminoma. She underwent bilateral gonadectomy with hysterectomy, followed by radiation therapy and hormone replacement. At two years of follow-up she remained well and recurrence-free, illustrating the risk of gonadal tumors in dysgenetic gonads.

pmid-8305356.summary_ja: 病期I精巣セミノーマ94例に対し、大動脈傍領域のみへ20Gy・8分割の短期間放射線療法を施行した前向き研究の予備結果。忍容性は良好で、中央値34か月の追跡で腹部再発はなかった。潜在性奇形腫由来の孤立性遠隔転移が1例あり、化学療法で無病となった。簡便で低再発率の治療として有用性が示唆された。
pmid-8305356.summary_en: Ninety-four patients with stage I testicular seminoma received short-course radiotherapy (20 Gy in 8 fractions) to the para-aortic field only, in a prospective study. The regimen was well tolerated. With a median follow-up of 34 months, no abdominal relapse occurred. One patient developed a solitary distant metastasis from a latent teratoma and was disease-free after chemotherapy. The authors suggest this simpler, shorter technique offers a low relapse rate and may reduce the need for intensive surveillance.

pmid-8308217.summary_ja: 成人に発生した肝奇形腫の症例報告。成人例としては本報告が5例目と考えられ、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)との対比および44歳から61歳までの単純X線による経時的な進行記録が初めて示された。緩徐な進行を示した点が特徴である。肝奇形腫の文献レビューを付記している。
pmid-8308217.summary_en: The authors describe a hepatic teratoma in an adult patient, believed to be only the fifth such adult case reported. It is the first with CT correlation and with plain-film documentation of its development and slow progression from age 44 to 61. The report includes a review of the literature on hepatic teratomas, which are rare in adults and pose diagnostic challenges.
