pmid-1710406.summary_en: A case report of ovarian dysgerminoma describing cytologic, histologic, and electron microscopic findings. Cells showed marked anisokaryosis and large, sometimes bizarre nucleoli, with lymphocytic infiltration. Electron microscopy revealed convoluted nucleoli, annulated lamellae, and glycogen particles typical of germ cell tumors. The diagnosis was not certain on frozen section but was established by combined cytologic, histologic, and ultrastructural review. The case highlights the value of multimodal assessment in diagnosing ovarian germ cell tumors.

pmid-1710473.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍11例を対象に、血液型関連抗原の発現を分化マーカーとして検討した研究である。全例で2-3シアロシルラクトサミン構造が認められ、N-アセチルラクトサミンやLe(y)の発現は腫瘍ごとに異なった。これらの抗原陰性例は形態学的に分化度が低く、陽性例はより分化した像を示した。ただし症例数が少なく、今後の大規模検討が必要とされている。
pmid-1710473.summary_en: This study examines histo-blood group antigens as differentiation markers in eleven non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumors. All tumors contained binary 2-3 sialosyllactosamine structures, while N-acetyllactosamine and Le(y) expression varied. Tumors negative for these antigens were morphologically least differentiated, whereas positive tumors showed more differentiated patterns. The authors suggest that type 2 chain antigens may serve as differentiation markers. Because the series is small, a larger study is needed to confirm whether their expression reflects differentiation potential.

pmid-1710481.summary_ja: 進行精巣がん48例に対し、シスプラチン、エトポシド、イホスファミド、ビンクリスチン、ブレオマイシンによる強化化学療法を施行した報告である。34例（71%）が無腫瘍状態に達し、うち20例は残存病変の外科的切除を要した。セミノーマは非セミノーマより良好な反応を示した。36か月生存率は76%であった。
pmid-1710481.summary_en: This 1991 study reports outcomes of an intensive five-drug alternating chemotherapy regimen in 48 patients with far advanced testicular cancer. Thirty-four patients (71%) achieved tumor-free status, 14 with chemotherapy alone and 20 after surgical resection of residual disease. Pure seminoma responded better than nonseminoma. Univariate analysis associated serum hCG level and number of involved organ sites with response. Three patients relapsed after a minimum follow-up of 24 months, and 36-month survival was 76%.

pmid-1710482.summary_ja: 予後不良の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍91例に対する白金製剤強化化学療法BOP/VIPの成績を報告している。64例（70%）が完全寛解に達し、51例で残存腫瘤の外科的切除が施行された。2年無増悪生存率は66%であった。主な有害事象は骨髄抑制であり、末梢神経障害が22%に認められた。
pmid-1710482.summary_en: This study reports the BOP/VIP regimen, an initial platinum-intensive chemotherapy schedule, in 91 patients with poor-prognosis non-seminomatous germ cell tumors. Of these, 64 (70%) achieved complete remission, and 51 underwent surgical resection of residual masses, with teratoma or non-germ cell cancer found in 11. The overall response rate was 80%. With a median follow-up of 90 weeks, 2-year progression-free survival was 66%. Major toxicity was myelosuppression, and peripheral neuropathy occurred in 22% of patients.

pmid-1710641.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎および絨毛癌患者の血清・尿中について、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の全体、遊離hCGβ、βコア断片を酵素免疫測定法で同時測定した研究である。全hCGは血清と尿で良好な相関を示したが、血清値は尿中の約2倍であった。遊離hCGβ/全hCG比は絨毛癌で高値を示した。βコア断片は尿中のみで検出された。腫瘍マーカーとして血清全hCGの測定が推奨され、各比率は鑑別診断に有用と考えられている。
pmid-1710641.summary_en: This study measured whole hCG, free hCG beta, and beta-core fragment in serum and urine of patients with hydatidiform mole and choriocarcinoma, using sandwich enzyme immunoassays. Whole hCG levels in serum and urine correlated closely, although serum levels were about twice urine levels. Free hCG beta/whole hCG ratios were higher in choriocarcinoma. Beta-core fragment was detected only in urine, contributing about 40% in moles and 70% in choriocarcinoma. The authors recommend serum whole hCG as the preferred tumor marker and suggest these ratios may aid differential diagnosis.

pmid-1710655.summary_ja: 進行性胚細胞腫瘍159例を対象とした無作為化試験で、高用量シスプラチン(40 mg/m²)と標準用量(20 mg/m²)をエトポシド・ブレオマイシンと併用し比較した。高用量群では神経毒性、耳毒性、骨髄抑制が増加し、治療関連死は3%であった。生存率や無病生存に差はなく、標準用量を超える増量は毒性のみを増やすと結論された。
pmid-1710655.summary_en: This randomized SWOG and SECSG trial enrolled 159 men with advanced germ cell cancer and compared high-dose cisplatin (40 mg/m2 daily for 5 days) with standard-dose cisplatin (20 mg/m2), both combined with etoposide and bleomycin. High-dose cisplatin caused more neurotoxicity, ototoxicity, nausea, vomiting, and myelosuppression, with 3% treatment-related deaths. Dose intensity was largely maintained, but survival and disease-free rates were similar in both arms. The authors concluded that escalating cisplatin beyond standard doses adds toxicity without therapeutic benefit.

pmid-1710872.summary_ja: 本論文は、まれな精母細胞性セミノーマの日本人2例を報告したものである。いずれも無痛性の陰嚢内容腫大で受診し、精巣摘除術を受けた。1例目は初回病理で未分化セミノーマとされ、PVB併用化学療法を1コース施行後に病理が見直され、予防的放射線療法が行われた。2例目も予防的放射線療法を受けた。両例とも術後に再発はない。本邦での報告としては14例目と15例目にあたる。
pmid-1710872.summary_en: This Japanese case report describes two men with spermatocytic seminoma, a rare seminoma variant. Both presented with painless scrotal swelling and underwent orchiectomy for presumed testicular tumor. In the first patient, the initial pathology was anaplastic seminoma, so he received one cycle of PVB chemotherapy before the diagnosis was revised to spermatocytic seminoma and prophylactic radiotherapy was given. The second patient had spermatocytic seminoma and also received prophylactic radiotherapy. Both remained free of recurrence. The authors note these are the 14th and 15th reported Japanese cases.

pmid-1711304.summary_ja: 播種性胚細胞腫瘍の集学的治療において、腫瘍マーカーを軸とした治療の流れを自験例に基づいて示した総説的報告である。腫瘍マーカーは病理学的要素やリスク因子の診断、化学療法プロトコルの選択、残存腫瘍の切除時期の判断、治療後の再発監視に役立つとされる。進行非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の2症例を提示し、マーカーの推移から化学療法効果を評価し、プロトコルを見直す手順を説明している。
pmid-1711304.summary_en: This Japanese review presents personal experience with multidisciplinary management of disseminated germ cell tumors, with emphasis on tumor markers. Markers guide diagnosis of pathological elements and risk stratification, selection of chemotherapy protocols, timing of residual tumor resection, and monitoring for recurrence. Two patients with advanced nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors illustrate how marker trends evaluate chemotherapy response, prompt protocol changes, and indicate when surgery for residual masses is appropriate.

pmid-1711586.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ26例と非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍13例を対象に、血清アルカリフォスファターゼ・アイソザイムの腫瘍マーカーとしての有用性を検討した。胎盤型様酵素はセミノーマの病期I半数と進行例の全例で上昇した。胎盤型酵素、LDH、β-hCGを組み合わせると、病期Iの75%と進行例全例を正しく同定できた。非セミノーマ性腫瘍では血清上昇が稀で、組織発現もセミノーマより低かった。
pmid-1711586.summary_en: This study examined serum alkaline phosphatase isoenzymes as tumor markers in 26 seminoma and 13 nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor patients. Placental-type alkaline phosphatase-like enzyme was elevated in half of stage I seminomas and all advanced seminomas, while liver-type isoenzyme was also frequently raised. Combining the placental-type enzyme with LDH and beta-hCG correctly identified 75% of stage I and all advanced seminoma patients. Nonseminomatous tumors rarely elevated these enzymes, consistent with lower tissue expression.

pmid-1711647.summary_ja: 小児の胚細胞腫瘍63例(卵巣・精巣が中心、性腺外も含む)を検討した。卵巣・精巣の病期I例の治癒率は100%、病期IIIで82%、病期IVで75%であった。未熟奇形腫の組織型、特に神経型のグレードII・IIIは予後不良であった。進行例には手術、放射線療法、化学療法の併用を推奨し、一部の病期I例では腫瘍マーカーを追跡しながら待機的観察を行う方針を示している。
pmid-1711647.summary_en: This report describes 63 pediatric patients with germ cell tumors, mostly ovarian and testicular, plus presacral, mediastinal, and other extragonadal sites. It details symptoms, histology, staging, markers, treatment protocols, and responses. Cure rates were 100% for stage I ovarian and testicular tumors, falling to 82% in stage III and 75% in stage IV. Immature teratoma histology, particularly the neural type at grades II and III, had the worst prognosis. The authors advocate aggressive multimodal therapy for advanced disease and marker-guided wait-and-see management for selected stage I patients.

pmid-1712373.summary_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍(YST)患者の血清と胎児卵黄嚢培養液のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)の糖鎖不均一性を、原発性肝細胞癌と比較して検討した。レクチン親和性交差免疫電気泳動により、YSTのAFPは肝細胞癌や胎児肝にはないLCH弱反応性分画をもつことが示された。この糖鎖パターンは胎児卵黄嚢のAFPに類似し、卵巣および性腺外の卵黄嚢腫瘍が卵黄嚢由来であることを支持する。
pmid-1712373.summary_en: This Japanese study examined microheterogeneity of alpha-fetoprotein in sera from yolk sac tumor patients and primary hepatocellular carcinoma patients, as well as fetal yolk sac and liver culture fluids. Lectin affinity crossed-line immunoelectrophoresis showed that yolk sac tumor AFP has a distinct subfraction pattern, including a weakly LCH-reactive variant absent in hepatocellular carcinoma and fetal liver. This pattern resembles fetal yolk sac AFP, suggesting that AFP glycosylation in yolk sac tumors follows a yolk sac rather than liver pathway. The findings support a yolk sac origin for ovarian and extragonadal yolk sac tumors.

pmid-1712606.summary_ja: 1979〜1986年に精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍127例にBEP化学療法を行い、中央値65か月の長期フォローアップ結果をまとめた。5年全生存率は87.2%で、腫瘍量と血清マーカー値が予後と関連した。化学療法単独で完全奏効が得られたのは62%であった。ブレオマイシン肺炎は13%に、精液検査で無精子症が20%に認められた。低リスクの転移(性)非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍には標準治療となるが、進行例にはより強力な治療が必要とされる。
pmid-1712606.summary_en: This report follows 127 men with previously untreated nonseminomatous germ cell tumours of the testis treated with BEP chemotherapy from 1979 to 1986. With median follow-up of 65 months, five-year survival was 87.2%. Outcome correlated with tumour volume and serum AFP and beta-HCG levels. Sixty-two percent achieved complete response with chemotherapy alone, and 18% failed or relapsed. Bleomycin pneumonitis occurred in 13%, and azoospermia was found in 20% of men tested, though 21 men fathered children. BEP is standard for low-risk metastatic disease, while advanced disease requires more intensive therapy.

pmid-1712626.summary_ja: 1978〜1989年に転移(性)精巣奇形腫の連続92例にシスプラチン併用化学療法を施行し、救済治療を要した41例を検討した。手術を受けた16例中9例(56%)が無病となったが、放射線療法を受けた13例では3例、二次化学療法を受けた12例では全例が死亡した。腫瘍マーカーが正常であれば残存腫瘤の切除が最も有効であった。放射線療法は緩和には有用だが、残存腫瘤への効果は限定的である。
pmid-1712626.summary_en: This Clinical Oncology report reviews 92 consecutive men with metastatic testicular teratoma treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy from 1978 to 1989. Forty-one required salvage treatment with surgery, radiotherapy, or second-line chemotherapy. Surgery rendered 9 of 16 patients (56%) disease-free, radiotherapy 3 of 13, and second-line chemotherapy none of 12. Resection of residual masses was most effective when tumour markers were normal. Incompletely resected malignant disease carried a poor prognosis, and radiotherapy was useful mainly for palliation.

pmid-1712663.summary_ja: 進行期小児胚細胞腫瘍27例を対象に、化学療法後のセカンドルック手術の意義を腫瘍マーカー別に検討した。マーカーが正常化した例では多くが完全寛解で、残存腫瘤は成熟奇形腫や壊死組織が中心であった。マーカー高値が持続する例では残存病変が多く認められた。診断時にマーカーが高値の症例では手術の追加情報は少なく、適応は残存腫瘤やマーカー残存例に限るべきと結論している。
pmid-1712663.summary_en: This study evaluated 27 children with stage III to IV germ cell tumors who had completed four courses of chemotherapy, assessing the value of second-look surgery according to tumor marker status. When AFP or beta-hCG normalized, surgery confirmed complete response in most patients, and residual masses were mostly mature teratoma or necrosis. In patients whose markers stayed elevated, residual disease was common. The authors conclude that second-look surgery adds little for children with elevated markers at diagnosis and is best reserved for patients with residual masses and persistent marker elevation or normal markers at diagnosis.

pmid-1714700.summary_ja: 8歳男児に生じた巨大縦隔奇形腫の症例報告である。呼吸窮迫と胸壁穿孔を伴って発症した。巨大縦隔奇形腫による呼吸窮迫の報告はこれまでなく、報告の題名では緊張性奇形胸郭症と呼ばれている。小児の縦隔奇形腫における重篤な合併症を示す簡潔な報告である。
pmid-1714700.summary_en: This case report describes an 8-year-old boy with a giant mediastinal teratoma who presented with respiratory distress and perforation of the chest wall. The authors state that respiratory distress caused by a giant mediastinal teratoma had not previously been reported, and they call this presentation tension teratothorax. The brief communication focuses on the clinical history of this serious, previously unrecognized complication of a pediatric mediastinal teratoma.

pmid-1714980.summary_ja: 膀胱後部に発生した性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告である。会陰部痛と排尿時痛を訴え、CTとMRIで膀胱内に突出する腫瘍を認めた。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は12,170 ng/mlと著明に上昇していた。化学療法と放射線照射を行ったが、約6か月後に癌腫症で死亡した。剖検で精巣に腫瘍はなく、膀胱後部由来の報告としては2例目である。
pmid-1714980.summary_en: This case report describes a man with an extragonadal germ cell tumor arising in the retrovesical region. He presented with perineal and micturition pain. CT and MRI showed a retrovesical tumor protruding into the bladder, and serum alpha-fetoprotein was markedly elevated at 12,170 ng/ml. The testes showed no palpable mass or ultrasonographic tumor. He was diagnosed with a retrovesical extragonadal germ cell tumor with paraaortic nodes and lung metastases, received combination chemotherapy and irradiation, and died about six months later. Autopsy showed no testicular tumor, making this only the second reported case arising from the retrovesical region.

pmid-1715416.summary_ja: 1985〜1987年に播種性精巣腫瘍34例を対象に、PVB、VAB-6、BVP療法(群A、エトポシドなし)とPEB療法(群B)を比較した多施設ランダム化試験。完全奏効率に有意差はなかったが、救済手術の成功率と3年生存率はPEB群で高かった。骨髄抑制と脱毛はPEB群で多く、神経障害は群Aで多かった。進行性精巣腫瘍の導入化学療法としてPEBがより優れると結論している。
pmid-1715416.summary_en: This 1985-1987 multicenter randomized trial compared PVB, VAB-6, or BVP (group A, without etoposide) with PEB (bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin; group B) as induction chemotherapy for 34 men with disseminated testicular tumors, 10 with seminoma and 24 with non-seminomatous tumors. Complete response rates (35% vs 43%) did not differ significantly, but salvage surgery success was higher in group B (88% vs 61%). Three-year survival was 100% with PEB versus 76% with group A. Myelosuppression and alopecia were more frequent with PEB, while neuropathy was more common in group A. The authors conclude PEB is a better induction regimen.

pmid-1715798.summary_ja: 単施設での解析で、精巣セミノーマの病期Iの患者97例について検討した。精巣摘除術後に放射線療法を受けた64例と、サーベイランスを選んだ33例を比較した。中央値48か月のフォローアップで、再発はサーベイランス群3例、放射線療法群2例にみられた。著者らは、潜在転移の10%というリスクと進行率の高さからサーベイランスは推奨されず、照射線量と照射野を減らした放射線療法を提案している。
pmid-1715798.summary_en: This single-institution study reviewed 116 patients with testicular seminoma, 97 with stage I disease. Sixty-four received radiotherapy after orchiectomy and 33 entered surveillance. After a median follow-up of 48 months, relapse occurred in 3 surveillance patients and 2 irradiated patients. Patients with elevated beta-hCG did not progress. The authors argue surveillance is not recommended because of a 10% risk of occult metastases and a threefold higher progression rate compared with irradiated patients. They suggest reduced-dose, limited-field radiotherapy as an alternative.

pmid-1716095.summary_ja: 24歳男性の病期III性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。頸部・縦隔・腹部・鼠径リンパ節、両肺、肝臓に転移があり、腹水と胸水・心嚢水を伴っていた。腫瘍はヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)などを産生し、hCGが最も有用なマーカーであった。超高用量併用化学療法と自家骨髄移植の後、hCGは1.8 mIU/mlまで低下し、25か月後も再発はない。
pmid-1716095.summary_en: This Japanese case report describes a 24-year-old man with stage III extragonadal germ cell tumor involving cervical, mediastinal, abdominal and inguinal nodes, both lungs, and liver, with ascites and effusions. The tumor produced hCG, AFP, placental ALP and LDH, with hCG the most useful marker. Serum hCG was 460,000 mIU/ml initially, fell after three PVP courses, then rose tenfold within a week. After ultra-high-dose combination chemotherapy with autologous bone marrow transplantation, hCG fell to 1.8 mIU/ml and stayed low. The patient had no recurrence at 25 months.

pmid-1716204.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍の後腹膜リンパ節転移について、10例で化学療法の前・中・後に磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)とコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)を前向きに比較した研究。病変の検出、局在、大きさの評価はほぼ同等であった。化学療法中の構造変化はMRIのみで認められ、成熟奇形腫では高T2信号が高含水量を反映していた。ただし信号強度や性状からは最終的な治療効果を判断できないと結論している。
pmid-1716204.summary_en: This prospective study compared MRI and CT for evaluating retroperitoneal lymph node metastases from non-seminomatous testicular tumors in 10 consecutive patients before, during and after chemotherapy. Results were compared with laparotomy findings and histology. MRI and CT were equivalent for detecting lesions, localizing them and measuring their size. Only MRI showed marked structural changes during chemotherapy, which had no histological explanation except in mature teratoma, where high T2 signal reflected high water content. The authors conclude MRI cannot yet determine the final chemotherapy effect.

pmid-1716405.summary_ja: 1983〜1989年に治療されたセミノーマ7例と非セミノーマ性腫瘍9例を対象に、血清フェリチン値を他の腫瘍マーカーと比較した研究。治療前の異常高値は全体の44%で、β-hCGやLDHより低く、AFPと同程度であった。フェリチンの変動は臨床経過と必ずしも一致しなかったが、一部の患者では治療効果や再発の指標になりうると示唆している。
pmid-1716405.summary_en: This Japanese study measured serum ferritin alongside beta-hCG, AFP, CEA and LDH in 7 seminoma and 9 non-seminoma patients treated from 1983 to 1989. Ferritin was abnormally high in 44% overall, less often than beta-hCG and LDH but similar to AFP. Ferritin changes did not always match the clinical course, though some patients with high pretreatment levels normalized after therapy. One patient with persistently high ferritin developed retroperitoneal metastasis. Most patients with normal baseline levels stayed normal. The authors suggest ferritin may help monitor response and recurrence in some patients.

pmid-1716406.summary_ja: セミノーマ7例と非セミノーマ性腫瘍9例の精巣腫瘍を対象に、フェリチンの免疫組織化学染色を行った研究。正常の胚細胞は陰性で、腫瘍胞巣や組織球が陽性であった。転移巣や血管内の腫瘍塞栓でも染色された。陽性率はβ-hCG、AFP、CEAより有意に高く、血清フェリチン高値例では染色が強かった。一部の精巣腫瘍で有用な腫瘍マーカーになりうると結論している。
pmid-1716406.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined ferritin staining in testicular tumors from 7 seminomas and 9 non-seminomas, comparing results with clinical course. Normal germinal cells were negative, while tumor nests and histiocytes stained positive. Metastatic lesions and vascular tumor thrombi also showed staining. Positive ferritin staining occurred significantly more often than for beta-hCG, AFP and CEA. Cases with high serum ferritin stained more intensely. The authors suggest ferritin may be a useful tumor marker in some testicular tumors.

pmid-1716953.summary_ja: セミノーマ患者286例の血清2,000検体を用いて、PLAP、LD、β-hCGの腫瘍マーカーとしての有用性を検討した研究。単独では病期分類やフォローアップで十分な性能を示すマーカーはなかった。マルコフモデルで組み合わせ基準を検討し、β-hCG 6 IU/l超、またはLD 400 U/l超かつPLAP 60 U/l超を異常とする方法が最良とされた。この方法で病変のある患者の約50%を検出でき、偽陽性率は2%であった。
pmid-1716953.summary_en: This study analyzed 2,000 serum samples from 286 seminoma patients to assess placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP), lactate dehydrogenase (LD) and beta-hCG as tumor markers. No single marker performed adequately for detecting disease at staging or during follow-up, according to ROC curves. Using a Markov model, the authors identified a strategy in which results were abnormal if beta-hCG exceeded 6 IU/l, or if LD exceeded 400 U/l together with PLAP above 60 U/l. This detects about half of patients with disease, with a 2% false-positive rate. PLAP needs testing only when beta-hCG is low and LD is high.

pmid-17170803.summary_ja: 翼口蓋窩から眼窩へ進展した、まれな奇形腫の症例報告。受診時は上顎部の腫脹と眼球突出で、当初は診断が困難であった。繰り返しのコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)により腫瘍の進行を追跡した。側頭下窩アプローチによる手術で良好な結果が得られた。頭蓋底・眼窩領域に生じる性腺外の奇形腫は極めてまれであり、画像による経過の追跡が有用であったと報告している。
pmid-17170803.summary_en: This case report describes an unusual teratoma arising in the pterygopalatine fossa and extending into the orbit. It was first noticed after four months, as maxillary swelling and eye proptosis, and the diagnosis was initially difficult. Repeated computed tomography scans helped track tumor progression. The lesion was removed through an infratemporal surgical approach with a successful result. The report highlights the diagnostic challenge of this rare extragonadal teratoma in the skull base and orbital region.

pmid-1717098.summary_ja: 転移性精巣奇形腫の男性39例に、ブレオマイシンとシスプラチンを1日目のみ、エトポシドを3日間投与する改変BEP療法を行った。中央値31か月の観察で77%が生存かつ無病であった。リンパ節のみの病変では96%、肺病変を伴う例では43%が無病であった。小容量のリンパ節病変には入院期間の短縮やブレオマイシン肺毒性の低減に有用だが、進行例では強化療法が必要との見解。
pmid-1717098.summary_en: This report describes 39 men with metastatic testicular teratoma treated with a modified BEP regimen, in which bleomycin and cisplatin were given only on day 1 and etoposide for three days. With a median follow-up of 31 months, 77% were alive and disease-free. Outcomes were better for nodal-only disease (24 of 25 disease-free) than for lung involvement (6 of 14). The authors call this regimen well tolerated for small-volume nodal disease, with shorter hospital time and less bleomycin lung toxicity. They caution that more extensive disease may need more intensive therapy.

pmid-1717384.summary_ja: 胎児性癌の前駆細胞に発現する抗原TRA-1-60について、高感度な2段階酵素免疫測定法を開発した。胎児性癌陽性の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍42例中32例(76%)で血清中に抗原が検出された。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)とヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)がともに陰性の症例でも67%が陽性であった。セミノーマでは上昇はなく、経過観察に有用な追加マーカーとして提唱された。
pmid-1717384.summary_en: This study developed a sensitive two-step immunoenzymometric assay for TRA-1-60, an antigen on embryonal carcinoma progenitor cells. Among 42 EC-positive NSGCT patients, 76% had detectable serum TRA-1-60, compared with rare positivity in EC-negative patients. Notably, 67% of EC-positive patients negative for AFP and hCG were marker-positive. Seminoma patients showed no elevation. The authors propose TRA-1-60 as an additional serum marker for monitoring NSGCT patients.

pmid-1717667.summary_ja: 小児がん研究グループによる93例の小児悪性胚細胞腫瘍の治療成績である。4年生存率は54%で、卵巣原発は性腺外原発より予後が良好だった。11歳超、初回手術での不完全切除、複数臓器の罹患が予後不良因子であった。組織型は予後に影響せず、二回目手術の残存腫瘤の半数以上には悪性所見がなかった。
pmid-1717667.summary_en: This Children's Cancer Study Group report analyzed 93 children with malignant germ cell tumors, excluding dysgerminoma and testicular or brain tumors. Four-year survival was 54%, with better outcomes for ovarian than nongonadal primaries. Age over 11, incomplete initial resection, and multiple sites involved predicted poorer outcome. Histologic subtype did not affect results. Over half of residual masses resected at second-look surgery showed no malignancy.

pmid-1717863.summary_ja: PVB療法に抵抗性の精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍から頭蓋内に転移した奇形腫を有する26歳男性の症例報告である。脳出血に対する緊急手術で卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断された。再発後、エトポシド、シスプラチン、ACNUによる救援化学療法と放射線療法を施行した。3回目の手術では瘢痕組織のみとなり、初回手術から30か月後も良好であった。
pmid-1717863.summary_en: This case report describes a 26-year-old man with an intracranial teratoma metastasized from a testicular yolk sac tumor refractory to PVB chemotherapy. Emergency surgery for hemorrhage revealed the yolk sac tumor. After recurrence, he received etoposide, cisplatin, and ACNU salvage chemotherapy with radiation therapy. A third operation found only scar tissue, and he remained well 30 months after the first surgery.

pmid-1718175.summary_ja: 腹痛とCEA・CA19-9高値を示した70歳日本人女性の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に発生した乳房外パジェット病の症例報告である。奇形腫の扁平上皮内にパジェット細胞が認められ、粘液やCEA、EMA、サイトケラチンが陽性であった。他部位に基礎となる腺癌はなく、奇形腫の多能性細胞由来の上皮内腺癌と解釈された。
pmid-1718175.summary_en: This case report describes extramammary Paget's disease arising within an ovarian mature cystic teratoma in a 70-year-old Japanese woman with abdominal pain and elevated CEA and CA 19-9. Paget cells were found within the squamous epithelium of the teratoma and were positive for mucin, CEA, EMA, and cytokeratin. No underlying adenocarcinoma was identified elsewhere, so the lesion was interpreted as an intraepithelial adenocarcinoma arising from multipotential squamous cells of the teratoma.

pmid-1718401.summary_ja: 病期I精巣非セミノーマ72例を、リスクに基づいて補助化学療法または経過観察で管理した成績である。血管・リンパ管侵襲などの不良因子を有する30例はPVB療法3コースを受け、42例は経過観察とした。全例が生存し無病であった。経過観察群の1例のみが再発し、補助化学療法群では再発はなかった。
pmid-1718401.summary_en: This study reports 72 patients with stage I testicular nonseminoma managed by a risk-adapted strategy. Thirty patients with adverse histologic factors, such as vascular or lymphatic invasion, received three cycles of PVB adjuvant chemotherapy, while 42 without such factors were kept under surveillance. All patients remained alive and disease-free for 12 to over 60 months. One surveillance patient relapsed, and no relapses occurred after adjuvant chemotherapy.

pmid-1718685.summary_ja: 若年男性に最も多い悪性腫瘍である精巣がんの薬物療法を総説した。腫瘍マーカーのヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)とαフェトプロテイン(AFP)、セミノーマと非セミノーマへの分類、病期に応じた治療方針を扱う。標準リスク例にはシスプラチンとエトポシドが用いられ、予後不良例や再発・難治例にはイホスファミドや自家骨髄救済を伴う大量カルボプラチンが検討される。
pmid-1718685.summary_en: This review addresses drug therapy for testicular cancer, the most common malignancy in young men. It covers the tumor markers hCG and AFP, classification into seminomatous and nonseminomatous types, and stage-based management. Standard-risk patients are typically treated with cisplatin and etoposide, while poor-risk or relapsed patients may receive ifosfamide or high-dose carboplatin with autologous rescue. Toxicities are also discussed.

pmid-1718791.summary_ja: 母体血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)が中央値の17.46倍と高値を示し、卵巣未熟奇形腫と診断された女性の症例報告である。著者らは、中央値の9倍を超える母体血清AFPには詳細な評価が必要であり、成人でもAFPは腫瘍マーカーとなり得ると提案している。
pmid-1718791.summary_en: This case report describes a woman whose maternal serum AFP was 17.46 multiples of the median, leading to diagnosis of an ovarian immature teratoma. The authors suggest that maternal serum AFP above 9 multiples of the median warrants comprehensive evaluation, since AFP can act as a tumor marker in adults.

pmid-1719142.summary_ja: 不完全切除の進行卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ患者20例を、GOGの2つのプロトコルでシスプラチン、ブレオマイシン、ビンブラスチンまたはエトポシドにより治療した。測定可能病変を有する11例中10例が完全奏効し、セカンドルック手術14例はすべて陰性であった。追跡期間中央値26か月で、20例中19例が無病状態であった。シスプラチン併用化学療法は進行例に非常に有効と結論づけられた。
pmid-1719142.summary_en: Twenty assessable patients with incompletely resected ovarian dysgerminoma were treated on two Gynecologic Oncology Group protocols between 1984 and 1989 with cisplatin, bleomycin, and vinblastine or etoposide, with VAC consolidation in more recent patients. Ten of eleven patients with measurable disease achieved complete response, and all 14 second-look procedures were negative. At a median follow-up of 26 months, 19 of 20 patients were disease-free. The authors conclude cisplatin-based chemotherapy is highly effective in advanced dysgerminoma.

pmid-1719803.summary_ja: 8年間に経験した思春期異常を伴う男児小児胚細胞腫瘍患者6例を報告した。hCG産生腫瘍による思春期早発症が高頻度にみられ、一部では性染色体異常も認められた。AFP、hCG、妊娠特異的β1糖タンパク質は、診断とフォローアップに有用な腫瘍マーカーであった。
pmid-1719803.summary_en: This report describes six male pediatric patients with germ cell tumors and pubertal abnormalities over eight years. Most had precocious puberty from hCG-secreting tumors, and sex chromosome abnormalities were found in some. AFP, hCG, and pregnancy-specific beta-1 glycoprotein were useful tumor markers for diagnosis and follow-up. The study confirms the high frequency of sexual precocity and the utility of these markers in these patients.

pmid-1720411.summary_ja: ヒト悪性胚細胞腫瘍由来の細胞株32株をin vitroで樹立した。従来はヌードマウスへの継代移植で維持されていた。培養上清中のAFPおよびSP1産生を免疫化学的に確認した。本法は多分化能を持ち、マーカータンパクを産生する腫瘍細胞の培養を可能にし、胚細胞腫瘍の研究資源となる。
pmid-1720411.summary_en: Thirty-two cell lines were established in vitro from human malignant germ cell tumors, overcoming the need for serial transplantation into nude mice. Culture medium was tested for AFP and SP1 production, which was demonstrated immunochemically. The work establishes an in vitro culture method for these multipotent tumor cells that produce marker proteins. Such lines provide a resource for studying germ cell tumor biology in cancer research.

pmid-1720634.summary_ja: 進行セミノーマ患者33例に、シスプラチン併用化学療法であるPVB/BEPの交互投与4コースを行った。評価可能な30例中、完全寛解は43%、部分寛解は57%であった。追跡期間中央値28か月で79%が無病状態であった。白血球減少（グレード3/4）は97%、血小板減少は61%に生じ、毒性は高度であった。
pmid-1720634.summary_en: Thirty-three patients with advanced seminoma received four courses of alternating PVB/BEP, a cisplatin-based regimen. Complete remission was achieved in 43% and partial remission in 57% of 30 evaluable patients, with 79% disease-free at median follow-up of 28 months. Toxicity was considerable, with grade 3/4 leukopenia in 97% and thrombocytopenia in 61%. The authors conclude alternating PVB/BEP yields response rates comparable to non-alternating schedules but with significant toxicity.

pmid-1720656.summary_ja: 転移性セミノーマ患者59例を、VAB-6療法（21例）またはCP療法（シクロホスファミドとシスプラチン、38例）で治療した。一部の非奏効例には放射線療法または化学療法を追加した。最終完全奏効率はVAB-6で67%、CPで72%であった。両療法とも忍容性は良好で、主な毒性は白血球減少であり、致死的毒性はなかった。
pmid-1720656.summary_en: Fifty-nine patients with metastatic seminoma were treated with either VAB-6 (21 patients) or cyclophosphamide plus cisplatin (CP, 38 patients), with additional radiotherapy or chemotherapy for some non-responders. Final complete response rates were 67% for VAB-6 and 72% for CP. Both regimens were well tolerated, with leukopenia the main toxicity and no fatal toxicities. The authors conclude both regimens have comparable, high activity in disseminated seminoma.

pmid-1721771.summary_ja: 1976年から1989年に治療された非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍26例を検討した。大半は病期Iであった。1985年以降に精巣摘除術のみでwatch-and-see方針をとった症例では、2例が再発し、いずれも未熟奇形腫を含んでいた。転移例のPVB療法奏効率は66.7%であった。5年生存率は病期Iで100%、病期II・IIIで50%、全体で84.6%であった。
pmid-1721771.summary_en: Twenty-six patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumors treated from 1976 to 1989 were reviewed. Most were stage I. Those treated with orchidectomy alone under a watch-and-see policy after 1985 had two relapses, both containing immature teratoma. Patients with metastatic disease responded to PVB therapy in 66.7%. Five-year survival was 100% for stage I, 50% for stages II and III, and 84.6% overall.

pmid-1722041.summary_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍への分化を伴う肺芽腫の2例を報告した。両例ともαフェトプロテイン(AFP)を産生し、卵黄嚢腫瘍の組織学的領域を有していた。肺芽腫に胚細胞腫瘍成分が併存する例はこれまで報告されていなかった。また、胎児肺組織のAFP免疫染色所見も報告され、これらの腫瘍における癌胎児性抗原発現が示唆される。
pmid-1722041.summary_en: Two cases of pulmonary blastoma with yolk sac tumor differentiation are described. Both produced alpha-fetoprotein and showed histologic areas of yolk sac tumor, a feature not previously reported for pulmonary blastoma. The authors also report immunohistochemical AFP staining of fetal lung tissue, suggesting oncofetal antigen expression in these tumors. This is the first report of coexisting germ cell tumor components in such neoplasms.

pmid-1722771.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍52例と健常対照33例で、血清総アミラーゼ、膵型・唾液腺型分画、P/S比を測定した。P/S比と膵型分画は、セミノーマと非セミノーマ性腫瘍の双方で上昇し、非セミノーマ性で高頻度であった。P/S比は診断の補助となりうるが、予後評価や治療中の病勢モニタリングには有用でないと結論づけられた。
pmid-1722771.summary_en: In 52 patients with testicular germ cell tumours and 33 healthy controls, serum total amylase, pancreatic and salivary fractions, and the P/S ratio were measured. The P/S ratio and pancreatic fraction were elevated in both seminomatous and non-seminomatous tumours, more often in non-seminomatous. Treatment did not substantially lower the ratio in non-seminomatous tumours. The authors conclude the P/S ratio may aid diagnosis but is not useful for prognosis or monitoring during treatment.

pmid-1722833.summary_ja: 進行精巣胚細胞腫瘍15例にVAB-6化学療法を行った。部分奏効は60.0%、完全奏効は13.3%で、5年生存率は51.4%だった。残存腫瘍の組織解析で、進行肺病変と絨毛癌が不良な予後因子と示された。そのため、初回治療にVP-16、イホスファミド、高用量シスプラチンを用いることが示唆された。
pmid-1722833.summary_en: This Japanese series treated 15 patients with advanced testicular germ cell tumor using VAB-6 chemotherapy after radical orchiectomy. Partial response occurred in 60% and complete response in 13%, with 5-year survival of 51.4%. Residual tumor histology showed necrosis/fibrosis, teratoma, or cancer. Advanced lung disease and choriocarcinoma were identified as poor prognostic factors, suggesting initial use of VP-16, ifosfamide, and high-dose cisplatin for such patients.

pmid-1723173.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の脳転移の2例を報告する。両例とも初回入院日に腫瘍内の突然の大量出血を来し、致死的となる危険が高かった。全身状態の悪化前に早期に積極的な外科的摘出を行うこと、薬剤耐性を考慮して原発巣とは異なる薬剤で術後化学療法を行うことが推奨される。
pmid-1723173.summary_en: Two cases of brain metastasis from testicular tumor are described, each presenting with sudden, massive intratumoral hemorrhage on the first admission day. Such hemorrhage carried a high risk of fatality. The authors advise early, aggressive surgical removal before general deterioration, along with postoperative chemotherapy using an agent different from that used for the primary tumor, given possible drug tolerance.

pmid-1723407.summary_ja: 進行精巣がんに対する化学療法を総説した。精巣がんは治癒率が95%を超える代表的な固形がんとなった。段階的な試験を経て現在の治療法が確立され、低リスク患者では毒性を抑えた最小限の治療が明らかになった。高リスク患者については、新規レジメンのランダム化試験による改善が必要である。
pmid-1723407.summary_en: This review summarizes chemotherapy for advanced testicular cancer, which has become one of the most curable solid malignancies, with cure rates above 95%. Sequential trials established the current regimens, which serve as a model for chemotherapy development. Recent work defines minimal effective therapy for low-risk patients to reduce toxicity, while high-risk patients still need improvement through randomized trials of new regimens.

pmid-1723408.summary_ja: 本総説は、胚細胞腫瘍における血清腫瘍マーカーを検討し、セミノーマおよびNSGCTの病期評価、経過観察、予後判定における役割を述べる。AFPおよびβ-hCGの上昇は遺残病変や再発の評価に役立つ一方、LDH、PLAP、BFPは特異性が低い。多くのNSGCTおよびほとんどのセミノーマでは、AFPおよびβ-hCGは検出されないことがある。残存腫瘤は、遺残病変を除外するために依然として切除を必要とする。
pmid-1723408.summary_en: This review examines serum tumor markers in germ cell neoplasms, including their roles in staging, monitoring, and prognosis for seminoma and NSGCT. AFP and beta-hCG elevations help assess persistent disease and recurrence, while LDH, PLAP, and BFP are less specific. Many NSGCT and most seminoma cases have undetectable AFP and beta-hCG, and residual masses still require resection to exclude persistent disease.

pmid-1723674.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌の患者で血清SP1、hPL、β-hCGを測定した。SP1は胞状奇胎で最も高く、絨毛癌で最も低かった。SP1/β-hCG比とβ-hCG/hPL比は、良性と悪性の栄養膜疾患の鑑別に有用であった。SP1とβ-hCGが治療後に低下すれば予後は良好であり、血清マーカーはフォローアップにも役立つ。
pmid-1723674.summary_en: This Chinese study measured serum SP1, hPL, and beta-hCG by radioimmunoassay in patients with hydatidiform mole, invasive mole, and choriocarcinoma, comparing them with normal pregnancy and non-pregnant controls. SP1 was highest in hydatidiform mole and lowest in choriocarcinoma. SP1/beta-hCG and beta-hCG/hPL ratios helped distinguish benign from malignant trophoblastic disease, and falling SP1 and beta-hCG predicted favorable outcomes.

pmid-1723842.summary_ja: 進行性の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の5例に導入化学療法を行った。BVP療法の2例は死亡し、BEP療法の3例は完全寛解に至り1年以上生存した。BEPでは発熱性好中球減少が生じたが、予防的G-CSF投与で全量投与が可能となった。BEP化学療法は、進行精巣腫瘍と同様に性腺外病変にも有効と考えられた。
pmid-1723842.summary_en: Five patients with advanced extragonadal germ cell tumor received induction chemotherapy, either BVP or BEP. Two BVP patients died within 9 months, while three BEP patients achieved complete remission and survived over one year. Febrile neutropenia occurred after the first BEP cycle, but prophylactic G-CSF allowed two patients to complete full-dose therapy. The authors conclude BEP is effective for extragonadal disease as it is for advanced testicular tumors.

pmid-1723958.summary_ja: 本研究は、成人18人のセミノーマ、奇形腫、混合型胚細胞腫瘍に隣接する上皮内癌と、思春期前の小児の卵黄嚢腫瘍および分化した奇形腫に隣接する上皮内癌を比較した。成人では、上皮内癌は3群で形態学的に区別できず、胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼを発現しビメンチンや低分子量サイトケラチンを発現しなかったことから、セミノーマと奇形腫の共通の前駆細胞が示唆された。精子細胞性セミノーマには上皮内癌は認められず、組織発生が異なることが示唆された。思春期前の精巣では成人型の上皮内癌は認められず、停留精巣の評価に影響しうる。
pmid-1723958.summary_en: This study compared carcinoma in situ (CIS) adjacent to seminomas, teratomas, and mixed germ cell tumors in 18 adults, and to yolk sac tumors and differentiated teratomas in prepubertal children. In adults, CIS was morphologically indistinguishable across the three groups and expressed placental alkaline phosphatase but not vimentin or low molecular weight cytokeratins, supporting a multipotent precursor for seminoma and teratoma. No CIS was found adjacent to spermatocytic seminomas, suggesting a distinct histogenesis. In prepubertal testes, adult-type CIS was not identified, which matters when assessing cryptorchid testes.

pmid-1724229.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、出血性胸水を初発症状とした妊娠性絨毛癌の症例を提示する。著者らは、胸水中のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の測定が診断上重要であることを強調している。生殖年齢の女性に原因不明の出血性胸水がみられた場合、明らかな肺や骨盤の病変がなくても絨毛性疾患を鑑別に含めるべきであることを示唆する。抄録は簡潔で、治療内容や転帰の詳細は含まれていない。
pmid-1724229.summary_en: This case report describes gestational choriocarcinoma presenting with a haemorrhagic pleural effusion. The authors highlight that detecting human chorionic gonadotropin in pleural fluid is important for diagnosis. The report suggests that trophoblastic disease should be considered when a haemorrhagic effusion arises in a woman of reproductive age, even without an obvious pulmonary or pelvic lesion. The abstract is brief and does not describe the treatment course or outcome of the patient.

pmid-1725164.summary_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍20例について、免疫組織化学により中間径フィラメント蛋白の発現パターンを調べた。サイトケラチン8と18はすべての腫瘍で認められたが、サイトケラチン19は胎児性癌では弱いか欠如し、卵黄嚢腫瘍や絨毛癌、奇形腫では強く発現していた。このため、胎児性癌内に目立たない卵黄嚢腫瘍成分や絨毛癌成分を同定できた。胚細胞腫瘍の多様な分化能を反映する所見である。
pmid-1725164.summary_en: This study examined intermediate filament protein profiles of 20 human testicular non-seminomatous germ cell tumors, including embryonal carcinoma, endodermal sinus tumor, choriocarcinoma, and teratoma, using immunohistochemistry. Cytokeratins 8 and 18 were present in all tumors, but cytokeratin 19 was weak or absent in embryonal carcinoma while strongly expressed in other components. This allowed identification of small yolk sac tumor and choriocarcinoma elements within embryonal carcinoma. Vimentin was common, and stromal cells often co-expressed cytokeratins. The heterogeneity reflects the varied differentiation potential of these tumors.

pmid-1725190.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、無症状の11歳男児に生じた前縦隔原発の卵黄嚢腫瘍を記載する。シスプラチンを含む多剤併用化学療法の後に外科的切除を行った。診断から60か月後も健康に生存している。小児の性腺外卵黄嚢腫瘍が縦隔に生じ、白金製剤を含む化学療法と切除による集学的治療が有効であった例として示している。
pmid-1725190.summary_en: This case report describes an asymptomatic 11-year-old Japanese boy with a primary yolk sac tumor of the anterior mediastinum. He was treated with cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy followed by surgical excision. At 60 months after diagnosis he remained alive and in good health. The report illustrates that extragonadal yolk sac tumors can arise in the mediastinum in children and respond to platinum-based chemotherapy followed by resection, supporting multimodal treatment for such cases.

pmid-1725250.summary_ja: 本研究では、実験的奇形癌0TT6050から胚様体を作製し、形態から2型に分類した。それぞれを同系129/Svマウスの皮下に移植し、20日後と30日後に腫瘍を採取して組織学的および免疫組織化学的に解析し、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)の発現を調べた。腫瘍の組織像は、用いた胚様体の形態的な構築の程度と関連していた。胚様体の構造と腫瘍の組織像、AFP発現を結びつける実験モデルを示した。
pmid-1725250.summary_en: This study generated embryoid bodies from the experimental teratocarcinoma 0TT6050 and classified them into two morphological types. Each type was injected subcutaneously into isogenic 129/Sv mice, and the resulting tumors were examined 20 and 30 days later by histology and immunohistochemistry for alpha-fetoprotein. The histological pattern of the tumors was related to the degree of morphological organization of the embryoid bodies used. The work provides an experimental murine model linking embryoid body structure to tumor histology and AFP expression.

pmid-1725504.summary_ja: ハラレで治療された絨毛癌患者39例と、奇胎後絨毛性腫瘍1例を報告する。多くは妊娠から診断までの期間が長く、非婦人科的症状で受診し、95%が高リスク群であった。世界文献中で最も高率の脳転移を報告している。1987年に改変EMA療法を導入した後、死亡率は1985〜1986年の81%から1987〜1988年の31%に低下した。
pmid-1725504.summary_en: This series from Harare describes 39 patients with choriocarcinoma and one with post-molar trophoblastic tumour. Many presented long after the preceding pregnancy, with non-gynaecological symptoms, and 95% were in the high-risk or poor-prognosis group. The authors report the highest rate of cerebral metastases in the world literature. After a modified EMA regimen was introduced in 1987, mortality fell from 81% in 1985 to 1986 to 31% in 1987 to 1988. Follow-up of patients on this regimen ranged from four to twenty-four months.

pmid-1741980.summary_ja: 46,XYの純粋性腺形成不全7例と、完全型または不完全型の精巣女性化症候群14例を検討した。純粋性腺形成不全の4例では性腺芽腫、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）、またはその両方が認められたが、精巣女性化症候群では性腺腫瘍は認められなかった。著者らは、Y染色体を持つ46,XY個体において性腺形成不全が性腺芽腫の発生に病因として関与すると結論づけている。
pmid-1741980.summary_en: This Leuven series reviews seven patients with 46,XY pure gonadal dysgenesis and 14 with complete or incomplete testicular feminization syndrome. Four patients with pure gonadal dysgenesis had gonadoblastoma, dysgerminoma, or both, while no gonadal tumors were found in testicular feminization patients. The authors conclude that gonadal dysgenesis plays a pathogenic role in gonadoblastoma induction in 46,XY individuals carrying a Y chromosome. The findings emphasize the importance of recognizing gonadal dysgenesis for tumor risk assessment.

pmid-1742235.summary_ja: 転移性精巣奇形腫の患者が集中的な併用化学療法に良好に反応したものの、壊死した腫瘍腔内に肺膿瘍が生じ、残存病変の外科的切除前に死亡した症例報告。剖検では壊死組織と成熟分化した奇形腫が認められ、明らかな悪性所見はなかった。厚い壁を持つ病変内の膿瘍は抗菌薬のみでは改善しにくく、早期の外科的介入が治癒可能な症例を救い得ると述べている。
pmid-1742235.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with widely metastatic testicular teratoma who responded well to intensive combination chemotherapy but developed a lung abscess within a necrotic tumour cavity. The abscess led to death before residual lesions could be surgically resected. Post-mortem examination showed necrotic tissue and mature differentiated teratoma without frank malignancy. The authors note that abscesses in thick-walled lesions are unlikely to resolve with antibiotics alone, and that earlier surgical intervention might salvage potentially curable patients.

pmid-1749681.summary_ja: 6歳男児に持続する原因不明の発熱をきたした、後縦隔下部の感染性奇形腫の症例報告。超音波検査とコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)の併用で病変の部位、進展、性状を正確に診断できた。抗菌薬治療後のフォローアップCTで膿瘍の縮小が確認され、待機的手術が可能になった。この稀な縦隔病変の診断における画像併用の有用性を示している。
pmid-1749681.summary_en: This paper describes a six-year-old boy with prolonged unexplained fever caused by an infected teratoma of the lower posterior mediastinum. Combined ultrasonography and computed tomography allowed accurate determination of the lesion's location, extent and nature, explaining the clinical picture. Follow-up CT showed regression of the abscess after antibiotic therapy, which permitted elective surgery. The report highlights the diagnostic value of combined imaging for this rare mediastinal lesion.

pmid-1751915.summary_ja: 視力低下と眼痛で受診した33歳女性で、脈絡膜への転移性絨毛癌が判明し、眼球摘出術が行われた。免疫染色でサイトケラチンとβ-hCGが陽性であった。血清β-hCGは82,000 IU/Lと著明に上昇したが、併用化学療法で正常化し、30か月時点で再発はなかった。眼症状が初発となった眼の転移性絨毛癌としては2例目の報告である。
pmid-1751915.summary_en: This case report describes a 33-year-old woman whose presenting symptoms of decreased vision and pain were caused by metastatic choriocarcinoma in the choroid, with a lung lesion also present. The eye was enucleated after becoming blind. Histology and immunohistochemistry confirmed choriocarcinoma, with positive cytokeratin and beta-hCG staining. Serum beta-hCG was markedly elevated at 82,000 IU/L. Combination chemotherapy normalised beta-hCG levels, and there was no recurrence at 30 months. The authors note this is only the second reported case of metastatic choriocarcinoma in the eye presenting with ocular symptoms.

pmid-1754572.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株5種においてHLAクラスI分子の発現を検討した研究。細胞株間で発現に不均一性があり、表面発現量は重鎖mRNAとほぼ相関した。インターフェロンγは2株(NUC1、HCCM5)でHLAクラスIの発現とmRNAを増加させ、絨毛系細胞の免疫回避機構の解明に関連する知見を示した。
pmid-1754572.summary_en: This study examined HLA class I expression in five human choriocarcinoma cell lines, relevant to how trophoblasts avoid maternal immune rejection. The authors found heterogeneous HLA class I levels across lines, which correlated approximately with heavy-chain mRNA levels. All lines produced moderate amounts of surface and secreted beta-2-microglobulin. Interferon-gamma upregulated HLA class I molecules and mRNA in two lines, NUC1 and HCCM5, suggesting cytokine-mediated control of immune recognition in choriocarcinoma cells.

pmid-1756230.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌(EC)細胞株と栄養膜細胞株において、TNF-αおよびTNF-βのmRNA発現をRT-PCRで検討した研究。EC細胞株4株と栄養膜細胞株は両TNFを発現した。他のサイトカインでは株ごとに発現が異なり、胚発生における炎症様サイトカインネットワークの可能性が示唆された。
pmid-1756230.summary_en: The authors measured TNF-alpha and TNF-beta transcripts in murine embryonal carcinoma (EC) cell lines and a trophoblast line using RT-PCR. Four EC lines and the trophoblast line expressed both TNF genes, along with TNF receptors and NF-kappaB. Other cytokines showed variable expression: G-CSF was constant across lines, IL-1beta, IL-3 and IFN-gamma were expressed in some lines only, and IL-1alpha was absent. The authors propose an inflammation-like cytokine network during embryonic development.

pmid-1756486.summary_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の転移巣に含まれる成熟奇形腫成分と未熟奇形腫成分をそれぞれ核型解析した症例報告。両成分の核型は極めて類似していた。このことから、成熟と未熟という表現型の違いは主にエピジェネティックに決定されていることが示唆された。
pmid-1756486.summary_en: Metastases of a testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumor contained both mature and immature teratoma components. The authors karyotyped each component separately. The two karyotypes were highly similar, suggesting that the phenotypic difference between mature and immature teratoma is predominantly epigenetically determined rather than reflecting distinct genetic clones. This is a single case report.

pmid-1756501.summary_ja: 混合性性腺異形成を伴う46,XY表現型女性の、ストリーク性腺から発生した原発性胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。核型は48,XY,+7,+i(12p)であった。正常男性性腺由来の腫瘍と異なり近二倍体であったが、i(12p)および7番染色体の増加を認めた。これらの変化は、異形成性性腺においても胚細胞腫瘍の発生に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-1756501.summary_en: A 20-year-old phenotypic female with a 46,XY karyotype and mixed gonadal dysgenesis had a primary germ cell tumor arising from a streak gonad. Cytogenetic analysis showed a 48,XY,+7,+i(12p) pattern. The tumor was near-diploid, unlike typical aneuploid germ cell tumors of normal male gonads, yet it carried isochromosome 12p and chromosome 7 gain. The authors suggest these changes may contribute to germ cell tumor pathogenesis even in dysgenetic gonads.

pmid-1765933.summary_ja: 胎児水腫を伴う仙尾部奇形腫の新生児2例を報告。いずれも急性腎不全と重度の呼吸不全を呈したが生存し、腫瘍切除後に肺機能と腎機能が改善した。腫瘍血流量や血管作動性物質、周産期の体液管理が関与すると考察し、腎機能の注意深い評価の必要性を指摘している。
pmid-1765933.summary_en: This report describes two newborns with fetal hydrops and sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT), a combination previously considered lethal, who both survived. Both developed acute renal failure and severe respiratory insufficiency. Tumor resection improved pulmonary function and renal recovery. The authors suggest that tumor blood volume, vasoactive substances, and postnatal fluid management contribute to these complications, and that close attention to renal function is necessary.

pmid-1770233.summary_ja: 軟口蓋および中咽頭に発生したエピグナサス（奇形腫）の症例で、手術を行わず保存的に管理し8年間経過観察した。臨床所見と画像所見を提示し、保存的管理のみで長期生存が得られた点を報告している。頭頸部に生じた奇形腫の稀な症例として、臨床・画像の特徴を詳細に示している。症例報告。
pmid-1770233.summary_en: This report describes an epignathus, a teratoma arising from the soft palate and oropharynx, in which the patient survived long-term without surgery. Clinical and radiological features of the lesion are presented. The case was treated conservatively and followed for eight years. Because the patient was managed without operative resection, the report illustrates that conservative management alone can allow long-term survival in this rare head and neck presentation.

pmid-1771248.summary_ja: 純粋ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）に対する手術と術後放射線療法（骨盤部40Gy、傍大動脈領域30Gy）から11年後に骨肉腫を発症した20歳女性の症例。Cahan基準を満たし放射線誘発性骨肉腫と判断された。稀な合併症だが、胚細胞腫瘍の生存者では留意が必要と述べている。
pmid-1771248.summary_en: A 20-year-old woman who had undergone surgery for pure dysgerminoma and adjuvant radiotherapy (40 Gy to the pelvis and 30 Gy to the para-aortic region) 11 years earlier developed osteosarcoma. Histological examination of an open biopsy confirmed the diagnosis. The case met the Cahan criteria for radiation-induced osteosarcoma. The authors note that this complication is rare but should be considered in long-term survivors of germ cell tumor treatment.

pmid-1773269.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療後患者162例を対象に、定期的な胸部X線検査による再発検出の有用性を検討した研究です。胸腔内再発は6例で、胸部X線のみで発見されたのは1例でした。フォローアップにおける検出率は極めて低く、放射線被曝と費用を考慮して実施の是非を検討すべきと結論づけています。
pmid-1773269.summary_en: This study evaluated the usefulness of routine follow-up chest radiographs in 162 patients with germ cell testicular tumours. Only six patients developed intrathoracic recurrence, and chest radiography alone revealed recurrence in just one case, while five others were already suspected from serum markers or palpable masses. The authors conclude that the diagnostic yield of follow-up chest radiographs is very low. They recommend weighing its use against radiation exposure and financial cost.

pmid-1774106.summary_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫に生じた皮脂腺系腫瘍の8例（新規5例、既報3例）を報告した研究です。多くは皮脂腺腺腫で、大半は1〜6年のフォローアップ期間中に再発・転移を認めませんでした。皮脂腺分化を伴う基底細胞癌の1例で骨盤内再発がみられ、類皮嚢腫内に生じる稀な単一胚葉性腫瘍と位置づけられています。
pmid-1774106.summary_en: This paper reviews five new cases and three previously reported cases of sebaceous tumors arising in ovarian dermoid cysts, mostly in women around age 58. Lesions were classified as sebaceous adenoma, basal cell carcinoma with sebaceous differentiation, or sebaceous carcinoma. Most cases showed no recurrence or metastasis during follow-up of 1 to 6 years, while one basal cell carcinoma case recurred in the pelvis. The authors describe these tumors as a rare form of monodermal neoplasia within dermoid cysts.

pmid-1774510.summary_ja: 肺絨毛癌の治療後に、精巣の burned-out tumor が疑われた61歳男性の症例報告です。右上葉切除の後、精巣摘除術とVAB-VI化学療法3コースを受け、血清hCG-βは正常化しました。残存した10mm病変を切除し、病理組織学的検査で壊死のみが確認されました。
pmid-1774510.summary_en: This case report describes a 61-year-old man with pulmonary choriocarcinoma who was later found to have a possible burned-out testicular tumor. After right upper lobectomy, he received orchiectomy and three courses of VAB VI chemotherapy, and serum hCG-beta normalized. A residual 10 mm left lung lesion was resected, and histopathology showed nodular necrosis with no viable tumor. The case highlights the diagnostic challenge of a burned-out testicular germ cell tumor discovered after treatment for choriocarcinoma.

pmid-1776472.summary_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍として奇形腫、横紋筋肉腫、セミノーマを併存した36歳男性の症例報告です。横紋筋肉腫は奇形腫の間葉成分由来と考えられています。セミノーマとの合併例は文献上初めての報告で、精巣摘除術、化学療法、放射線照射後3年3か月間無病経過を得ています。
pmid-1776472.summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old man with a testicular mixed germ cell tumor composed of teratoma, rhabdomyosarcoma, and seminoma. The rhabdomyosarcoma was thought to arise from the mesenchymal component of the teratoma. A literature review found six definitive and two possible prior cases of testicular rhabdomyosarcoma with teratoma, but this is the first reported case with associated seminoma. The patient remained disease-free 3 years and 3 months after orchiectomy, chemotherapy, and irradiation.

pmid-1785279.summary_ja: 脳転移を含む転移性妊娠性絨毛癌の25歳女性の症例報告です。甲状腺中毒症を伴っていました。シスプラチン、エトポシド、アクチノマイシンD、髄注メトトレキサートによる多剤化学療法（PEA-M）のみで持続的寛解と甲状腺機能正常化が得られました。治療2年後に妊娠し、正常な満期児を出産しています。
pmid-1785279.summary_en: This case report describes a 25-year-old woman with metastatic gestational choriocarcinoma involving pelvic, pulmonary, and brain metastases, accompanied by thyrotoxicosis. Multiagent chemotherapy with cisplatin, etoposide, actinomycin-D, and intrathecal methotrexate (PEA-M) alone achieved durable remission and a euthyroid state. She conceived two years later and delivered a healthy term infant.

pmid-1786199.summary_ja: ビスタチンはアミノペプチダーゼ阻害薬で、4種の絨毛癌細胞株に対して用量依存的な増殖抑制効果を示した。特にNaUCC-4細胞で顕著であった。作用機序はアミノペプチダーゼBよりLAPまたはAP-Mの阻害に関連すると示唆された。また、アクチノマイシンDの細胞毒性を増強した。宿主介在性の間接的作用に加え、直接的な抗腫瘍効果を持つ可能性が示された。
pmid-1786199.summary_en: This in vitro study tested bestatin, an aminopeptidase inhibitor, on four choriocarcinoma cell lines. Bestatin inhibited growth in a dose-dependent manner, most strongly in NaUCC-4 cells. Inactive and differently potent stereoisomers did not produce the same effect, suggesting the direct action involves leucine aminopeptidase or aminopeptidase M rather than aminopeptidase B. Bestatin also enhanced the cytotoxicity of actinomycin D, suggesting a direct antitumor effect on some cancer cell lines in addition to host-mediated activity.

pmid-1787364.summary_ja: セミノーマの蝶形骨洞への転移を報告している。遠隔原発からの蝶形骨洞転移は稀で、既報は26例とされる。他の副鼻腔へのセミノーマ転移は報告があるが、蝶形骨洞への転移は文献上確認されていないとしている。転移性セミノーマの稀な部位として重要である。
pmid-1787364.summary_en: This report describes a metastatic seminoma involving the sphenoid sinus, a site where metastatic tumors are rarely reported. The authors note that only 26 cases of metastatic sphenoid sinus tumors from distant primaries had been reported before. Seminoma metastasis to other paranasal sinuses had been documented, but a careful literature search found no prior report of sphenoid sinus involvement. The paper highlights this as an unusual site of seminoma spread.

pmid-1790135.summary_ja: 出生直後に発見された眼窩内奇形腫の症例報告である。他に異常のない女児で、臨床症状が強かったため出生後24時間以内に手術が行われた。病理学的にはほぼ全ての組織を含む良性奇形腫であった。フォローアップでは両眼の視機能は良好であった。性器外の胚細胞腫瘍が新生児期に発症した例である。
pmid-1790135.summary_en: This case report describes an orbital teratoma found in an otherwise healthy girl shortly after birth. Because of severe clinical features, surgery was performed within 24 hours. Histology showed a benign teratoma containing nearly all tissue types. At follow-up, bilateral visual function was satisfactory and the child was doing well. The report illustrates an extragonadal germ cell tumor presenting in the neonatal period.

pmid-1791020.summary_ja: 原発性縦隔胎児性癌の稀な1例を報告している。胚細胞腫瘍が縦隔に原発することは広く認められているが、縦隔の胎児性癌の報告は極めて少ない。本症例の放射線学的所見およびコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)所見が示されている。性器外の胚細胞腫瘍の希少な亜型に関する限られた文献を補うものである。
pmid-1791020.summary_en: This report describes a rare case of primary mediastinal embryonal carcinoma. The authors note that germ cell tumors can arise primarily in the mediastinum and that primary extragenital seminoma has been documented there, but primary mediastinal embryonal carcinoma has rarely been reported. Radiological and CT features of the patient are presented. The paper adds to the limited literature on this extragonadal germ cell tumor subtype.

pmid-1797370.summary_ja: 原発性無月経の17歳女性で、46,XY純粋性性腺異形成と診断された症例報告である。胚細胞腫瘍の高いリスクから両側卵管卵巣摘出術と子宮全摘術が行われた。左卵巣の病理検査で偶発的に性腺芽腫が見つかった。その後のホルモン療法により、1年後に二次性徴が出現した。本症例は性腺の悪性化リスクに対する管理の重要性を示す。
pmid-1797370.summary_en: This case report describes a 17-year-old phenotypic female with 46,XY pure gonadal dysgenesis who presented with primary amenorrhea. Chromosome analysis confirmed a 46,XY karyotype and endocrine testing showed hypogonadism. Because of the high risk of germ cell tumor in such patients, bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy and hysterectomy were performed. Pathology incidentally revealed gonadoblastoma in the left ovary. After hormone therapy, secondary sexual development appeared one year later.

pmid-1801608.summary_ja: 精子バンキングに紹介された146例を後方視的に解析し、がんの存在が凍結保存後の精液品質に与える影響を検討した研究です。対象は対照群、リンパ腫・ホジキン病群、精巣がん群（セミノーマ、胎児性癌、奇形癌を含む）に分けられました。精子数、凍結前後の運動率と速度は、精巣がん群とリンパ腫群で対照群より有意に低下していました。がんの存在が精液品質を悪化させると結論づけています。
pmid-1801608.summary_en: This retrospective study of 146 men referred for sperm banking examined how cancer diagnosis affects semen quality after cryopreservation. Patients were grouped as prevasectomy controls, lymphoma or Hodgkin's disease patients, or testicular cancer patients including seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, and teratocarcinoma. Sperm count, prefreeze and postthaw motility, and velocity were significantly reduced in both cancer groups compared with controls. Specimens from controls retained good motility after thawing. The authors conclude that the presence of cancer adversely affects semen quality.

pmid-1803248.summary_ja: 播種性精巣がんが初期治療後6年および8年に再発した症例を報告し、晩期再発に関する文献をレビューした論文です。治癒が期待される患者の約4%が2年以上経過後に再発するとされています。病変の範囲が限られていればサルベージ療法が有効であるため、早期発見が重要であり、無期限のフォローアップを推奨しています。
pmid-1803248.summary_en: This case report describes disseminated testicular cancer that relapsed after six and eight years. The authors also review the literature on late relapses. They estimate that about 4% of potentially cured patients relapse after two or more years. They recommend indefinite follow-up, because salvage therapy can remain effective when disease extent is limited. Early detection of late relapse is therefore emphasized in long-term surveillance.

pmid-1815013.summary_ja: インド・パンジャブ州の病理部で10年間に診断された奇形腫267例のうち、稀少部位の10例を検討した症例シリーズである。後腹膜と口腔底が各3例で、縦隔、甲状腺、膀胱、腎臓が各1例であった。術前に奇形腫が疑われた症例はなく、追跡し得た症例では長期生存と再発は認められなかった。非典型部位の奇形腫は術前に疑われにくいことを示している。
pmid-1815013.summary_en: This series reviews ten teratomas arising at rare sites, drawn from 267 teratomas diagnosed over a decade at a single pathology department in Punjab, India. Three occurred in the retroperitoneum, three in the floor of the mouth, and one each in the mediastinum, thyroid, urinary bladder, and kidney. None were clinically suspected as teratoma. Immature elements were present in all solid or mixed lesions, and all but one patient survived for 1 to 8 years without recurrence. The study highlights that teratomas at atypical sites may be unsuspected preoperatively.

pmid-1819328.summary_ja: 精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の小児患者が、硬膜外転移による脊髄圧迫で発症した症例報告である。卵黄嚢腫瘍は小児精巣腫瘍で最も一般的な悪性胚細胞腫瘍であり、通常は後腹膜リンパ節に広がる。著者らは、精巣YSTが脊髄硬膜外腔に転移した報告は見当たらなかったと述べている。本例は小児精巣胚細胞腫瘍の転移パターンの範囲を広げ、神経症状の鑑別で硬膜外病変を考慮する必要性を示す。
pmid-1819328.summary_en: This case report describes a child with testicular yolk sac tumor who presented with spinal cord compression caused by epidural metastasis, an unusual site of spread. The authors note that yolk sac tumor is the most common malignant germinal tumor in pediatric testicular tumors and typically spreads to retroperitoneal lymph nodes. They could find no previous report of testicular YST metastasizing to the spinal epidural space. The case extends the recognized range of metastatic patterns for pediatric testicular germ cell tumors and highlights the need to consider epidural disease in neurologic presentations.

pmid-1823051.summary_ja: β-hCG陽性のセミノーマで対側精巣に精巣上皮内腫瘍（TIN）を認めた33歳男性の症例報告である。後腹膜の巨大病変（病期IIc）にカルボプラチン単剤療法を行い、画像と血清学的に完全寛解を得たが、精巣生検で持続するTINが確認された。精巣への20 Gyの局所放射線療法によりTINは消失した。著者らは、化学療法はTINの治療に安全ではないと結論づけている。
pmid-1823051.summary_en: A 33-year-old man with beta-hCG-positive seminoma and contralateral testicular intraepithelial neoplasia (TIN) received carboplatin after bulky retroperitoneal disease (stage IIc). Radiological and serological complete remission occurred after three cycles, but testicular biopsy showed persistent TIN. Local radiotherapy of 20 Gy to the testis eliminated TIN. The authors conclude that chemotherapy is not safe for treating TIN and usually cannot prevent contralateral testicular tumors.

pmid-1829907.summary_ja: 播種性非セミノーマ性精巣がん239例に化学療法を施行し、102例が残存腫瘤切除を受けた。成熟奇形腫の患者では長期フォローアップ後に88%、残存癌では59%が無病生存していた。残存癌の予後は手術の完全性と化学療法前の腫瘤量に相関した。前腕に発育した成熟奇形腫の稀な症例も報告されている。
pmid-1829907.summary_en: The EORTC GU Group followed 239 patients with disseminated non-seminomatous testicular cancer treated with cisplatin, vinblastine and bleomycin, and 102 underwent resection of residual masses. Of the resected specimens, 27 contained mature teratoma and 22 residual carcinoma. After follow-up of 74-112 months, 88% and 59% respectively were alive and disease-free. Prognosis in residual carcinoma correlated with surgical completeness and pre-chemotherapy tumor mass. A rare growing mature teratoma on the forearm is described.

pmid-1830415.summary_ja: アイルランド精巣腫瘍登録は、アイルランドの精巣がんの死亡率と罹患率を英国や他国と比較した。25〜34歳の死亡率は1961〜1984年に123%上昇した一方、イングランドとウェールズでは17%低下した。セミノーマの3年生存率は80%、非セミノーマは65%だった。標準用量の細胞傷害性薬剤を受けない患者や腫瘍マーカー測定を省略した場合は生存率が低かった。CT監視の頻度低下も生存率低下と関連した。
pmid-1830415.summary_en: The Irish Testis Tumor Registry compared Irish testicular cancer mortality and incidence with England, Wales, and other countries. Irish mortality among ages 25-34 rose 123% from 1961 to 1984, while England and Wales fell 17%. Incidence was 2.4 per 100,000 men per year. Three-year survival was 80% for seminoma and 65% for non-seminoma. Survival was lower without full-dose cytotoxics, and it fell to 64% when markers were omitted. Infrequent CT monitoring was also associated with reduced survival.

pmid-1833691.summary_ja: 子宮外妊娠に対する腹腔鏡検査中に、卵管の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が偶然発見された症例です。この合併例は文献上5例のみ報告されており、既報の卵管奇形腫を総括しています。卵巣以外に生じる稀な胚細胞腫瘍の臨床像を示す貴重な報告です。妊娠中の鑑別診断として留意すべき点も示しています。
pmid-1833691.summary_en: The authors report a mature cystic teratoma of the fallopian tube discovered incidentally at laparoscopy for an ectopic pregnancy. Only five prior cases of this combination exist in the literature. The report reviews all previously described tubal teratomas and summarizes cases occurring alongside tubal ectopic pregnancy. Because such tumors are exceptionally rare, the paper contributes primarily clinical documentation of an unusual extragonadal germ cell tumor presentation at a non-ovarian site.

pmid-1835849.summary_ja: 抗体指向性酵素プロドラッグ療法（ADEPT）を、ヌードマウスの絨毛癌異種移植に適用した前臨床研究です。抗hCG抗体にCPG2を結合させ、腫瘍内で活性化される新規プロドラッグを投与しました。従来の化学療法に抵抗性の移植腫瘍に対し、1コースの治療で生存期間を有意に延長しました。
pmid-1835849.summary_en: Three novel protected bifunctional alkylating prodrugs are tested in antibody-directed enzyme prodrug therapy (ADEPT) against human choriocarcinoma xenografts in nude mice. Anti-hCG antibodies conjugated to carboxypeptidase G2 are given first, followed by each prodrug, which activates within the tumor. Kinetic constants of the conjugates are determined. A single treatment course significantly prolonged survival in three regimens, showing that tumor-localized bacterial enzymes can activate prodrugs to eradicate established xenografts resistant to conventional chemotherapy.

pmid-1835852.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の男性177例を対象に、治療前後の父性を調べた研究です。治療後に子どもを望んだ男性の53%が、治療5年後も不妊に悩んでいました。精巣摘除術単独と、シスプラチン併用化学療法や横隔膜下照射との間で有意差は認められませんでした。出生児の先天奇形率はデンマークの全国平均を超えませんでした。
pmid-1835852.summary_en: This study assesses paternity before and after treatment in 177 men with unilateral testicular germ cell tumours. Before diagnosis, 51% had fathered children, and an estimated 72% would have by age 40. After treatment, infertility persisted in 53% of men who wished to have children at five years. Fertility outcomes did not differ significantly between orchiectomy alone and cisplatin-based chemotherapy or subdiaphragmatic irradiation. Congenital malformation rates in offspring did not exceed the national rate.

pmid-1839425.summary_ja: 1985年に胞状奇胎のため全摘出術を受けた56歳のマレーシア人女性が、1990年に喀血と呼吸困難で受診した。絨毛癌と肺転移・腎転移と診断された。絨毛癌は肺、肝、脳に転移しやすいが、腎転移は稀であることが述べられており、本症例はその稀な転移形式を示す報告である。
pmid-1839425.summary_en: This case report describes a 56-year-old Malay woman who had total abdominal hysterectomy in 1985 for molar pregnancy. In 1990 she presented with haemoptysis and dyspnea, and was diagnosed with choriocarcinoma with pulmonary and renal metastases. The authors note that choriocarcinoma commonly spreads to lungs, liver, and brain, while renal metastasis is rare. The report highlights this uncommon pattern of renal involvement, which occurred years after hysterectomy.

pmid-1839922.summary_ja: 子宮穿孔を起こした稀な侵入奇胎の症例で、卵巣腫瘍と誤認された非典型的な提示様式を報告している。診断が困難であったことから、骨盤内腫瘤の鑑別において高い疑いを持つことの重要性を強調している。妊娠性絨毛性疾患を骨盤内腫瘤の鑑別に含める必要性を示す報告である。
pmid-1839922.summary_en: This case report describes a rare invasive mole that caused uterine perforation and presented unusually, being mistaken for an ovarian tumour. The authors emphasize that the diagnosis was difficult and that clinicians need a high index of suspicion for invasive mole when a pelvic mass with uncommon features is encountered. The short report focuses on the diagnostic pitfall rather than treatment details, underscoring the need to consider gestational trophoblastic disease in the differential diagnosis of pelvic masses in women of reproductive age.

pmid-1840451.summary_ja: 原発性無月経を訴えた18歳の表現型女性(46,XY)に発生した両側性純粋型性腺芽腫の症例である。開腹術で線条性性腺と低形成子宮が確認された。組織学的に胚細胞と性索由来成分が硝子様物質を伴う特徴的な胞巣を形成していた。性分化疾患例での認識の重要性を示す報告である。
pmid-1840451.summary_en: This case report describes a rare bilateral pure gonadoblastoma in an 18-year-old phenotypic female with a 46,XY karyotype who presented with primary amenorrhoea. Exploratory laparotomy revealed streak gonads and a hypoplastic uterus, and histology showed germ cells with sex cord derivatives in characteristic nests containing hyaline material. The authors note that the tumour accounted for only 0.2% of ovarian tumours seen at their institution over seven years, underscoring its rarity and the importance of recognising it in individuals with disorders of sex development.

pmid-1845272.summary_ja: 上咽頭に発生し気道を閉塞した真性奇形腫の新生児2例を報告している。1例は外科的切除後10年以上のフォローアップが行われた。もう1例は穿刺吸引細胞診と磁気共鳴画像法で評価された。両例とも中枢神経系の異常を伴っていた可能性があり、診断法と手術手技の利点も議論されている。
pmid-1845272.summary_en: This report describes two neonates with obstructing true teratomas of the nasopharynx, a rare tumour type. The first patient was followed for over ten years after surgical resection. The second was evaluated with fine-needle aspiration and magnetic resonance imaging before treatment. The authors discuss the advantages of these diagnostic studies and alternative surgical techniques. Both patients may have had central nervous system abnormalities, a possible association that is noted in the report.

pmid-1845936.summary_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍または卵黄嚢成分を含む胚細胞腫瘍の卵巣癌29例を、減量手術と併用化学療法で治療し解析した研究である。病期I、残存腫瘍なし、腹水が少ないことが良好な予後と関連していた。進行例ではシスプラチンを含む化学療法レジメンが優れていた。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)値は予後と相関しなかった。
pmid-1845936.summary_en: This clinicopathologic study analyzed 29 ovarian cancer patients with yolk sac tumours or germ cell tumours containing yolk sac elements, treated with cytoreductive surgery and combination chemotherapy. Stage I disease, absence of residual tumour, and minimal ascites were associated with better prognosis. Endodermal sinus tumour with intestinal or microcystic patterns was more common among survivors. Age, preoperative AFP, and tumour size did not correlate with outcome. Cisplatin-containing regimens outperformed vincristine, dactinomycin, and cyclophosphamide in advanced disease.

pmid-1845937.summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍82例に対し、エトポシドとシスプラチンの2剤化学療法を施行した1991年の報告。76例が完全奏効に至り、残存病変の切除を受けた56%の大半では奇形腫や壊死・線維化が認められた。9例が再発したが、追加治療で救済された。中央値63か月の観察で87%が無病生存を維持し、17.5か月以降の再発は認められなかった。
pmid-1845937.summary_en: This 1991 Cancer study evaluated 82 patients with metastatic germ cell tumors treated with two-drug therapy of etoposide and cisplatin. Seventy-six achieved complete response, and 56% of patients underwent excision of residual masses, which most often showed teratoma or necrosis. Nine patients relapsed at 6 to 17.5 months, and three were salvaged with additional treatment. With a median follow-up of 63 months, 87% remained disease-free, with no relapses beyond 17.5 months. The authors conclude that this regimen at these doses and schedule yields durable remission without late relapse.

pmid-1846052.summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍を有する23歳男性の症例報告。触診は正常だったが、右精巣の超音波検査で異常が認められた。精巣摘除術により精細管内胚細胞腫瘍と精巣微小石灰化が確認され、超音波所見の多発エコー源性病変と組織所見が一致した。超音波検査は高リスク者のスクリーニングの補助となりうると著者らは示唆し、さらなる検討を提案している。
pmid-1846052.summary_en: This 1991 Urology report describes a 23-year-old man with metastatic germ cell tumor whose testicular examination was normal but whose ultrasonography of the right testis was abnormal. Orchiectomy showed intratubular germ cell neoplasia with testicular microlithiasis, and the histology matched the multiple echogenic foci seen on ultrasound. The authors suggest that ultrasonography may serve as an adjunct for screening individuals at risk for intratubular germ cell neoplasia, and recommend further studies to assess this role.

pmid-1846053.summary_ja: フォン・ヒッペル・リンドウ病の患者に発生した精巣の胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。これまで本疾患と精巣胚細胞腫瘍の関連は報告されていなかった。VHL病では多様な病理学的病変が生じ得るため、患者の詳細な評価と注意深いフォローアップが、潜在的に悪性の病変の早期発見に重要であると著者らは強調している。
pmid-1846053.summary_en: This 1991 Urology case report describes a germ cell tumor of the testis in a patient with von Hippel-Lindau disease, a combination not previously reported. The authors highlight that VHL disease presents a range of pathologic lesions, so thorough patient evaluation is essential. They emphasize careful follow-up to allow early detection of potentially malignant lesions. The report is a brief case-based note and does not include detailed treatment outcomes or long-term survival data for the patient.

pmid-1846603.summary_ja: 1962～1987年に治療された悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の若年女性28例について、妊孕性温存を行った結果を検討した1991年の報告。未熟奇形腫と卵黄嚢腫瘍が多く、病期Iが大半だった。術後化学療法はほぼ全例に施行された。22例が持続的寛解を得て、妊娠を希望した症例の多くが妊娠に至った。対側卵巣と子宮が正常であれば、病期によらず妊孕性温存は安全かつ実施可能と結論づけている。
pmid-1846603.summary_en: This 1991 Gynecologic Oncology report reviews 28 young patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors treated from 1962 to 1987 with fertility preservation. Most had immature teratoma or endodermal sinus tumor, and most had stage I disease. Nearly all received postoperative chemotherapy. Twenty-two patients achieved persistent remission, and most who desired children became pregnant. The authors conclude that fertility preservation is safe and practicable regardless of stage, provided the contralateral ovary and uterus are uninvolved.

pmid-1847005.summary_ja: 1969年から1988年に治療された妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍1391例を解析した1991年の報告。全体の治癒率は93%で、死亡例はすべて転移性絨毛癌であった。転移例では、転移数や転移部位、絨毛癌の組織型、既治療の化学療法不応などが生存の独立因子であった。著者らは新たなBrewerスコアを提案し、WHOスコアと同等の予測能を示し、Hammond分類やFIGO病期より優れていた。
pmid-1847005.summary_en: This 1991 American Journal of Obstetrics and Gynecology study analyzes 1391 patients with gestational trophoblastic tumors treated at Northwestern University from 1969 to 1988. The overall cure rate was 93%, and all deaths occurred in patients with metastatic choriocarcinoma. In metastatic disease, multivariate analysis identified metastasis number, metastatic sites, choriocarcinoma diagnosis, and prior failed chemotherapy as survival predictors. The authors proposed the Brewer score, which predicted outcome comparably to the WHO score and outperformed the Hammond classification and FIGO stage.

pmid-1847433.summary_ja: 組織起源が不明な癌腫9例を細胞遺伝学的解析とサザンブロット解析で検討した研究。12p異常を示した4例は胚細胞腫瘍と診断され、うち3例はシスプラチン併用化学療法で完全奏効した。遺伝学的解析により9例中6例で診断が得られ、1例は非ホジキンリンパ腫に再分類された。
pmid-1847433.summary_en: Nine patients with carcinomas of uncertain histology, mostly poorly differentiated midline tumors, were analyzed by cytogenetics and Southern blotting. Four of the eight poorly differentiated carcinomas showed chromosome 12p abnormalities consistent with germ cell tumor, and three of these four responded to cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Genetic analysis yielded a diagnosis in six of nine cases, including reclassification of one case to non-Hodgkin lymphoma. The authors conclude that cytogenetic and molecular tests can help determine histogenesis in selected poorly differentiated carcinomas.

pmid-1848396.summary_ja: 原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍を化学療法と外科的切除で寛解させた若年男性が、6か月後に全身性肥満細胞症を発症した症例報告。低血圧、失神、胃出血、凝固異常を呈し、骨髄および肝生検で診断された。胚細胞腫瘍に関連する血液疾患の一つとして考慮すべきと述べている。
pmid-1848396.summary_en: The authors describe a young man with systemic mast cell disease diagnosed six months after complete remission of a primary mediastinal germ cell tumor treated with chemotherapy and surgical resection. He developed recurrent hypotension and syncope, then gastric hemorrhage and coagulopathy. Bone marrow and liver biopsies confirmed systemic mast cell disease, and a transient circulating heparin-like anticoagulant was detected. The authors suggest this association is not coincidental and that systemic mast cell disease should be considered among germ cell tumor-associated hematologic disorders.

pmid-1848821.summary_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で、シスプラチン併用化学療法後に後腹膜腫瘤が3cm超だった122例の後方視的検討。切除標本は壊死が47%、奇形腫が39%、残存悪性腫瘍が14%であった。化学療法後の腫瘤サイズと縮小率が病理所見と相関し、残存腫瘤が1.5cm未満でも奇形腫や悪性腫瘍が含まれる例があった。著者らは化療前腫瘤3cm以上の全例に後腹膜リンパ節郭清を推奨している。
pmid-1848821.summary_en: This retrospective study of 122 patients who underwent postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) for bulky nonseminomatous germ cell tumor after cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Histology showed necrosis in 47%, teratoma in 39%, and residual malignancy in 14%. Postchemotherapy mass size and degree of shrinkage correlated with pathology, and residual masses under 1.5 cm still harbored teratoma or malignancy in some patients. The authors recommend RPLND for all prechemotherapy masses of 3 cm or larger.

pmid-1848823.summary_ja: 直径1.2cmの典型的な精巣セミノーマに、広範な精細管内胚細胞腫瘍（IGCT）と精細管の進行性硬化が伴った1例の報告。形態、組織化学、免疫組織化学的所見から、IGCT、間質の腫瘍細胞、セミノーマの同一性を確認した。著者らは、この症例を基に、IGCT、精巣の胚細胞腫瘍、「burned-out」腫瘍の相互関係を提唱している。
pmid-1848823.summary_en: This report describes a 1.2 cm typical testicular seminoma associated with extensive intratubular germ cell tumor (IGCT) and progressive sclerosis of seminiferous tubules. Morphologic, histochemical, and immunohistochemical features linked the IGCT, interstitial neoplastic cells, and seminoma. Based on this case, the authors propose an interrelation between IGCT, germinal testicular tumors, and the burned-out tumor, a regressed germ cell neoplasm that leaves only fibrosis.

pmid-1848837.summary_ja: 17歳女性の卵巣に生じた、ポリエンブリオーマ成分が目立つ混合型胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。初回に外科的切除を受けた。1年後と3年後に、成熟および未熟奇形腫からなる転移性腫瘍が腹腔内から切除された。初回手術から11年後も生存し健康であり、再発を繰り返した若年患者の長期生存例として報告されている。
pmid-1848837.summary_en: A 17-year-old woman had a mixed germ cell tumor of the ovary with a prominent polyembryoma component and abundant vascular tissue. She underwent surgical resection. One and three years later, metastatic deposits composed of mature and immature teratoma were removed from the abdominal cavity. Eleven years after the original surgery, she remained alive and well. The report documents long-term survival in a young patient with recurrent metastatic ovarian germ cell disease.

pmid-1848902.summary_ja: ニューイングランド絨毛性疾患センターで管理された妊娠性絨毛性疾患（GTD）患者2,100例中、卵管原発の16例（0.8%）を検討した。内訳は卵管部分胞状奇胎、全胞状奇胎、絨毛癌であった。臨床的には通常の卵管妊娠と区別できなかった。転移は卵管胞状奇胎の1例と卵管絨毛癌の4例に認められた。全例が完全かつ持続的寛解に至り、まれな病態の予後は良好であった。
pmid-1848902.summary_en: This study reviewed 16 cases of tubal gestational trophoblastic disease among 2,100 women treated at the New England Trophoblastic Disease Center, accounting for 0.8%. The tubal lesions included partial mole, complete mole, and choriocarcinoma. Clinically, tubal GTD could not be distinguished from ordinary tubal pregnancy. Metastases occurred in one tubal mole and four tubal choriocarcinomas. All patients achieved complete and sustained remission, supporting the favorable prognosis of this rare presentation.

pmid-1848964.summary_ja: ワシントン州西部で行われた症例対照研究。精巣の胚細胞腫瘍の男性323例と対照658例を比較し、職業と精巣がんリスクの関連を検討した。電気工（RR 2.8）や船員・漁師（RR 3.1）などでリスク上昇が見られた。複数の研究を通じて一貫した職業関連はなく、ホワイトカラーの過剰は職業曝露ではなく社会経済的地位を反映している可能性が示唆された。
pmid-1848964.summary_en: This case-control study in western Washington examined whether occupation affects testicular cancer risk, comparing 323 men with testicular germ cell tumors to 658 population controls. Several occupations, including electricians (RR 2.8) and sailors/fishermen (RR 3.1), showed elevated risk, as did farmers. Overall, no consistent occupational association has emerged across studies. The authors suggest the white-collar excess may reflect socioeconomic status rather than specific occupational exposures.

pmid-1849112.summary_ja: 卵巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍に由来し、多数の胚様体を含むポリエンブリオーマが遊走して形成された、極めてまれな後腹膜腫瘍の症例報告。化学療法後に大動脈の人工血管置換を併用して切除された。転移後や化学療法後の胚様体の動態についても考察しており、播種性のポリエンブリオーマ成分が治療に反応する様子を理解する手がかりとなる。
pmid-1849112.summary_en: The authors describe a very rare retroperitoneal tumor formed by migrating polyembryoma containing numerous embryoid bodies, arising from an ovarian mixed germ cell tumor. The mass was removed after chemotherapy, requiring combined artificial replacement of the aorta. The report also discusses the fate of embryoid bodies after metastasis or chemotherapy, offering insight into how polyembryomatous elements behave when they spread and respond to treatment.

pmid-1849357.summary_ja: ヒト胎盤から肝細胞増殖因子（HGF）を精製し、血漿からの約100〜200倍の収量を得た。免疫組織化学により、絨毛合胞体栄養膜、絨毛外栄養膜、羊膜上皮での強い発現を示した。完全胞状奇胎、絨毛癌、枯死卵の栄養膜でもHGFが検出され、妊娠性絨毛性疾患を含む増殖の盛んな組織におけるHGFの増殖調節作用を示唆している。
pmid-1849357.summary_en: The authors purified hepatocyte growth factor (HGF) from human placenta, yielding about 100 to 200 times more than from plasma, and mapped its distribution by immunohistochemistry. HGF was strongly expressed in villous syncytiotrophoblast, extravillous trophoblast, and amnion epithelium. It was also detected in complete hydatidiform moles, choriocarcinomas, and a blighted ovum, suggesting that HGF's growth-regulating role extends beyond hepatocytes to rapidly proliferating and trophoblastic tissues.

pmid-1851024.summary_ja: 縦隔悪性胚細胞腫瘍15例の治療成績を検討した。セミノーマ9例、非セミノーマ6例で、非セミノーマにはシスプラチン併用化学療法が施行された。完全奏効率はセミノーマ71%、非セミノーマ33%で、セミノーマの生存期間が長かった。非セミノーマに対してはより良い治療法の開発が必要と結論された。
pmid-1851024.summary_en: This study of 15 patients with malignant germ cell tumors of the mediastinum compares outcomes between 9 pure seminomas and 6 non-seminomas. Non-seminoma patients received cisplatin-based chemotherapy, with radical resection in only four. Complete response rates were 71% for seminoma and 33% for non-seminoma. Three- and five-year survival were 67% and 33% for seminoma patients, who survived longer. The authors conclude that non-seminomas need a better therapeutic approach.

pmid-1851025.summary_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の男性患者の尿から精製したヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の糖鎖構造を解析した。ヒドラジン分解や酵素消化などにより、8種類の糖鎖を同定した。これらは女性の妊娠性絨毛癌由来hCGと同一の構造を示し、腫瘍由来hCGの糖鎖の特徴が共通することが示唆された。
pmid-1851025.summary_en: Human chorionic gonadotropin was purified from the urine of a male patient with an extragonadal germ cell tumor, and its asparagine-linked sugar chains were analyzed. Using hydrazinolysis, exoglycosidase digestion, methylation analysis and lectin chromatography, the authors identified eight sugar chain types, including triantennary, biantennary and monoantennary structures. These structures matched those of hCG from female gestational choriocarcinoma, suggesting that tumor-derived hCG shares glycosylation features across germ cell and trophoblastic tumors.

pmid-1851626.summary_ja: 原発性後腹膜悪性胚細胞腫瘍の男性14例をCTで検討した。大きく分葉した混合濃度の腫瘤が特徴で、大動脈や下大静脈への浸潤が見られた。転移は肺、肝臓、縦隔に多く、11例で血清腫瘍マーカーが上昇していた。大きな後腹膜腫瘤を認めた際には、性腺外胚細胞腫瘍を考慮すべきと結論された。
pmid-1851626.summary_en: This CT study of 14 men with primary malignant germ cell tumors of the retroperitoneum included 2 seminomas and 12 non-seminomatous tumors. Masses were large, lobulated and of mixed density, with frequent fat plane obliteration. The aorta was embedded in 9 patients and the inferior vena cava was affected in 7. Common metastatic sites were lung, liver and mediastinum, and serum biomarkers were elevated in 11. An extragonadal germ cell tumor should be considered when a large mixed-density retroperitoneal mass is seen.

pmid-1851881.summary_ja: HPV16のE6・E7遺伝子を導入したトランスジェニックマウスを作製し、in vivoでの形質転換活性を検討しました。3系統すべてで胚細胞由来の精巣腫瘍が発生し、組織学的にセミノーマと同定されました。腫瘍からはHPV mRNAが高発現しており、HPV16の癌遺伝子が精巣の胚細胞に優先的に作用することが示唆されます。
pmid-1851881.summary_en: Transgenic mice carrying the E6 and E7 open reading frames of human papillomavirus type 16 (HPV16) were generated to test their transforming activity in vivo. Testicular tumors of germ cell origin developed in all three transgenic lineages, and histology identified them as seminomas. Both testes were affected in tumor-bearing mice, and in one lineage all males developed the tumor. HPV mRNA was highly expressed in these tumors, suggesting that HPV16 oncogenes have transforming activity in vivo with preferential effects on testicular germ cells.

pmid-1855190.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の両側発生に関わる危険因子を、同時性4例・異時性19例の計23例で検討しました。停留精巣の頻度は片側例と差がなく、初発腫瘍の組織型も異時性発生に影響しませんでした。HLA解析では異時性群でHLA-B14が有意に高頻度でした。遺伝的要因が関与している可能性が示唆されます。
pmid-1855190.summary_en: This study examined potential risk factors for bilateral testicular germ cell tumors in 23 patients, including 4 with synchronous and 19 with sequential tumors. Maldescensus testis was not more frequent than in unilateral disease, and the histology of the first tumor did not affect the risk of a second. HLA typing in 21 patients showed HLA-B14 significantly increased in the sequential group, with trends for HLA-DR5 and DR7. The authors conclude that genetic factors may contribute to sequential bilateral testicular cancer.

pmid-1855534.summary_ja: 進行精巣がんの化学療法後に生じうる、切除不能な増大する成熟奇形腫の症例報告です。局所で制御不能に増大し死亡につながることがあります。本症例ではリンホブラストイド・インターフェロンにより長期の病勢安定が得られ、手術困難例の治療選択肢となり得ることを示唆しています。
pmid-1855534.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with an unresectable growing mature teratoma, a complication that can follow chemotherapy for advanced testicular cancer and may eventually cause death through uncontrolled local growth. The patient achieved long-lasting disease stabilization after treatment with lymphoblastoid interferon, suggesting that this agent may be a therapeutic option when surgery is not feasible.

pmid-1858745.summary_ja: 48歳の日本人女性に生じた、空腸原発の性腺外絨毛癌の症例報告です。食後の上腹部痛と嘔吐を呈し、血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が上昇していました。部分切除で絨毛癌と診断され、hCG免疫染色は陽性で転移は認められませんでした。小腸腫瘍の鑑別診断として本疾患を考慮すべきと述べています。
pmid-1858745.summary_en: This case report describes a 48-year-old Japanese woman with extragenital choriocarcinoma arising in the jejunum, presenting with postprandial abdominal pain and vomiting. Serum hCG was elevated, and resection showed choriocarcinoma with positive hCG immunostaining and no metastasis. The authors note that only seven similar cases had been reported and emphasize including this entity in the differential diagnosis of small intestinal neoplasms.

pmid-1862090.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍67例と非胚細胞性悪性腫瘍4例で網膜芽腫(RB)遺伝子の発現を調べた研究です。全ての胚細胞腫瘍でRBのmRNA発現が低下しており、セミノーマと非セミノーマの両方で認められました。RBタンパクは未分化細胞では検出されず、分化した奇形癌細胞では多くが発現していました。DNAレベルの明らかな異常は認められず、遺伝子変異ではなく転写レベルの制御が関与すると示唆されています。
pmid-1862090.summary_en: This study examined retinoblastoma (RB) gene expression in 67 primary testicular germ-cell tumors and 4 non-germ-cell testicular malignancies. RB transcript levels were decreased in all germ-cell tumors, including seminomas and nonseminomas. RB protein was undetectable in undifferentiated tumor cells but present in differentiated cells of most teratocarcinomas.
