pmid-2171286.summary_en: This study evaluates fine needle aspiration (FNA) cytology for classifying testicular germ cell tumors in 13 patients preoperatively. Cytologic typing based on seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, choriocarcinoma, and teratoma components agreed well with histology. Most cases showed mixed components, with up to four tumor types. The authors conclude FNA cytology may also help identify metastatic germ cell tumors at extragonadal sites.

pmid-2171316.summary_ja: 本研究は、臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者24例を後方視的に検討した。精巣摘除術後に注意深く観察し、25%が再発したが全例が化学療法で寛解した。信頼できる患者と十分なフォローアップが可能な施設では、精巣摘除術後の注意深い観察が妥当な選択肢になると結論している。
pmid-2171316.summary_en: This retrospective Mayo Clinic series followed 24 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis managed by orchiectomy alone and close observation. Median follow-up was 47 months. Six patients (25%) relapsed, typically within 3.5 months; all were successfully treated with chemotherapy and remained in remission. The remaining 18 patients stayed disease-free. The authors conclude that observation after orchiectomy is reasonable in reliable patients treated at well-equipped centers with dependable follow-up.

pmid-2171750.summary_ja: 精巣がんの患者2例で、画像上は縦隔や肺への転移に見える所見が、実際にはサルコイド反応であった。診断時と診断12か月後にそれぞれ認められた。セミノーマと非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍が混在する症例であった。組織学的確認を行わないと不要な化学療法につながるため、病理学的な確認が重要であると指摘している。
pmid-2171750.summary_en: This report describes two patients with testicular cancer combining seminomatous and nonseminomatous germ cell components. Both showed isolated sarcoid reactions in hilar and interlobular lymph nodes that mimicked intrathoracic dissemination on radiologic imaging. One reaction was present at diagnosis and the other 12 months later. Without histologic confirmation, these findings could lead to unnecessary chemotherapy, so tissue diagnosis is essential when intrathoracic lesions appear during surveillance.

pmid-2172569.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍85例に修正後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行した。病理病期Aの再発は6%、B1は15%だった。順行性射精は94%で温存または回復し、低病期の精巣がんでは監視療法に代わる選択肢になると結論している。追跡期間中央値は38か月であった。
pmid-2172569.summary_en: Eighty-five patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis underwent modified bilateral retroperitoneal lymph node dissection via a thoracoabdominal approach. Most had pathologic stage A disease. Relapses occurred in 6% of stage A and 15% of stage B1 patients. Antegrade ejaculation was preserved or restored in 94% of patients, using imipramine when needed. With median follow-up of 38 months, the authors conclude that the technique preserves ejaculation and is a preferred alternative to surveillance for low-stage disease.

pmid-2173132.summary_ja: 本論文は、精巣の病期II非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍と全身性サルコイドーシスを併存した患者の症例を報告している。精巣胚細胞腫瘍とサルコイドーシスの併存に関する既存文献をレビューし、診断上の問題点について考察している。病期II非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の診断における課題を示した症例報告である。
pmid-2173132.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with stage II nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis who also had generalized sarcoidosis. The authors review the existing literature on coexisting sarcoidosis and testicular germ cell tumor. They discuss the diagnostic problem these two conditions pose together. The report highlights how sarcoidosis can complicate the assessment of disease in patients with testicular germ cell tumor.

pmid-2173292.summary_ja: バーゼル大学小児病院で治療した小児精巣腫瘍20例を検討した。胚細胞腫瘍と非胚細胞腫瘍が各10例であった。良性病変は局所切除、悪性胚細胞腫瘍は精巣摘除術を基本とし、腫瘍マーカーが高値持続時のみ化学療法等を追加した。悪性例5例は全例生存し、平均12年の長期フォローアップで再発は認められなかった。
pmid-2173292.summary_en: This Basel Children's Hospital review covers 20 pediatric testicular tumours, half germ cell and half non-germ cell. Germ cell tumours included benign teratomas, yolk sac tumours, and teratocarcinomas. The authors advocate local excision for benign lesions confirmed on frozen section and primary orchiectomy for malignant germ cell tumours, adding chemotherapy or retroperitoneal dissection only when tumor markers remain elevated. All five malignant cases survived, with no recurrence after a mean 12-year follow-up.

pmid-2174237.summary_ja: 本論文は、精巣がんが20〜44歳男性で最も多い悪性腫瘍であることを指摘し、早期診断の重要性を強調している。転移例でも約80%が治癒可能となった現在、かかりつけ医は患者教育と専門施設への早期紹介を担うべきだと述べている。
pmid-2174237.summary_en: This 1990 Australian review emphasizes that testicular cancer is the most common malignancy in men aged 20 to 44 years. Early diagnosis improves cure rates and reduces treatment severity, and about 80% of patients with metastatic disease can now be cured. The authors urge family physicians to educate patients, stay alert for the diagnosis, and refer suspected cases to specialist urologists or cancer centres, because errors of judgment by inexperienced practitioners may become a leading cause of death.

pmid-2174300.summary_ja: シスプラチン抵抗性の胚細胞腫瘍42例に対しVIP療法（エトポシド・イホスファミド・シスプラチン）を前向きに試験した。完全奏効は25%で、15か月の追跡で15%が寛解を維持した。血液毒性と腎毒性が問題となり、より有効なサルベージ療法の必要性が示された。
pmid-2174300.summary_en: This prospective study of 42 cisplatin-refractory germ cell tumor patients tested four cycles of VIP (etoposide, ifosfamide, cisplatin) as salvage therapy. Ten patients (25%) achieved complete response, seven with chemotherapy alone and three after surgical resection of viable tumor. With a median follow-up of 15 months, four responders relapsed and six (15%) remain in remission. Significant hematologic and renal toxicity was observed, and the authors suggest that ifosfamide improves salvage efficacy while more effective therapies are still needed.

pmid-2175762.summary_ja: 過去16年間の精巣腫瘍29例を検討した臨床研究である。病期Iのセミノーマには高位精巣摘除術と放射線療法が標準とされた。非セミノーマは主に後腹膜リンパ節郭清後の化学療法で治療され、胚細胞腫瘍23例中21例が生存した。現在の化学療法の効果から、後腹膜リンパ節郭清の意義は低下すると結論づけられている。
pmid-2175762.summary_en: This clinical study reviews 29 testicular tumors treated over 16 years, including 14 seminomas and various non-seminomatous and mixed histologies. Most seminomas were stage I and were managed with high orchiectomy and radiotherapy. Non-seminomas were mainly treated with chemotherapy after retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Of 23 germ cell tumor patients, 21 survived. The authors conclude that the role of RPLND should decline given the efficacy of current chemotherapy in early-stage disease.

pmid-2175931.summary_ja: 本総説は侵入奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍を含む妊娠性栄養膜腫瘍を扱う。ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)を腫瘍マーカーとした治療効果のモニタリングと予後分類により、治癒率は90%を超える。低リスク例はメトトレキサートやアクチノマイシンDの単剤で治癒が期待でき、高リスク転移性疾患ではエトポシド等を含む多剤併用化学療法で80〜90%の治癒率が得られる。
pmid-2175931.summary_en: This review addresses gestational trophoblastic tumors, including invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, and placental-site trophoblastic tumor. Cure rates exceed 90 percent, attributed to chemosensitivity, monitoring with human chorionic gonadotropin as a tumor marker, and prognostic risk stratification. Nonmetastatic and low-risk metastatic disease can be cured with single-agent methotrexate or actinomycin-D. High-risk metastatic disease requires combination chemotherapy including etoposide, high-dose methotrexate, and actinomycin-D, sometimes with radiotherapy and surgery, yielding cure rates of 80 to 90 percent. Response determinants include choriocarcinoma histology, metastatic sites and number, prior chemotherapy failure, and WHO score of 8 or more.

pmid-2176133.summary_ja: 血液透析を要する重度腎不全の患者3例に、カルボプラチンを投与した報告である。うち2例は進行性胚細胞腫瘍で、エトポシドとの併用療法により完全奏効が得られた。薬物動態解析では、透析前のカルボプラチン半減期は長いものの、透析により半減期が短縮し、全身曝露が制限された。重度腎不全の患者にもカルボプラチンの投与が可能であることが示された。
pmid-2176133.summary_en: This report describes three patients with hemodialysis-dependent renal insufficiency treated with carboplatin 100 mg/m2 plus etoposide, or another regimen in one case. Two patients had advanced germ cell tumors, and both achieved complete responses. Pharmacokinetic analysis in two patients showed pre-dialysis carboplatin half-lives of 32 and 18.3 hours, falling to 2 and 3 hours during dialysis. Dialysis limited systemic exposure while achieving adequate AUCs, suggesting carboplatin can be safely given in severe renal insufficiency.

pmid-2176560.summary_ja: 侵入奇胎および妊娠性絨毛癌で化学療法後に一見有効と考えられた41例を対象に、超音波検査で子宮と卵巣の形態を評価した。49%で子宮の異常所見、20%で卵巣の卵胞膜黄体嚢胞を認めた。フォローアップ中に2例が再発したが、超音波所見から再発を予測できる特徴は確認されなかった。治療後の超音波形態は再発予測の指標にはならないと結論された。
pmid-2176560.summary_en: This study used ultrasound to assess uterine and ovarian morphology in 41 patients after apparently successful chemotherapy for invasive mole and gestational choriocarcinoma. Uterine volume was calculated and echopatterns were evaluated. Nearly half of patients showed an abnormal uterine appearance, and 20 percent had ovarian theca-lutein cysts. Two patients relapsed during follow-up, but no ultrasonic features of the uterus or ovaries predicted this outcome. Post-treatment ultrasound morphology therefore did not reliably identify patients at risk of recurrence.

pmid-2177125.summary_ja: シスプラチンとエトポシドによる前治療に抵抗性の進行性胚細胞腫瘍6例に対し、大量化学療法と自家骨髄移植を施行した日本の報告である。2例は大量化学療法を3回受けた。第3回ではエトポシド、シクロホスファミド、アドリアマイシン、ACNU、254Sを用いた。移植後に1例が脳出血で死亡した。評価可能な5例中、完全奏効1例と部分奏効3例の計4例で奏効が得られた。
pmid-2177125.summary_en: This Japanese report describes six patients with advanced germ cell tumors refractory to prior cisplatin and etoposide chemotherapy, treated with high-dose chemotherapy and autologous bone marrow transplantation. The regimen combined etoposide, cyclophosphamide, and cisplatin, with autologous marrow infused 72 hours after the last dose. Two patients received high-dose therapy three times, with a third regimen adding adriamycin, ACNU, and 254S. One patient died of cerebral hemorrhage seven days after transplantation. Among five evaluable patients, four responded, including one complete and three partial responses.

pmid-2177638.summary_ja: 20例の男性胚細胞腫瘍から得られた24検体について染色体解析を行った。精巣および性腺外病変を含み、i(12p)は全組織型および発生部位の90%の腫瘍に認められた。del(12)(q13-q22)は非セミノーマおよび混合型胚細胞腫瘍に限られた。性腺外腫瘍と転移巣では遺伝子増幅も確認され、DNAに基づくi(12p)検出法が開発された。
pmid-2177638.summary_en: This study performed karyotypic and DNA-based analyses of 24 male germ cell tumors from 20 patients, including testicular and extragonadal lesions across seminoma, teratoma, embryonal carcinoma, choriocarcinoma, and endodermal sinus tumor histologies. Isochromosome 12p was present in 90 percent of tumors across all histologies and sites, while del(12)(q13-q22) occurred only in nonseminomatous and mixed tumors. The authors also documented gene amplification in extragonadal and metastatic tumors, including a series of primary mediastinal tumors, and developed a DNA-based method to detect i(12p).

pmid-2178277.summary_ja: 縦隔は成人において性腺外原発の胚細胞腫瘍の最も多い部位である。多くは前縦隔に生じ、胸腺と関連することが多く、主に人生の最初の30年に好発する。大半は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫で、胸部画像検査で偶然発見される。悪性腫瘍は男性に多い。若年成人の未熟奇形腫は組織学的グレーディングが予後を示す。縦隔リンパ節は性腺原発腫瘍の転移である可能性もあり、慎重な評価が必要である。
pmid-2178277.summary_en: This review covers germ cell tumors of the mediastinum, the most common extragonadal primary site for germinal neoplasms in adults. Most arise in the anterior mediastinum, often associated with the thymus, and typically occur in patients in their first three decades. Most are mature cystic teratomas, often found incidentally on imaging, while malignant tumors affect males predominantly. Histologic grading of immature teratomas in young adults predicts an aggressive course. Germinoma-seminoma is the most frequent nonteratomatous malignant type, and mediastinal nodes may represent metastases from gonadal primaries.

pmid-2178810.summary_ja: 1990年の研究で、婦人科腫瘍患者の血清PLAPを2種類の測定キットで測定し、他の腫瘍マーカーとの併用効果を検討した。PLAPは健常女性や良性卵巣腫瘍でほぼ陰性で、卵巣癌の約35%で陽性だった。ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）では特に高値を示し、CA54/61との併用が診断効率を高めた。
pmid-2178810.summary_en: This 1990 study measured serum placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP) in women with gynecologic tumors using two immunoassay kits and tested its combination with other markers. PLAP was rarely positive in healthy women and benign ovarian tumors, but was positive in about 35% of ovarian cancers, most often serous cystadenocarcinoma. Dysgerminoma patients showed notably high PLAP-I values. Combining PLAP with CA54/61 improved diagnostic efficiency over PLAP with CA125 in ovarian cancer, suggesting PLAP is useful for diagnosing serous cystadenocarcinoma and dysgerminoma.

pmid-2181165.summary_ja: 30歳の初産婦で妊娠36週の帝王切開時に偶然見つかった、左卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告である。3cmの腫瘍内に授乳期の乳腺組織が認められた。抗α-ラクトアルブミン抗体で腺腔細胞の分泌活性を、抗アクチン抗体で筋上皮細胞を確認した。類似の奇形腫内組織の報告2件と比較している。
pmid-2181165.summary_en: This case report describes a mature cystic teratoma of the left ovary, found incidentally during a cesarean section in a 30-year-old primigravida at 36 weeks. The 3 cm tumor contained lactating mammary tissue. Immunostaining with anti-alpha-lactalbumin showed secretory activity in luminal cells, and anti-actin highlighted myoepithelial cells. The authors compare the finding with two other reported cases of similar tissue within teratomas, illustrating unusual glandular differentiation in ovarian teratomas.

pmid-2182405.summary_ja: 52歳女性の右卵巣の良性類皮嚢腫内に骨肉腫が発生した症例報告である。嚢腫内の充実性腫瘤は軟骨芽細胞様分化を伴う骨肉腫で、残りは通常の類皮嚢腫組織だった。術後に化学療法を併用し、術後16か月時点で無病生存していた。世界で3例目の報告とされる稀な悪性転化例である。
pmid-2182405.summary_en: This case report describes osteosarcoma arising within a benign dermoid cyst of the right ovary in a 52-year-old woman. The 10 cm unilocular cyst contained a solid mass with osteosarcoma showing focal chondroblastic differentiation, while the rest of the cyst was ordinary dermoid tissue. The patient received postoperative combination chemotherapy and remained alive and well 16 months later. The authors note this is only the third such case documented in the world literature.

pmid-2183156.summary_ja: 8種のヒト胚細胞腫瘍細胞株を検討し、男性の非セミノーマ株7種すべてでイソクロモソーム12p（i(12p)）マーカーを認めたが、女性の奇形癌細胞株では認めなかった。男性株では12p上のc-ki-ras2のコピー数増加とmRNA発現亢進が見られた。一方、コドン12、13、61に点突然変異は認められず、点突然変異による活性化はまれであるとされた。著者らは、12pのコピー数評価が胚細胞腫瘍の診断的評価に有用だと結論づけた。
pmid-2183156.summary_en: This study examined eight human germ cell cancer lines and found an isochromosome 12p marker in all seven male nonseminoma lines, but not in a single female teratocarcinoma line. These male lines showed increased copy number of c-ki-ras2, a gene on 12p, with enhanced mRNA expression. However, no point mutations were found in codons 12, 13, or 61, suggesting point-mutational activation of c-ki-ras2 is infrequent. The authors conclude that 12p copy number is useful in diagnostic evaluation of germ cell cancer.

pmid-2183915.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、新生児期に不完全切除された仙尾部奇形腫が再発した女児例です。再発腫瘍内に悪性カルチノイドが認められました。仙尾部奇形腫は良性で完全切除されれば、尾骨を含めた切除により予後は良好です。小児で奇形腫に悪性カルチノイドを合併する例は稀で、著者らは小児例として初めての報告と考えています。不完全切除のリスクも示されています。
pmid-2183915.summary_en: This case report describes a girl whose sacrococcygeal teratoma recurred after incomplete neonatal excision. The recurrent tumor contained a malignant carcinoid. Sacrococcygeal teratomas usually have a good prognosis when benign and completely resected, including the coccyx. Carcinoids are rarely associated with teratomas in children, and the authors believe this is the first such pediatric case. The report highlights the risks of incomplete surgery for these tumors.

pmid-2184024.summary_ja: 本研究は絨毛癌由来のJAR細胞におけるヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)産生の調節機構を検討したものです。8-ブロモアデノシン処理によりhCGの合成と分泌が2~5倍に増加し、hCG陽性細胞の数も増えました。この作用は細胞増殖の抑制と並行しており、アデノシン受容体を介したものではなく、栄養膜細胞の増殖抑制によるものと結論づけられています。
pmid-2184024.summary_en: This study examines regulation of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) in JAR choriocarcinoma cells. Only a small fraction of cells expressed hCG at any time, and about 30% of those were morphologically differentiated. Treatment with 8-bromoadenosine increased hCG synthesis and secretion two- to fivefold and raised the number of hCG-expressing cells. The effect paralleled inhibition of proliferation. The authors conclude that it works by suppressing trophoblast proliferation rather than through adenosine receptors.

pmid-2187297.summary_ja: 本総説は、セミノーマ由来の胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼ様(PLAP様)酵素を腫瘍マーカー候補として取り上げています。この酵素の生化学的特徴と、組織および血清中での存在について概説しています。健常者と精巣がん患者の双方が検討対象とされ、セミノーマの早期発見や経過観察への応用が期待されています。
pmid-2187297.summary_en: This review examines the placental-like alkaline phosphatase (PLAP-like) enzyme derived from seminomas as a possible tumor marker. It describes the biochemistry of this enzyme and its presence in tissue and serum. The authors consider both healthy individuals and patients with testicular cancer. The enzyme has been studied as an aid to early detection and monitoring of seminoma, a major subtype of testicular germ cell tumor.

pmid-2188021.summary_ja: 精巣の純粋な成熟奇形腫の初回切除標本に胎児型横紋筋肉腫が認められた症例を報告する。成熟奇形腫に肉腫性成分が生じることはまれであると著者らは指摘している。経過観察中、胎児型横紋筋肉腫成分から転移が急速に出現した。著者らは、予後と治療に影響するため、この肉腫成分を正確に診断することが極めて重要であると強調している。
pmid-2188021.summary_en: This case report describes embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma found within a purely mature teratoma of the testis at primary excision. The authors note that such a sarcomatous component arising in mature teratoma is unusual. During follow-up, metastases developed rapidly from the embryonal rhabdomyosarcomatous component. The paper emphasizes that accurate recognition of this sarcomatous element is critical because it affects prognosis and therapy.

pmid-2188251.summary_ja: 本報告は、出生前の超音波検査で診断された心膜内奇形腫の症例です。出生前診断により分娩と新生児管理を事前に計画できました。新生児は心臓外科手術で腫瘍を完全切除され、完全に回復しました。稀な縦隔奇形腫における出生前超音波検査と新生児集中治療の連携の有用性を示しています。
pmid-2188251.summary_en: This report describes an intrapericardial teratoma detected by ultrasound before birth. Prenatal diagnosis allowed delivery and neonatal management to be planned in advance. The infant underwent successful cardiac surgery with complete resection of the tumor and recovered fully. The case shows the value of prenatal ultrasonography and coordinated neonatal intensive care for rare mediastinal teratomas.

pmid-2190872.summary_ja: 46,XY純粋性腺異形成(Swyer症候群)で表現型は女性の患者に、性腺芽腫と転移性胎児性癌が併存した症例。手術と化学療法により治療し、2年時点で無病生存を得た。英語文献では過去25年で3例目、初の治癒例であり、現在の治療法を概説している。
pmid-2190872.summary_en: This case report describes a phenotypically female patient with 46,XY pure gonadal dysgenesis (Swyer syndrome) who had gonadoblastoma coexisting with metastatic embryonal carcinoma. Treatment combined surgery with chemotherapy, and she remained disease-free at two years. The authors note this is only the third reported case and the first cure in the English literature over 25 years, and they review current management.

pmid-2193140.summary_ja: 新生児の仙尾部奇形腫4例を対象に、術前に超音波検査、CT、MRIを組み合わせて腫瘍範囲と周囲解剖との関係を評価した。この画像戦略により完全切除が可能となり、良好な転帰が得られたと報告している。画像による術前計画の有用性を示した研究である。
pmid-2193140.summary_en: This study reports four neonates with sacrococcygeal teratoma, a rare and potentially malignant tumor. Preoperative ultrasound, CT, and MRI were combined to define tumor extent and its relationship to adjacent anatomy. The authors conclude that this multimodality imaging approach enabled complete surgical resection and optimal outcomes, supporting its use in surgical planning.

pmid-2194261.summary_ja: 婦人科・産科病理の難しい鑑別診断4項目を検討した総説。絨毛癌と初期胚盤胞、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍と退縮性着床部位の鑑別を含み、ほかに卵巣腫瘍における肉腫様壁在結節と部分胞状奇胎を扱う。著者自身の解釈と推奨が示されている。
pmid-2194261.summary_en: This review of gynecologic and obstetric pathology discusses four difficult differential diagnoses. Two concern gestational trophoblastic disease: choriocarcinoma versus early blastocyst, and placental site trophoblastic tumor versus regressing implantation site. The others are sarcoma-like mural nodules in ovarian tumors and partial hydatidiform mole. The author presents personal interpretations and recommendations.

pmid-2194707.summary_ja: 若年女性に生じた両側性の卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告。稀な症例であるため診断と治療上の問題点を詳細に分析している。両側性で典型的な超音波所見から卵巣腫瘍が強く疑われた。若年であることを考慮し、妊孕性を温存する保存的手術が施行された。
pmid-2194707.summary_en: This case report describes bilateral cystic teratomas of the ovaries in a young woman. Because the case is rare, the authors analyze diagnostic and therapeutic challenges in detail. Bilateral, typical ultrasound findings strongly suggested an ovarian tumor. Given her young age, a conservative, reproduction-preserving procedure was performed.

pmid-2201432.summary_ja: 1975年から1987年にノルウェーのラジウム病院で治療された卵巣未熟奇形腫の連続16例の報告である。多くは病期Iで、9例では少なくとも1側の卵巣が温存された。主な補助療法はアドリアマイシンで、中央値85か月のフォローアップで全例が無病生存し、重篤な毒性は認められなかった。残存腫瘍のない症例では、併用化学療法と同等の有効性かつ低毒性であるとして、アドリアマイシンが推奨されている。
pmid-2201432.summary_en: This retrospective series of 16 consecutive patients with pure ovarian immature teratoma, treated at the Norwegian Radium Hospital from 1975 to 1987, reports a median age of 22 years, mostly FIGO stage I disease, and conservation of at least one ovary in nine patients. Adjuvant adriamycin was the main treatment; all patients remained alive without evidence of disease at a median follow-up of 85 months, with no severe toxicity. The authors favor adriamycin over multiagent regimens for patients without residual tumor after surgery, given comparable efficacy and lower toxicity.

pmid-2203228.summary_ja: 未熟奇形腫5例、成熟奇形腫12例などの軟骨95検体を用いて、GFAP、ビメンチン、S-100タンパクの免疫染色性を検討した報告である。GFAP陽性軟骨細胞は未熟軟骨に多く、成熟に伴い減少した。弾性軟骨で多く、中枢神経組織の近くに位置することが多かった。奇形腫軟骨の染色パターンは気道軟骨と類似すると結論づけている。
pmid-2203228.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined GFAP, vimentin, and S-100 protein expression in chondrocytes from 95 cartilage specimens of five immature teratomas, 12 mature teratomas, and one teratocarcinoma. GFAP-positive chondrocytes were abundant in immature cartilage and declined with maturation, becoming peripheral. Elastic cartilage contained more GFAP-positive chondrocytes, and these cells were often near central nervous tissue. The authors conclude that teratoma cartilage staining patterns resemble those of respiratory tract cartilage.

pmid-2204171.summary_ja: 精巣正常組織とセミノーマ組織のα・γエノラーゼを酵素免疫測定法で測定した。セミノーマではγエノラーゼが有意に高値で、血清値も病期IIおよびIIIの全例で上昇していた。手術と化学療法後に血清値は低下し、病期分類やフォローアップのバイオマーカーとしての有用性が示唆された。
pmid-2204171.summary_en: This study measured alpha- and gamma-enolase in normal testis and seminoma tissue by enzyme immunoassay. Gamma-enolase was markedly higher in seminoma than in normal testis, and immunohistochemistry was positive in 75% of cases. Serum gamma-enolase was elevated in 75% of seminoma patients, reaching 100% of stage II and III disease, and fell after surgery and chemotherapy. The authors propose serum gamma-enolase as a potential biomarker for staging and monitoring seminoma.

pmid-2205176.summary_ja: 25歳女性の膵奇形腫例を報告する。1976年に石灰化膵嚢胞として手術を受け、14年間の経過を追跡している。極めて稀な本疾患の既報9例をレビューし、緩徐に増大する良性膵嚢胞との鑑別診断について論じる。症状は周囲臓器の圧迫によることが多く、早期診断と腫瘍の完全切除の重要性を強調している。
pmid-2205176.summary_en: The authors describe a 25-year-old woman with a pancreatic teratoma that was initially diagnosed as a calcified pancreatic cyst and treated surgically in 1976. They report 14 years of follow-up and review nine previously published cases of this extremely rare entity. Symptoms usually arise from compression of adjacent organs. The differential diagnosis from slow-growing benign pancreatic cysts is discussed, and the authors emphasize early diagnosis and total tumor resection.

pmid-2207782.summary_ja: 49歳男性に生じた仙尾部の腫瘤例である。コンピュータ断層撮影で石灰化を伴う病変が確認され、デジタルアンギオグラフィーで血管増生が認められた。S状結腸鏡検査時の経直腸生検で悪性奇形腫と診断されたが、切除不能で治療適応もなかった。成人の悪性仙尾部奇形腫の稀な症例である。
pmid-2207782.summary_en: A 49-year-old man presented with a sacrococcygeal mass. Computed tomography showed a calcified lesion, and digital angiography revealed hypervascularity. A transrectal biopsy performed during sigmoidoscopy established a diagnosis of malignant teratoma, which was judged unresectable and not amenable to treatment. The case illustrates a rare presentation of malignant sacrococcygeal teratoma in an adult, diagnosed by imaging and endoscopic biopsy.

pmid-2209843.summary_ja: 胎児性癌に対し精巣摘除術を受けた若年男性が、大量の腹腔内出血を来した。開腹で4リットルの新鮮血を除去し、左葉の単発の大きな肝転移が出血源と判明したため、同部を切除した。既往に悪性腫瘍があり他に出血原因がない場合は、転移巣からの出血を考慮すべきと強調している。
pmid-2209843.summary_en: A young man who had undergone orchiectomy for embryonal cell carcinoma developed massive intra-abdominal bleeding. Laparotomy drained four liters of fresh blood, and a single large liver metastasis in the left lobe was identified as the source. The left lobe was resected. The authors emphasize that bleeding from a metastasis should be considered when no other cause is found in a patient with prior malignancy.

pmid-2210200.summary_ja: 34歳女性に発生した大網奇形腫の症例報告。超音波検査で下腹部を占める不均一なエコー像の大きな腫瘤、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で脂肪と石灰化を含む充実性・嚢胞性腫瘤を認めた。性腺外に生じる奇形腫の画像所見を示し、成人の大網腫瘤の鑑別に有用な知見を提供している。本症例は画像所見の重要性を示す。
pmid-2210200.summary_en: This case report describes a 34-year-old woman with an omental teratoma, a rare extragonadal location for this germ cell tumor. Ultrasonography showed a large, mixed-echogenicity mass filling the lower abdomen, and computed tomography revealed an inhomogeneous solid and cystic mass containing fat and calcification. The findings illustrate how imaging can suggest a diagnosis of teratoma outside the gonads. The report is useful for clinicians evaluating omental masses with fat and calcification in adult patients.

pmid-2213443.summary_ja: 先天性口咽頭奇形腫の新生児3例について、周術期の評価と外科的管理を報告。出生時に気道障害をきたしやすく、確実な気道確保と正中部の中枢神経系奇形の画像評価が必要とされる。窒息や変形を防ぐため早期切除が推奨され、まれな先天性奇形腫の診療に実践的な指針を与える。
pmid-2213443.summary_en: This report describes perioperative assessment and surgical management of three neonates with congenital oropharyngeal teratomas. These rare tumors distort orofacial anatomy and often cause airway compromise at birth. The authors recommend immediate establishment of a secure airway, radiographic exclusion of midline central nervous system anomalies, and early surgical excision to prevent asphyxia or disfigurement. The paper provides practical guidance for managing this uncommon congenital teratoma.

pmid-2213748.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、卵巣の破裂した成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が17年後に肝内腫瘤と横行結腸病変として再発した51歳女性を記述する。両方の再発病変には成熟奇形腫成分のみが含まれていた。部分肝切除と横行結腸の区域切除により完治した。著者らは、卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫によるこのような晩期合併症の報告は初めてであり、破裂後の長期フォローアップの重要性を強調している。
pmid-2213748.summary_en: This case report describes a 51-year-old woman whose ruptured mature cystic teratoma of the ovary recurred 17 years later as an intrahepatic mass and a transverse colon lesion. Both recurrences contained only mature teratomatous elements. The patient was cured by partial hepatectomy and segmental transverse colectomy. The authors note this as the first documented report of such a late complication of ovarian mature cystic teratoma, highlighting the importance of long-term follow-up after rupture.

pmid-2216267.summary_ja: 超音波検査と磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で出生前に診断された口咽頭奇形腫（エピグナサス）の症例。帝王切開で娩出後、臍帯を結紮せず胎盤循環を温存し、酸素化を保ったまま気管切開を行った。その後に臍帯を結紮し腫瘍を減量切除した。母子ともに良好に回復し、出生前画像が気道管理の計画に有用であることを示した。
pmid-2216267.summary_en: This report describes the antepartum diagnosis of epignathus, a teratoma arising from the oropharynx, using ultrasonography and magnetic resonance imaging. The team planned a controlled perinatal approach: cesarean delivery with the umbilical cord left unclamped, followed by tracheostomy while the infant remained oxygenated, then clamping and debulking of the tumor. Both mother and infant recovered well. The case shows how prenatal imaging can guide peripartum airway management in life-threatening fetal teratomas.

pmid-2217466.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ治療をめぐる論点を整理した。治癒率は約97%と高く、病期IIの最適な放射線療法線量や化学療法後の残存腫瘤の管理が議論された。治療成績が良好なため、今後は治療に伴う有害事象を最小化する方向への研究が重要と述べている。コンセンサス会議の議論を基にしている。
pmid-2217466.summary_en: This review discusses controversies in managing testicular seminoma, a tumor with an excellent cure rate of about 97%. Key issues include the optimal radiation dose for stage II disease and the management of residual masses after chemotherapy. The authors emphasize that as cure rates are high, research should shift toward minimizing treatment morbidity. The discussion reflects a consensus conference and frames the balance between efficacy and toxicity in seminoma care.

pmid-2217472.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの検査と治療に関する1989年のコンセンサス声明。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)による病期診断や、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)とβ-hCGの腫瘍マーカーの有用性が述べられている。シスプラチン併用化学療法と放射線療法により治癒率は97〜98%とされる。進行例の化学療法レジメンや予後因子、早期病期での放射線療法の最適化などが今後の課題とされる。
pmid-2217472.summary_en: This consensus statement summarizes the investigation and management of testicular seminoma, drawing on developments in CT staging and serum tumor markers AFP and beta-hCG. It notes that cisplatin-based chemotherapy and radiation therapy have raised cure rates to 97 to 98 percent. Remaining controversies concern advanced-stage chemotherapy regimens, prognostic factors for the 1 to 2 percent of patients who die of disease, and refinement of radiotherapy for early stage disease to reduce morbidity.

pmid-2218787.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、妊娠後期の羊水過多の評価中にリアルタイム超音波検査で子宮内診断された縦隔奇形腫の症例を扱う。出生直後に迅速な呼吸補助を行い、早期に外科的切除を施行して良好な転帰を得た。出生前超音波検査で縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍を同定しうること、そして新生児期の気道管理と適時の手術が予後改善に重要であることを示している。
pmid-2218787.summary_en: This case report describes a fetus with mediastinal teratoma diagnosed in utero by real-time ultrasonography during a late third-trimester evaluation for polyhydramnios. After birth, prompt respiratory support was provided, followed by early surgical intervention, and the outcome was successful. The report highlights that prenatal ultrasound can identify mediastinal germ cell tumours, and that early neonatal airway management and timely surgery are key to a favorable result.

pmid-2220805.summary_ja: 良性成熟卵巣奇形腫102例と未熟性悪性奇形腫2例を核型解析し、着糸点ヘテロ多型を用いて染色体構成と起源を検討した。良性例の大多数は46,XXであり、良性卵巣奇形腫で初めての四倍体や構造再構成例も報告された。約65%は減数分裂後の単一胚細胞由来、約35%は減数分裂前または第I減数分裂の異常に由来すると推定された。
pmid-2220805.summary_en: This study karyotyped 102 benign mature ovarian teratomas and two immature malignant teratomas, and used centromeric heteromorphisms to determine their chromosomal composition and genetic origin. Most benign cases were 46,XX, and the paper reports the first tetraploidy and structural rearrangements in benign ovarian teratomas. Heterozygosity analysis indicated that about 65% of teratomas arise from a single germ cell after meiotic failure, while about 35% arise from premeiotic or meiosis I failure.

pmid-2220922.summary_ja: 原発性非転移性子宮頸部絨毛癌の症例報告である。本疾患は1915年以降の報告が約60例と極めて稀である。本症例は既報の診断基準をすべて満たし、原発性子宮頸部絨毛癌と定義された。タイトルでは保存的治療が成功したと示されているが、要旨では臨床詳細は限られている。
pmid-2220922.summary_en: This case report describes a primary nonmetastatic choriocarcinoma of the uterine cervix, a very rare entity with only about 60 cases published since 1915. The authors state that the case fulfills all previously defined criteria for primary cervical choriocarcinoma. The title indicates successful conservative management, although the abstract provides limited clinical detail. The report underscores that this rare disease should be considered in the differential diagnosis of cervical tumours.

pmid-2222151.summary_ja: 生後1か月の乳児が、母体胎盤由来と推定される絨毛癌の脳転移により広範な脳内出血で死亡した症例である。高ビリルビン血症や反復するけいれんを呈し、CTで左頭頂後頭部に血管性腫瘤を認めた。胎盤は検査されず、母体hCG高値と剖検での転移所見から診断された。同様の報告は以前に1例のみとされる。
pmid-2222151.summary_en: This report describes a one-month-old infant who died from extensive intracerebral hemorrhage caused by brain metastasis of choriocarcinoma, presumed to have originated in the maternal placenta. The clinical course included hyperbilirubinemia, recurrent seizures and intracranial hemorrhage, and imaging showed a vascular mass in the left parieto-occipital region. Because the placenta was not examined, the diagnosis rests on elevated maternal hCG and autopsy findings of metastasis. The authors note that only one similar case had been reported previously.

pmid-2224437.summary_ja: 化学療法後に摘出された25個の精巣を対象に、精巣上皮内癌(CIS)の化学感受性を検討した。評価可能な23例中8例(35%)でCISが残存し、5例では浸潤性胚細胞腫瘍を併存していた。CISは化学療法後も持続・再発しうるため、潜在的な転移性腫瘍の見逃しや、対側精巣の管理に影響を与える。
pmid-2224437.summary_en: This study examined the chemosensitivity of testicular carcinoma in situ (CIS) in 25 testes removed 10 weeks to 4.5 years after platinum-based chemotherapy for advanced germ cell tumours. CIS persisted in 8 of 23 evaluable cases, and in five of these it coexisted with invasive germ cell tumour. The authors conclude that CIS may persist or recur after chemotherapy, which has implications for occult metastatic disease and for management of the contralateral testis in patients with testicular germ cell tumours.

pmid-2224438.summary_ja: 播種性精巣がんの化学療法後に残存腫瘤を手術した55例を検討した。生存腫瘍12例、成熟奇形腫12例、線維化・壊死31例であった。後腹膜腫瘤の70%超の縮小は線維化と一貫して関連し、50 mm超の残存腫瘤は生存腫瘍または成熟奇形腫を示した。化学療法前後の画像計測はインディアナ分類やEORTC分類と併せて予後評価に有用で、個別化治療の指針となりうる。
pmid-2224438.summary_en: This study reviewed 55 patients with disseminated testicular cancer who underwent surgery for residual masses after chemotherapy. Viable tumour was found in 12, mature teratoma in 12, and fibrosis or necrosis in 31. A greater than 70% reduction in retroperitoneal mass size was consistently associated with fibrosis, while residual masses over 50 mm indicated viable tumour or mature teratoma. Radiographic measurement before and after chemotherapy, used with the Indiana or EORTC models, provides prognostic information to guide individualized treatment.

pmid-2224803.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍を発症した兄弟4名と近親者1名の計5名を含む家系を報告した。組織型はセミノーマ3例と胎児性癌1例で、全例が治療後に生存している。家系内には他のがんや泌尿生殖器異常も見られた。家族性精巣がんのリスク因子としての同定と報告の必要性が指摘されている。
pmid-2224803.summary_en: This report describes a kindred in which four brothers developed testicular germ cell neoplasms, three seminomas and one embryonal carcinoma, and a first cousin once removed also had embryonal carcinoma. All patients survived after treatment. The mother was a dizygous twin among ten siblings, and several relatives had other cancers, including breast carcinoma in monozygous twin nieces. The authors note associated urogenital abnormalities and discordant histology among the five males with testicular cancer. They encourage further identification and reporting of this familial risk factor.

pmid-2225480.summary_ja: 絨毛性腫瘍の女性24例の甲状腺機能を検討し、高hCG血症を伴う8例に甲状腺機能亢進症を認めた。精製hCGはFRTL-5細胞のヨウ素取り込みを促進し、機能亢進例の血清は甲状腺刺激活性を示した。hCG産生精巣腫瘍の男性6例は生化学的に甲状腺機能正常であった。甲状腺機能亢進の原因は、hCGを含む甲状腺刺激物質と考えられた。
pmid-2225480.summary_en: This study examined thyroid function in 24 euthyroid women with gestational trophoblastic tumours, eight of whom were biochemically hyperthyroid with markedly higher serum hCG. Purified hCG stimulated iodide uptake in FRTL-5 cells, and serum from hyperthyroid patients contained thyroid-stimulating activity that correlated with hCG levels. Sera from choriocarcinoma patients also increased cAMP production in human thyroid cells. Six men with hCG-secreting testicular tumours were biochemically euthyroid, although some of their sera stimulated iodide uptake. The authors conclude that hCG or a related substance likely underlies hyperthyroidism in these tumours.

pmid-2227584.summary_ja: 卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍33例に術後VAC療法を施行し、無効であった8例にPEB療法(エトポシド、ブレオマイシン、シスプラチン)を行った。このうち3例が治癒し、PEB療法終了後24〜79か月間無病生存を維持した。VAC不応例に対する化学療法として救済療法の有用性が示唆された。
pmid-2227584.summary_en: This report describes 33 patients with malignant germ cell tumor of the ovary who received postoperative vincristine, dactinomycin, and cyclophosphamide (VAC). Eight patients failed VAC and received etoposide, bleomycin, and cisplatin (PEB) combination chemotherapy. Three of these eight were cured and remained disease-free for 24 to 79 months after completing PEB therapy. The findings suggest that PEB may be an effective salvage regimen for refractory ovarian malignant germ cell tumor. The authors report these outcomes without detailing further comparisons among patients.

pmid-2227597.summary_ja: 68歳女性の無症候性腹部腫瘤例で、超音波検査とCTにより骨盤内腫瘤と右腸骨稜沿いの石灰化を伴う腫瘤が確認された。大網奇形腫が良性卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫および悪性腫瘍と併存した初の報告である。文献上の卵巣奇形腫合併大網奇形腫7例をレビューし、成因を考察している。
pmid-2227597.summary_en: This report describes a 68-year-old woman with an asymptomatic abdominal mass and uterine prolapse. Ultrasound revealed a cystic and solid pelvic mass, and CT showed a second calcified mass along the right iliac crest. The authors describe this as the first report of an omental teratoma occurring with a benign ovarian cystic teratoma that coexisted with a malignant neoplasm. They review seven previously reported cases of omental teratoma associated with ovarian teratoma and discuss possible etiologies.

pmid-2228718.summary_ja: 若年女性の進行卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の1症例を報告する。保存的手術の後、根治的併用化学療法を行った。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)を術前から化学療法中まで追跡し、セカンドルックラパロトミーで完全寛解を確認した。生殖機能は温存され、若年女性における生殖機能温存の重要性が示された。
pmid-2228718.summary_en: This case report describes advanced endodermal sinus tumor of the ovary in a young woman, managed with conservative surgery followed by radical combination chemotherapy. Serum AFP was followed from before surgery through chemotherapy, as elevated levels predict persistent disease. Normal reproductive function was preserved, and second-look laparotomy documented complete resolution. The report highlights the tumor's occurrence in young women and the importance of fertility preservation.

pmid-2231890.summary_ja: 11年間の精巣がん140例を後方視的に検討し、HIV感染者6例を含む。全例が病期IまたはIIで、全例が完全寛解に至り精巣がんで死亡した者はいなかった。HIV感染による病期I症例では精巣摘除術後の経過観察が推奨され、大多数のHIV陽性者には標準治療が推奨された。
pmid-2231890.summary_en: This retrospective review of 140 testicular cancer patients over 11 years included six with HIV infection and seven from HIV risk groups. All cases were stage I or II, with seminoma in 8, teratocarcinoma in 3, embryonal cell carcinoma in 1, and teratoma in 1. Clinical presentation was comparable to patients without HIV risk factors. All patients achieved complete remission, and none died of testicular cancer. Because treatment could worsen immunosuppression, the authors recommend surveillance after orchiectomy for stage I patients with AIDS, while most HIV-positive patients should receive standard therapy.

pmid-2231948.summary_ja: 慢性精巣痛の評価中に超音波検査で発見された、遺伝学的・表現型的に正常な男性の性腺芽腫の症例報告である。触知しない腫瘍で、同時に胚細胞腫瘍は認めなかった。解剖学的に正常な男性の既報は2例のみで、いずれも精巣胚細胞腫瘍を伴っていた。
pmid-2231948.summary_en: This case report describes a genotypically and phenotypically normal, fertile man with descended testes who presented with chronic orchialgia. Scrotal ultrasound revealed a nonpalpable gonadoblastoma, with no accompanying germ cell neoplasm. The authors note that only two prior gonadoblastomas had been reported in anatomically normal men with scrotal testes, and both were associated with testicular germ cell tumors. The report shows that gonadoblastoma can arise in such men without a concurrent germ cell neoplasm.

pmid-2237390.summary_ja: 56歳の喫煙歴のある男性が女性化乳房と肺腫瘤で受診した症例報告である。肺葉切除で純粋な絨毛癌と診断され、精巣は正常で後腹膜に腫瘤が認められた。性腺外発生、女性化乳房、高齢などが予後不良因子であった。5日間の積極的な化学療法により完全寛解が得られた。原発性後腹膜絨毛癌は極めてまれであり、主に20〜30歳代の男性に生じると述べている。
pmid-2237390.summary_en: This case report describes a 56-year-old male smoker with bilateral gynaecomastia and a right upper lobe lung mass. Lobectomy showed pure choriocarcinoma, and the testes were normal while a retroperitoneal mass was found, establishing primary retroperitoneal choriocarcinoma. Poor prognostic features included extragonadal origin, gynaecomastia, and older age. A five-day aggressive chemotherapy regimen achieved complete remission. The authors note that primary retroperitoneal choriocarcinoma is extremely rare, mostly affecting men aged 20 to 30.

pmid-2237888.summary_ja: 卵黄嚢成分を含む悪性縦隔奇形腫の症例報告である。思春期早発症を呈し、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)の上昇が悪性度と浸潤性の指標となった。放射線療法と化学療法の後に根治的切除を行い、64か月以上転移なく生存している。内分泌産生を伴うこのような腫瘍の経過観察において、AFPが有用なマーカーであることを示している。
pmid-2237888.summary_en: This report describes a case of malignant mediastinal teratoma containing yolk sac elements, a rare tumor with generally poor prognosis. The patient presented with precocious puberty, and an elevated alpha-fetoprotein level indicated malignancy and invasiveness. Treatment consisted of radiotherapy and chemotherapy before radical surgical excision. The patient has survived more than 64 months without evidence of metastasis. The report highlights AFP as a useful marker for monitoring such endocrine-secreting tumors.

pmid-2238295.summary_ja: 本研究は、初回精巣摘除術後の早期精巣セミノーマに対する放射線療法を評価したものである。病期Iの32例と病期II-Aの13例を治療した。病期Iでは同側の骨盤および傍大動脈リンパ節に、病期II-Aではそれに加えて横隔膜上領域に放射線療法を行った。生化学的マーカーと放射線学的な経過観察により、両群とも無病生存率は100%であった。著者らは、精巣摘除術と放射線療法により予後は治癒に近づくと結論づけている。
pmid-2238295.summary_en: This study evaluates radiation therapy after initial orchiectomy for early-stage testicular seminoma. Thirty-two patients with Stage I and 13 with Stage II-A disease were treated, with radiotherapy directed to ipsilateral pelvic and para-aortic nodes for Stage I and extended to supradiaphragmatic regions for Stage II-A. Using biochemical markers and radiologic follow-up, disease-free survival was 100 percent in both groups. The authors conclude that prognosis approaches cure with orchiectomy and radiotherapy.

pmid-2238301.summary_ja: 病期Iおよび病期IIの精巣セミノーマの病期分類における胸部X線、断層撮影、CTの有用性を検討した研究である。全例で胸部X線を施行し、22例では断層撮影またはCTを行った。初期病期分類で潜在性の肺病変や縦隔リンパ節病変は認められず、胸部の初発再発もなかった。文献的にも早期セミノーマの胸部再発率は極めて低いことが支持される。そのため、日常的なCTや断層撮影は不要と結論づけている。
pmid-2238301.summary_en: This study assesses the value of chest radiography, conventional tomography, and CT in staging Stage I and II testicular seminoma. All patients had chest X-rays, and 22 underwent tomography or CT during initial staging. No occult pulmonary or mediastinal nodal disease was detected, and no thoracic recurrence occurred as a first event. A literature review supports the very low thoracic failure rate in early-stage seminoma. The authors conclude that routine CT or tomography is not indicated for staging these patients.

pmid-2245007.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍35例(卵黄嚢腫瘍16例、胎児性癌15例、セミノーマ13例)におけるラミニンの発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した研究である。卵黄嚢腫瘍はすべてラミニン陽性であった。胎児性癌とセミノーマでは主に膜染色が認められた。一方、ラミニンは組織型の鑑別には有用ではなかった。本知見は胚細胞腫瘍の組織発生と胚発生の理解に寄与するとしている。
pmid-2245007.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examines laminin expression in 35 testicular germ cell tumors, including 16 yolk sac tumors, 15 embryonal carcinomas and 13 seminomas, with normal yolk sacs and lung carcinomas for comparison. Yolk sac tumors stained uniformly positive for laminin, while embryonal carcinomas and seminomas showed mainly membrane staining. However, laminin did not reliably distinguish yolk sac tumors from embryonal carcinomas or seminomas from non-seminomatous tumors. The findings contribute to understanding histogenesis and embryogenesis.

pmid-2246359.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者87例と他のがん患者35例を比較し、診断・治療の前後における気分と人格の評価を行った。精巣がん患者は治療中、特に化学療法中に苦痛が強く、既婚者ではストレスが緩和される傾向があった。重篤な精神病理を示す強い証拠は乏しく、治療に伴う苦痛は一過性と結論づけられた。
pmid-2246359.summary_en: This study compared psychological distress in 87 men with testis cancer and 35 men with other cancers, using mood and personality inventories before, during, and after diagnosis and treatment. Testis cancer patients were more distressed during treatment, especially during cytotoxic chemotherapy compared with locoregional treatment, and more distressed than patients with other cancers. Being married appeared to buffer distress. The authors concluded that cancer treatment, particularly cytotoxic therapy, causes transient distress rather than strong evidence of severe psychopathology.

pmid-2246626.summary_ja: 1983年から1989年にタイのソンクラナガリンド病院で治療した20歳未満の卵巣腫瘍47例を後方視的に検討した。胚細胞腫瘍が最多（59.6%）で、60.7%が悪性であった。主症状は腹部膨満または腫瘤で、17%で捻転を認めた。全例に手術が行われ、悪性例では化学療法や放射線療法が併用された。
pmid-2246626.summary_en: This retrospective review of 47 females under 20 years with ovarian tumors at Songklanagarind Hospital (1983 to 1989) found germ cell tumors to be the most common type (59.6%), and 60.7% of tumors were malignant. Abdominal distention or a mass was the chief presenting symptom, with torsion in 17%. Ascites and solid consistency suggested malignancy. Surgery was performed in all patients, with conservative approaches in many benign cases, and chemotherapy and/or radiotherapy were added for malignant cases.

pmid-2246754.summary_ja: SCIDマウスを用いてヒト腫瘍の転移機構を検討した。ヒト卵黄嚢腫瘍（YST-2）は皮下・腹腔内移植のいずれでも増殖し、肺や肝臓などへ自然転移した。ヌードマウスでは生着が不良で転移も認めなかった。古典的セミノーマもSCIDマウスで増殖・転移し、転移研究に有用なモデルであると結論づけられた。
pmid-2246754.summary_en: The authors used severe combined immunodeficiency (SCID) mice to study metastasis of human tumors. Human yolk sac tumor (YST-2) grew rapidly and spontaneously metastasized to lung, liver, kidney, pancreas and spleen in SCID mice, while athymic nude mice showed poor engraftment and no metastasis. Classic seminoma, which could not be transplanted into nude mice, also grew and metastasized in SCID and double-mutant mice. The authors concluded that SCID mice provide a valuable experimental system for investigating metastatic mechanisms.

pmid-2247871.summary_ja: 生後1か月の乳児に発生した良性の後縦隔奇形腫の症例である。気管分岐部から食道裂孔を通って上腹部へ進展し、下部食道に浸潤していた。部分食道切除術により良好な転帰が得られた。乳児期の後縦隔良性奇形腫は報告が少なく、本例は進展様式の点でも稀である。
pmid-2247871.summary_en: A one-month-old infant had a benign posterior mediastinal teratoma that extended from the carina through the oesophageal hiatus into the upper abdomen and infiltrated the lower oesophagus. Partial oesophagectomy led to a successful outcome. The authors note that only nine such cases of posterior mediastinal benign teratoma in infancy had been reported. The report highlights the rarity of this extensive presentation and the surgical approach it required.

pmid-2247930.summary_ja: 左側停留精巣の既往がある男性不妊症患者で、右精巣に石灰化を認めた。6か月後、クロミフェン内服中に精巣腫瘍が触知され、超音波検査で石灰化を取り囲む腫瘍と確認された。乏精子症のホルモン治療中に精巣腫瘍を発症した報告は本例で6例目であり、クロミフェン内服者には超音波スクリーニングを含む注意深い経過観察が勧められた。
pmid-2247930.summary_en: A subfertile man with prior left cryptorchidism had scrotal ultrasound showing stippled calcifications in the right testis without a mass. Six months later, while taking clomiphene citrate, a testicular tumor became palpable and was sonographically confirmed to surround the calcifications. The authors review the association between testicular calcifications and neoplasia and note this is the sixth reported case of testicular tumor developing during hormonal treatment for oligospermia. They suggest closer surveillance with screening ultrasound for such men.

pmid-2248772.summary_ja: セミノーマ12例と転移巣1例を対象に、モノクローナル抗体を用いてアルカリホスファターゼのアイソザイムを免疫組織化学的に検討した。胎盤型様（PLAP様）と肝型（LAP）が検出され、腸型は認められなかった。両酵素は正常精巣より高い酵素活性を示した。LAPがセミノーマ細胞で免疫化学的に証明されたのは初めてであり、病理組織診断の有用なマーカーとなりうる。
pmid-2248772.summary_en: The authors used monoclonal antibodies to examine alkaline phosphatase isoenzymes in 12 seminomas and one seminoma metastasis. Placental-like alkaline phosphatase (PLAP-like) and liver alkaline phosphatase (LAP) were detected in tumor cells, while the intestinal isoenzyme was absent. Both enzymes showed higher catalytic activity than normal testis. This is the first immunochemical demonstration of LAP in seminoma cells, suggesting these enzymes may be useful histopathological markers for seminoma.

pmid-2249123.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の手術で通常用いられる横隔膜下後腹膜アプローチでは届かない横隔膜脚後方リンパ節への、有用な外科的アプローチを報告した。経腹膜的アプローチでは上腸間膜動脈起始部までしか到達できず、進行精巣腫瘍では横隔膜脚後方リンパ節郭清が必要となることがある。関連する解剖も併せて解説している。
pmid-2249123.summary_en: The authors describe a surgical approach to retrocrural lymph nodes, which requires a route other than the infradiaphragmatic retroperitoneal access typically used for testicular tumour surgery. The transperitoneal route reaches only the origin of the superior mesenteric artery, so advanced testicular tumours sometimes require retrocrural node dissection. The paper presents a useful approach to these nodes and describes the relevant anatomy.

pmid-2249209.summary_ja: 両側卵精巣、両側性の性腺芽腫、ディスジャーミノーマを有する46,XX/46,XY核型の真性半陰陽患者が29歳で妊娠に成功した症例である。乳児期に性腺芽腫と微小なディスジャーミノーマを切除した。妊娠の1年後に残存する性腺の大きな腫瘍が切除され、性腺芽腫から生じたディスジャーミノーマと診断された。異常性腺におけるY染色体の悪性化の可能性を示す症例である。
pmid-2249209.summary_en: The authors report a true hermaphrodite with bilateral ovotestes, bilateral gonadoblastomas and dysgerminomas, a 46,XX/46,XY karyotype, and a successful pregnancy at age 29. A gonadoblastoma and a microscopic dysgerminoma were excised in infancy. A year after the pregnancy, a large gonadal tumor was removed and proved to be a dysgerminoma arising from a gonadoblastoma. The case highlights the malignant potential of Y-chromosome material in abnormal gonads.

pmid-2249338.summary_ja: 難治性胚細胞腫瘍の患者10例に、テニポシドとシスプラチンによるP-VM療法を施行した。化学療法単独で3例が完全寛解に達し、放射線療法の追加でさらに3例が寛解した。寛解例の3例は再発したが、再救援療法により無病となった。6例（60%）は18～84か月の追跡で無病生存している。重篤な骨髄抑制が高頻度に認められたが、可逆的であった。P-VM療法は難治性精巣がんに有効と結論づけられた。
pmid-2249338.summary_en: Ten patients with refractory germ cell tumors received a chemotherapy regimen of teniposide and cisplatin (P-VM). Three achieved complete remission with chemotherapy alone and three more after adding radiation therapy. Three of the six complete responders relapsed but were rendered disease-free by re-salvage therapy. Six patients (60%) remain disease-free after 18 to 84 months of follow-up. Severe myelosuppression was common but reversible. The authors concluded that P-VM is effective for refractory testicular cancer.

pmid-2249643.summary_ja: 移植可能なラット絨毛癌（Rcho）が胎盤性プロラクチン関連ホルモンを産生するかを検討した。Rchoは胎盤性ラクトゲンI（PL-I）のmRNAとタンパク質を発現したが、PL-II、PLP-A、PLP-Bは認めなかった。発現産物は正常ラット栄養膜のものに類似し、巨細胞がその産生源であった。宿主雌ラットでは乳腺発達も誘導された。栄養膜分化の研究に有用なモデルとなりうる。
pmid-2249643.summary_en: The authors characterized a transplantable rat choriocarcinoma (Rcho) for expression of placental prolactin-family hormones. Rcho tumors expressed placental lactogen-I (PL-I) mRNA and protein but not PL-II, PLP-A or PLP-B. The PL-I products resembled those of normal rat trophoblast, and giant cells were the source. Rcho also induced mammary gland development in host female rats. The tumor resembles early postimplantation rat trophoblast and may be useful for studying placental PRL expression during trophoblast differentiation.

pmid-2252471.summary_ja: 51歳男性が2年来の右精巣腫大で受診し、横紋筋肉腫と密接に合併した精子細胞性セミノーマと診断された。精巣摘除術後に肺、肝、後腹膜リンパ節への転移が判明したが、本人が治療を拒否し、2か月後に自宅で死亡した。著者らは既報の類似7例を併せて検討し、肉腫様成分が攻撃的な経過と極めて不良な予後に関連すると論じている。
pmid-2252471.summary_en: A 51-year-old man presented with a two-year history of right testicular enlargement and was found to have a spermatocytic seminoma intimately associated with rhabdomyosarcoma. After orchiectomy, lung, liver, and retroperitoneal lymph node metastases were identified. He declined further therapy and died at home two months later; autopsy was not permitted. The authors review seven prior reported cases of spermatocytic seminoma with sarcomatous components, noting that sarcomatous elements are associated with aggressive behavior, metastasis, and very poor prognosis, and may arise from anaplastic transformation of the seminoma.

pmid-2253130.summary_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫(類皮嚢腫)に悪性度の異なる腫瘍が生じた2例を報告している。1例は紡錘細胞肉腫で急速に再発し、術後3か月で死亡した。もう1例は索状カルチノイドで、残存病変なく良好な経過をたどった。悪性転化時は術式が大きく異なるため、症例によっては術中の病理相談が推奨されると結論している。
pmid-2253130.summary_en: The authors report two women in whom tumors of contrasting malignant potential arose within mature cystic teratomas (dermoid cysts) of the ovary. One developed a spindle-cell sarcoma that recurred rapidly and caused death three months after surgery. The other had a trabecular carcinoid and remained well without residual disease, although follow-up was short. Because the appropriate surgical approach differs substantially when malignant transformation occurs in an ovarian dermoid cyst, the authors recommend intraoperative pathology consultation in selected cases.

pmid-2253191.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍(GCT)細胞株7株と卵巣GCT細胞株1株の核型を解析した。全ての精巣細胞株にi(12p)が認められ、卵巣細胞株には認められなかった。新鮮腫瘍での知見が細胞株でも確認された。12q上の欠失は精巣胚細胞の悪性転化における初期の変化である可能性が示唆された。i(1q)やt(15;20)転座などの反復性異常も報告されている。
pmid-2253191.summary_en: The authors performed karyotypic analysis of seven testicular and one ovarian germ cell tumor cell line. All testicular lines carried an i(12p), which was absent from the ovarian line, confirming in cell lines a nonrandom abnormality previously seen in fresh tumors. Additional recurrent aberrations included del(1)(p22), del(1)(q21), i(1q), del(7)(q11.2), and del(12)(q14), the last found in five lines. A t(15;20)(p11;q11) translocation appeared in the ovarian line and one testicular line, and a der(15) marker in two others. The findings suggest that 12q loss may be a primary event in testicular germ cell malignant transformation.

pmid-2253586.summary_ja: ヒト絨毛癌組織をヌードマウスに移植し、低用量または高用量のEGF、あるいは対照を4週間投与した。低用量EGFは腫瘍増殖を促進し、高用量EGFは抑制した。EGF受容体の結合活性とmRNA発現は増殖の変化と並行して変動した。ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)産生腫瘍のEGF依存的な増殖は、EGF受容体の発現量に依存すると考えられた。
pmid-2253586.summary_en: The authors transplanted human choriocarcinoma tissue into female nude mice and treated them daily for four weeks with low-dose EGF, high-dose EGF, or saline control. Immunohistochemistry confirmed hCG and EGF receptor expression in the tumors. Low-dose EGF stimulated tumor growth, while high-dose EGF inhibited it. EGF receptor binding activity and EGF receptor mRNA expression changed in parallel with growth effects, suggesting that EGF-driven growth of this hCG-producing tumor depends on EGF receptor levels.

pmid-2255107.summary_ja: 神経症状が進行した脳転移を伴う絨毛癌の2例を報告した。両者とも長期生存を得ている。脳転移は予後を悪化させるものの、治癒可能な腫瘍であるため積極的な治療は正当化されると述べている。進行性の神経症状を示す場合は、病変の外科的切除に続く化学療法と放射線照射が第一選択であると結論づけた。
pmid-2255107.summary_en: This clinical report describes two patients with choriocarcinoma who developed brain metastases causing progressive neurological deterioration. Although brain metastasis worsens prognosis in this potentially curable neoplasm, the authors argue that aggressive treatment can be justified. The authors describe treatment of both patients and conclude that surgical removal of the lesion followed by chemotherapy combined with irradiation should be the treatment of choice for progressive neurological decline. Both patients achieved long-term survival.

pmid-2258174.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫の壁にみられる多嚢胞性（篩状）構造を、組織学的、免疫組織化学的、超微細構造的に検討した研究である。本研究は、これらの嚢胞が油性物質の嚢胞壁からの漏出と線維組織・小血管内での滞留により生じるという説を支持する。一部の嚢胞は退行した皮脂腺に由来する可能性も示唆された。
pmid-2258174.summary_en: This histological, immunohistochemical and ultrastructural study examined multicystic or sieve-like areas found in the walls of mature cystic ovarian teratomas, which are common in these tumours. The authors propose that these cysts form when oily material is extravasated through the cyst wall and becomes trapped in fibrous tissue and small blood vessels. Some cysts may also derive from degenerating sebaceous glands. The findings support an extravasation-based origin for these multicystic structures.

pmid-2260468.summary_ja: 乳児期早期に発症した縦隔未熟奇形腫の男児症例を報告する。生後1か月時点で気道を圧迫するまでに増大し、人工呼吸管理を要した。生後58日に被膜に包まれた腫瘍を摘出し、病理学的に未熟奇形腫と診断された。4か月後に縦隔腫瘤が再発し、短期間の化学療法の後に再切除が行われ、成熟奇形腫の小結節が確認された。術後9か月以上良好に経過している。
pmid-2260468.summary_en: This case report describes a male infant with an immature mediastinal teratoma diagnosed in early infancy. Presenting with respiratory compromise, the infant had an enlarging superior mediastinal mass. After intubation and ventilation, a well-encapsulated tumour anterior to the thymus was surgically removed at 58 days of age, and pathology confirmed immature teratoma. Four months later the mass recurred; after short chemotherapy, re-excision showed hypertrophic thymic tissue and a small mature teratoma. The patient remained well for over nine months.

pmid-2261383.summary_ja: 米国の放射線腫瘍医600名へのアンケートで、1982年以降に65%が精巣セミノーマの治療方針を変更していた。病期IIでは縦隔照射を省略する医師が多く、照射線量を下げる傾向もみられた。縦隔照射の省略は同部位の再発リスクを高める可能性があり、慎重なフォローアップが必要と指摘している。
pmid-2261383.summary_en: Questionnaire study of 600 US radiation oncologists showing that 65% changed treatment policy for testicular seminoma since 1982. Mediastinal irradiation was omitted by 62% for stage IIA and 38% for stage IIB, and lower radiation doses were increasingly used. The authors warn that omitting mediastinal treatment in some stage II patients may increase failure risk at that site, and that such patients need careful follow-up for recurrence.

pmid-2261406.summary_ja: 馬蹄腎を合併した精巣セミノーマ4例の報告。病期Iの3例は放射線腎炎を避けるため、定期的CTによる監視方針を取り、うち2例は再発後に化学療法で救済された。病期IICの1例は再発して死亡した。後腹膜の解剖学的変化に注意したCT読影の必要性を強調している。
pmid-2261406.summary_en: Four patients with testicular seminoma and horseshoe kidney are described. Three with stage I disease were managed by surveillance with regular CT rather than conventional abdominal nodal irradiation because of radiation nephritis risk; two of these relapsed and were salvaged with chemotherapy. The fourth, stage IIC, responded initially to combined treatment but later relapsed and died. The authors stress that altered retroperitoneal anatomy requires careful CT interpretation.

pmid-2261427.summary_ja: 原発性精巣セミノーマの男性79名を、中央値10年の長期フォローアップで検討し、精巣以外の二次性悪性腫瘍5例を同定した。ほとんどは放射線照射野内に発生し、観察数はSEERによる予想数を有意に上回った(P = 0.04)。著者らは、病期Iの精巣がんに対しては、選択的治療よりも経過観察を支持する結論を示している。
pmid-2261427.summary_en: Long-term follow-up of 79 men with primary testicular seminoma, with a median follow-up of ten years, identified five second non-testicular malignancies. Most arose within radiation fields, and the observed number was significantly higher than the SEER-expected count (P = 0.04). The authors conclude that these findings support observation rather than elective treatment for stage I testicular cancer.

pmid-2261930.summary_ja: 無痛性の精巣腫瘤を有する3例で、射精液と前立腺マッサージ後の液の細胞診を行い、全例で腫瘍細胞を検出した。最終診断はセミノーマ、絨毛癌、混合型奇形癌であった。非侵襲的な検体採取と細胞DNA量解析の併用は、術前の鑑別診断に有用と提案されている。
pmid-2261930.summary_en: Cytological examination of ejaculate or post-prostatic-massage fluid was performed in three men with painless testicular masses. Neoplastic cells were found in all three, with final diagnoses of seminoma, choriocarcinoma, and mixed teratocarcinoma. Malignant cells disappeared after orchiectomy. The authors propose this noninvasive sampling, combined with flow cytometric DNA analysis, as a useful aid to preoperative differential diagnosis of testicular masses.

pmid-2265338.summary_ja: 精巣の類皮嚢胞（単一胚葉性奇形腫）14例の報告。7例は腫瘍摘出と周囲組織の生検、7例は根治的鼠径部精巣摘除術を受けた。上皮内癌は認められず、平均10年のフォローアップで再発はなかった。超音波検査所見は非特異的で、全例で探索的手術が必要であった。
pmid-2265338.summary_en: This series of 14 patients describes epidermoid cyst of the testis, also termed monodermal teratoma. Seven were treated by excision with biopsy of adjacent testicular tissue, and seven by radical inguinal orchiectomy. No carcinoma in situ was found, and no recurrence occurred after a mean follow-up of 10 years. Ultrasonographic appearance was nonspecific, so exploratory surgery was needed in all cases. The authors conclude that excision with biopsy to exclude carcinoma in situ is adequate treatment for this rare testicular neoplasm.

pmid-2265407.summary_ja: ヒト奇形癌細胞株NT2/D1を用いた基礎研究で、ベルベリンはレチノイン酸より速やかに神経様細胞への形態変化を誘導した。c-Ki-ras2 mRNAの発現が著明に低下し、胚細胞腫瘍モデルの分化と癌遺伝子発現の関係を示唆する。
pmid-2265407.summary_en: This basic study shows that berberine induces rapid morphologic differentiation of the human teratocarcinoma clone NT2/D1 into neuron-like cells, faster than retinoic acid. Berberine did not induce differentiation of murine F9 cells into endodermal cells. Differentiation was accompanied by marked down-regulation of c-Ki-ras2 mRNA, although the parent line had amplified expression, while actin mRNA was unchanged. The results link differentiation of this germ cell tumor model to reduced expression of a protooncogene.

pmid-2265807.summary_ja: 性腺異形成とターナー表現型の患者に見つかった顕微鏡的性腺芽細胞腫の症例報告で、対側卵巣に線維腺腫を合併していた。Y染色体を有する異形成性腺では腫瘍リスクが高いことを議論し、性腺線条の慎重な組織学的検索の必要性を強調している。
pmid-2265807.summary_en: This report describes a microscopic gonadoblastoma in a patient with gonadal dysgenesis and Turner phenotype, found alongside a contralateral ovarian fibroadenoma. The authors discuss the higher tumour risk in dysgenetic gonads carrying a Y chromosome. They stress careful microscopic examination of gonadal streaks in such patients to detect incipient neoplasia. The case supports systematic histological evaluation of gonads in disorders of sex development.

pmid-2269940.summary_ja: 卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫の内部に見られた歯牙5本を、走査型電子顕微鏡で観察した研究である。歯の全体的な形態はほぼ正常であったが、エナメル質形成不全、セメント質の不規則な発育、前象牙質層の変化、周囲組織の未熟な骨性突起などの異常が認められた。胚細胞腫瘍である奇形腫の構成成分としての歯牙の病理形態を明らかにしている。
pmid-2269940.summary_en: Scanning electron microscopy was used to examine five teeth found inside an ovarian cystic teratoma. The teeth were arranged in a generally normal sequence, and their gross morphology was nearly normal. However, the study identified enamel hypoplasia, irregular cementum growth, an altered predentin layer, and immature osteofibrous bony outgrowths in the surrounding tissues. The findings describe morphological abnormalities of the dental structures within this ovarian germ cell tumor.

pmid-2273701.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍40例の血清および組織中のPLAPを測定した研究である。セミノーマ組織のPLAP値は正常精巣より著しく高く、非セミノーマより有意に高値であった。術前に血清PLAPが高値だった症例は、精巣摘除術後に正常範囲へ低下した。セミノーマの診断と治療効果モニタリングに有用な腫瘍マーカーであると結論している。
pmid-2273701.summary_en: This study measured placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP) in sera and tissues from 40 patients with testicular tumors using a monoclonal immuno-catalytic assay. PLAP levels were markedly higher in seminoma tissue than in normal testis and non-seminoma tissue. Serum PLAP elevations normalized after orchiectomy, with or without chemotherapy or radiation therapy. The authors conclude that PLAP is a useful tumor marker for diagnosing seminoma and monitoring treatment response.

pmid-2277222.summary_ja: 原発性縦隔セミノーマの29歳男性に対し、動脈内CDDP化学療法を施行した症例報告である。縦隔腫瘍の外科的切除後、腎臓および脊髄への転移をきたし、1987年の縦隔再発に対しても動脈内投与を4コース行った。副作用なく良好な効果が得られ、多職種連携治療の意義を示している。
pmid-2277222.summary_en: This case report describes a 29-year-old man with primary mediastinal seminoma (described as germinoma) treated with intra-arterial cisplatin (CDDP). After resection of the mediastinal tumor, histology showed seminoma, and the disease later metastasized to the kidney and spinal cord. After a left mediastinal recurrence in 1987, four courses of intra-arterial CDDP into the bronchial and internal thoracic arteries produced good responses without notable side effects. The authors highlight the value of multidisciplinary management.

pmid-2278989.summary_ja: 非活性化マウスマクロファージが、マウス奇形癌腫細胞株F9を効率よく殺傷することを示した。活性化マクロファージとは異なる機序で、リソソーム機能に依存し、カルモジュリンやcAMPシグナルが関与する。in vivoでも腹腔内でのF9腫瘍の発生を抑制した。
pmid-2278989.summary_en: This study shows that non-activated murine macrophages efficiently kill F9 teratocarcinoma cells, a murine embryonal carcinoma line, through a mechanism distinct from classical macrophage activation. Killing was independent of dexamethasone, TNF-alpha, reactive oxygen species and serine proteases, and required intact lysosomal function. The cells were phagocytosed alive and destroyed intracellularly. Chlorpromazine, dibutyryl cAMP and prostaglandin E2 inhibited killing, implicating calmodulin and cAMP signaling. In vivo, elicited macrophages at the peritoneal inoculation site prevented F9 tumor development.

pmid-2281547.summary_ja: 松果体ジャーミノーマ16例と精巣セミノーマ18例を超微細構造で比較した。両者に腺分化が認められ、松果体ジャーミノーマでより一貫していた。これは胚細胞腫の早期の癌腫化転換と解釈され、胎児性癌との鑑別の難しさを説明しうる。精巣腫瘍も含むため、中枢神経系は研究の一部である。
pmid-2281547.summary_en: This ultrastructural study compared 16 pineal germinomas with 18 testicular seminomas. Glandular differentiation was found in both tumor types and was more consistent in pineal germinomas. The authors interpret this as early carcinomatous transformation of germinoma cells, which may explain difficulties in distinguishing germinoma, including its anaplastic variant, from embryonal carcinoma. The findings also inform the classification of germinoma and seminoma within germ cell neoplasia. Because testicular tumors are included alongside pineal tumors, the CNS component is only part of the study.

pmid-2283183.summary_ja: ヒト奇形癌腫由来の9細胞株で14種の細胞性癌遺伝子の発現を解析した。多くの癌遺伝子が発現していたが、増幅や再構成は認められなかった。ras遺伝子のコドン12、13、61の活性化変異も検出されなかった。これらの細胞株では、遺伝子が増幅や点変異によって活性化されていないことが示唆された。
pmid-2283183.summary_en: Northern blot analysis examined the expression of 14 cellular oncogenes in nine cell lines established from human teratocarcinomas. All lines expressed p53, c-Ki-ras2, c-Ha-ras1, c-raf1, N-myc and c-fos, with low-level c-myc in some. Southern blotting showed no amplification or rearrangement of c-Ki-ras2, N-myc or c-fos. A rapid dot-blot method detected no activating point mutations in Ha-ras or Ki-ras at codons 12, 13 or 61, or in unexpressed N-ras sequences. The study suggests these oncogenes are not activated by amplification or point mutation in these lines.

pmid-2284276.summary_ja: 完全に腹腔内に存在する仙尾部奇形腫（IV型）の出生前診断が初めて報告された症例である。超音波検査で当初は下部尿路閉塞が疑われたが、追加の検査と造影剤を用いた画像検査により仙尾部奇形腫と診断された。腹腔内型は超音波で誤診されやすいことを示している。
pmid-2284276.summary_en: This report describes the first prenatal diagnosis of a totally intra-abdominal sacrococcygeal teratoma, a presacral type IV tumor. The initial ultrasound suggested lower urinary tract obstruction, which led the team to perform further ultrasonographic examination and contrast radiological imaging. These established the correct diagnosis. The report highlights that intra-abdominal presacral sacrococcygeal teratoma can mimic other fetal pathology on ultrasound, so careful imaging is needed to avoid misdiagnosis during prenatal care.

pmid-2285598.summary_ja: 性腺および非性腺腫瘍のインヒビン免疫反応性を測定した。精巣非セミノーマでは正常精巣に匹敵する活性が見られたが、精巣セミノーマや奇形腫、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）では活性が認められなかった。このためインヒビンは性腺腫瘍の特異的マーカーとしては適さないと結論された。
pmid-2285598.summary_en: This study measured inhibin immunoreactivity across gonadal and non-gonadal tumors. Human testicular non-seminomas and some ovarian benign tumors showed levels comparable with normal gonads. Testicular seminomas, teratomas, a dysgerminoma and ovarian adenocarcinomas showed no activity. Inhibin therefore appears unreliable as a specific marker for gonadal tumors. The authors suggest it may act as an intratumoral growth or differentiation factor. Germ cell tumors are one substantial component among several tumor categories examined.

pmid-2286911.summary_ja: 21週の胎児に発生した巨大仙尾部奇形腫による高拍出性心不全の症例である。ドップラー検査で腫瘍内の大量の血流が示された。胎盤肥大や水腫を伴う胎児9例は全例が死亡した。重症例の救命には出生前に腫瘍血流を減少させることが唯一の希望と結論された。
pmid-2286911.summary_en: This report presents a 21-week fetus with a huge sacrococcygeal teratoma that died from high-output cardiac failure. Marked placentomegaly, cardiomegaly and hyperdynamic ventricles were seen, and Doppler studies showed large flow through the tumor with inferior vena cava enlargement. The authors propose that the teratoma acts as a large arteriovenous shunt. Pooling 45 cases of fetal SCT, they found that all nine fetuses with placentomegaly or hydrops died. They conclude that reducing tumor blood flow before birth is the only hope for survival in severely affected fetuses.

pmid-2287388.summary_ja: 絨毛癌に起因する頭蓋内腫瘍性動脈瘤の症例報告と文献レビューである。腫瘍塞栓が脳動脈に浸潤して生じる稀な合併症である。2個の動脈瘤が化学療法後に消失した。これまでの報告は12例のみである。
pmid-2287388.summary_en: This case report and literature review describes intracranial oncotic aneurysms caused by choriocarcinoma, a rare complication in which tumor emboli infiltrate cerebral arteries. The patient had two aneurysms that disappeared after chemotherapy. The authors report that only twelve prior cases of choriocarcinoma-related oncotic aneurysms had been published. They conclude that brain involvement from choriocarcinoma can respond to systemic chemotherapy, which resolved the aneurysms in this patient.

pmid-2288001.summary_ja: 46,XY性腺異形成症の表現型女性3例から治療方針の変遷を検討した報告。従来は卵巣悪性腫瘍のリスクから子宮摘出と両側性腺摘出が行われたが、凍結切片による評価と適切な病期分類があれば足り、病期Iのディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）でも子宮摘出は不要とする。内分泌療法と胚移植により二次性徴と妊娠の可能性を確保できるとしている。
pmid-2288001.summary_en: This report of three phenotypic females with 46,XY gonadal dysgenesis examines how management has evolved. Historically, these patients underwent hysterectomy with bilateral gonadectomy because of the risk of ovarian malignancy. The authors argue that frozen-section evaluation and appropriate surgical staging are sufficient, and that even stage I dysgerminoma does not require hysterectomy. Reproductive endocrinology now allows cyclic hormone replacement for secondary sexual development and embryo transfer for childbearing.

pmid-2289629.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のBeWo細胞からcDNAクローニングにより、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)のα・βサブユニットのアミノ酸配列を決定した研究。推定配列は正常hCGと同一で、正常と腫瘍由来サブユニットの差異は主に糖鎖にあることが示された。腫瘍マーカーとしてのhCGの分子的特徴を理解する上で示唆を与える。
pmid-2289629.summary_en: This study determined the amino acid sequences of the alpha and beta subunits of hCG from BeWo choriocarcinoma cells by cDNA cloning. The deduced sequences were identical to those of normal hCG, indicating that differences between normal and choriocarcinoma subunits lie mainly in carbohydrate moieties rather than the peptide chain. Several base changes in untranslated and coding regions were found without altering amino acids. The work clarifies molecular features of tumor-derived hCG relevant to its use as a tumor marker.

pmid-2289662.summary_ja: 健診の超音波検査で発見された46歳男性の膵臓原発類皮嚢腫の症例報告。CTで膵体部の膨張性病変が示唆され、左膵切除術で膵実質内の類皮嚢腫が確認された。1918年から1977年までの報告は11例のみであり、選択的な嚢腫摘出術が適切な外科的治療と考えられるとしている。
pmid-2289662.summary_en: This case report describes a dermoid cyst arising from the pancreas in a 46-year-old man, discovered incidentally on ultrasonography during a health check. CT suggested an expansive mass at the pancreatic body, and left pancreatectomy revealed a dermoid cyst within the pancreatic parenchyma. Only 11 cases had been reported between 1918 and 1977. The authors conclude that elective enucleation of the cyst is an adequate surgical treatment.

pmid-2291342.summary_ja: 生命を脅かす呼吸困難を呈した新生児女児の先天性鼻咽頭奇形腫（epignathus）の症例報告。完全切除が達成された。この希少な病変について治療方針と鑑別診断を論じ、文献の概説を添えている。新生児期の呼吸管理を要する希少疾患として、その診療上の要点がまとめられている。
pmid-2291342.summary_en: This case report describes a newborn girl with a congenital nasopharyngeal teratoma, known as epignathus, presenting with life-threatening respiratory distress. Complete surgical excision was achieved. The authors discuss the management strategy and differential diagnosis for this rare lesion, accompanied by a review of the published literature on congenital nasopharyngeal teratomas.

pmid-2291344.summary_ja: 全切除で治療された乳児の悪性胃奇形腫の症例報告。胃奇形腫における悪性腫瘍の発生は極めてまれで、通常は良性病変として扱われる。著者らの知る限り、悪性組織像を示す胃奇形腫の報告は本例が2例目であり、悪性の可能性を認識する必要性を示している。
pmid-2291344.summary_en: This report describes an infant with a malignant gastric teratoma treated by total excision. Malignancy in gastric teratomas is extremely rare, and such lesions are generally regarded and managed as benign. The authors state that this is only the second reported gastric teratoma with malignant histology, underscoring the rarity of the condition and the need to recognize its malignant potential.

pmid-2293232.summary_ja: 卵巣の再発悪性腫瘍89例に対する外科治療を検討した。未熟奇形腫の5年生存率は75%であったが、卵黄嚢腫瘍は3.6%と低かった。未熟奇形腫とディスジャーミノーマには反復的な減量手術が有用で、卵黄嚢腫瘍などには補助療法の併用が必要と結論づけている。
pmid-2293232.summary_en: This study reviews 89 cases of recurrent ovarian malignancies treated surgically. Five-year survival was 75% for immature teratoma, but only 6.1% for epithelial carcinoma and 3.6% for endodermal sinus tumor. Two recurrent dysgerminomas survived over ten years. The authors conclude that repeated debulking is worthwhile for recurrent immature teratoma and dysgerminoma, whereas epithelial and endodermal sinus tumors require new adjuvant therapy after debulking.

pmid-2293746.summary_ja: デンマークの全国がん登録に基づき、精巣がん患者の出生月分布を検討した。1950～1959年生まれの胎児性癌にのみ12か月周期が認められたが、症例数は少ない。全体には明確な出生月の偏りはないと結論づけている。
pmid-2293746.summary_en: This Danish registry-based study examined birth-month distribution in testicular cancer patients over 40 years. A significant 12-month cycle was found only in embryonal carcinoma among men born 1950-1959, with small case numbers. Significant 2-month cycles appeared for all testicular cancers and histologic subgroups. The authors conclude there is little evidence for a systematic birth-month variation in testicular cancer.

pmid-2293856.summary_ja: メイヨークリニックで化学療法前後の精巣胚細胞腫瘍の両側性発生を後方視的に比較した。両側性の割合は1935～1944年の1.02%から1977～1986年の3.2%に増加した。異時性発生が多く、停留精巣の既往は16例中2例のみであった。
pmid-2293856.summary_en: This retrospective Mayo Clinic review compared bilateral testicular tumors before and after the chemotherapy era. Bilateral disease occurred in 1.02% of patients in 1935-1944 and 3.2% in 1977-1986, with metachronous tumors most common in the modern era. Only two of 16 bilateral cases had prior undescended testes. The authors suggest the rising incidence of bilateral tumors may reflect improved cure rates of the first tumor.

pmid-2293868.summary_ja: 1927～1984年にラジウムヘメット施設で治療された純粋な卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ60例を検討した。中央値19年の追跡で、5年生存率は83%であった。1963年以降に高エネルギーX線治療が導入されてからはディスジャーミノーマによる死亡はなく、手術に加えた外照射は有効と結論づけている。
pmid-2293868.summary_en: This Radiumhemmet series reviewed 60 women treated for pure ovarian dysgerminoma from 1927 to 1984, with surgery followed by radiotherapy. Median follow-up was 19 years. Actuarial 5-year survival, counting only dysgerminoma deaths, was 83%, and no dysgerminoma deaths occurred after megavoltage radiotherapy was introduced in 1963. The authors conclude that external irradiation is an effective complement to surgery.

pmid-2295455.summary_ja: 多能性を持つヒト胎児性癌細胞株NEC 14をヘキサメチレンビスアセトアミドで分化誘導した。分化細胞は一時的に増殖能と腫瘍形成能を失い、分化マーカーやHLA抗原などを発現した。がん治療における分化誘導因子のスクリーニング系として有用と提案している。
pmid-2295455.summary_en: This in vitro study induced differentiation of the pluripotent human embryonal carcinoma line NEC 14 using hexamethylene bisacetamide. Differentiated cells temporarily lost proliferative capacity and tumorigenicity in nude mice, and expressed differentiation markers, HLA antigens, and intermediate filaments. The loss of tumorigenic potential was not restored after the inducer was removed. The authors propose this system for screening differentiation modifiers in cancer therapy.

pmid-2296419.summary_ja: ホノルルで37,159件の分娩中に見つかった付属器腫瘤228例を検討した。良性嚢胞性奇形腫は15.8%を占め、悪性や境界悪性腫瘍はなかった。フィリピン系女性で良性嚢胞性奇形腫の頻度が有意に高かった。
pmid-2296419.summary_en: This Honolulu study reviewed 228 adnexal masses found among 37,159 deliveries. Hydatid cysts of Morgagni were most common, followed by benign cystic teratomas (15.8%), epithelial cystadenomas, and paraovarian cysts. No malignant or borderline tumors were found. Benign cystic teratomas were more frequent among Filipino women, and the authors demonstrated a significantly increased incidence in that group.

pmid-2297631.summary_ja: ジョンズ・ホプキンス病院で1975～1987年に放射線療法を受けた精巣セミノーマ61例を検討した。中央値5.5年の追跡で57例が無病であった。リンパ管造影とCTによる病期分類で38%の症例で照射野が変更された。適切な病期分類と十分な照射線量により10年無病生存率は92%であった。
pmid-2297631.summary_en: This Johns Hopkins study reviewed 61 patients with testicular seminoma treated with radiotherapy from 1975 to 1987. With a median follow-up of 5.5 years, 57 remained disease-free. Lymphangiography combined with CT improved staging accuracy, altering portals in 38% of patients. Five- and ten-year overall survival was 97% and 92%. The authors conclude that accurate staging and adequate radiation dose yield high disease-free survival.

pmid-2297683.summary_ja: 卵巣原発で類皮嚢腫と卵黄嚢腫瘍成分を伴う胚細胞腫瘍から生じた転移性卵黄嚢腫瘍の核型とDNA量を解析した報告です。転移巣は次三倍体型で、精巣胚細胞腫瘍に典型的なi(12p)を欠いていました。この結果から、本腫瘍の発生は類皮嚢腫に類似し、ディスジャーミノーマとは異なる可能性が示唆されました。
pmid-2297683.summary_en: The authors karyotyped and analyzed DNA content by flow cytometry in a metastasis of pure yolk sac tumor arising from a primary ovarian germ cell tumor containing dermoid cyst and yolk sac tumor components. The metastasis was hypertriploid with a DNA index of 1.78 and lacked the i(12p) marker, which is typical of testicular germ cell tumors. Because the dermoid-cyst-containing tumor lacked this marker, the authors suggest the yolk sac tumor pathogenesis may resemble that of dermoid cysts rather than dysgerminoma. The findings provide cytogenetic insight into ovarian germ cell tumor origin and subtype differences.

pmid-2298498.summary_ja: マウス胚を腎被膜下へ移植して生じた奇形腫が、長期間の増殖後に壁側卵黄嚢癌へ進展することを示した動物実験です。卵黄嚢成分や栄養膜様成分は継代移植により次第に消失しました。卵黄嚢癌は一部の奇形腫で後期に生じる事象であり、移植片由来の卵黄嚢巣や分化した胚性幹細胞に由来すると考察されています。
pmid-2298498.summary_en: Seven-day BALB/c mouse embryos were transplanted under the kidney capsule of syngeneic adults to generate teratomas or teratocarcinomas. Slow-growing embryo-derived teratomas were observed for up to one year, and many later developed parietal yolk sac carcinomas. Some tumors contained visceral yolk sac and trophoblastic components that gradually disappeared with serial transplantation. The authors conclude that parietal yolk sac carcinoma arises as a late event in some teratomas, either from yolk sac foci in the graft or from yolk sac formed by differentiating embryonic stem cells. The model clarifies the malignant progression of these tumors.

pmid-2299733.summary_ja: 精巣の上皮内癌（CIS）を吸引フローサイトメトリーで診断する方法を報告しています。不妊患者25例の研究で、片側セミノーマの患者の対側精巣からDNAの異数性ピークが検出され、組織生検でCISが確認されました。本法はハイリスク男性のスクリーニングやフォローアップに有用である可能性が示されています。
pmid-2299733.summary_en: This report describes a diagnostic approach using aspiration flow cytometry for testicular carcinoma in situ (CIS). In a study of 25 infertility patients undergoing testicular aspiration biopsy, one patient had a unilateral seminoma. At radical orchiectomy, flow cytometry of the contralateral testis showed an aneuploid DNA peak, and tissue biopsy subsequently confirmed CIS. The authors argue that this technique can help screen and follow up men at increased risk, such as those with prior testicular cancer, cryptorchidism, or infertility. It highlights a potentially useful tool for detecting premalignant testicular lesions.

pmid-2302353.summary_ja: 1955年から1984年にアイスランドで診断された悪性精巣腫瘍76例を、WHO分類に基づき組織学的に分類した疫学研究です。セミノーマが最多で、続いて胎児性癌と奇形腫でした。発生率は約48%増加し、生存率は時代とともに改善しています。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍を含め両者とも増加しており、発生頻度はアイスランドで高リスク国と低リスク国の中間にあると報告されています。
pmid-2302353.summary_en: This Icelandic registry study analyzed 76 patients with malignant testicular tumors diagnosed from 1955 to 1984 and classified them by WHO criteria. Seminoma was most common (46%), followed by embryonal carcinoma (18%) and teratoma (8%), with mixed histology in 26%. Age-adjusted incidence rose 48% between the early and later periods, affecting both seminoma and non-seminomatous tumors. Survival improved over time, and all 16 testis-related deaths occurred within four years of diagnosis. Iceland's incidence was intermediate between high-risk and low-risk countries.

pmid-2302662.summary_ja: 病期Iの精巣セミノーマ113例を、精巣摘除術後に補助放射線療法を行わずサーベイランスで管理した研究です。3年再発リスクは15.8%でした。再発した13例は全例が救済療法後に寛解しましたが、5例は再再発を来しました。サーベイランスは安全な選択肢であるものの、長期の観察と多くの医療資源を要するため、補助放射線療法が選択されるべきだと結論づけられています。
pmid-2302662.summary_en: This study followed 113 patients with stage I seminoma managed by surveillance after orchiectomy instead of adjuvant radiotherapy, between 1983 and 1988. The actuarial 3-year relapse risk was 15.8%. All 13 patients who relapsed achieved remission after salvage therapy, though five had second relapses. The authors conclude that surveillance is a safe alternative to adjuvant radiotherapy but requires prolonged observation and substantial resources. Therefore, adjuvant radiotherapy should be considered the treatment of choice.

pmid-2302685.summary_ja: 組織学的に卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断された卵巣胚細胞腫瘍に、i(12p)が1コピー以上存在することを報告した短報です。i(12p)は通常、男性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍に特徴的なマーカーです。女性の胚細胞腫瘍の発生にも関与する可能性があり、さらなる検討が必要と述べられています。
pmid-2302685.summary_en: The authors report one or more copies of the isochromosome i(12p) in an ovarian germ cell tumor that was histologically a yolk sac tumor. This marker is typically associated with testicular germ cell tumors in men. The finding suggests that i(12p) may also be relevant to ovarian germ cell tumor pathogenesis in women, and the authors call for further investigation of its role in female germ cell tumors. It is a brief cytogenetic report.

pmid-2304089.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者13例を対象に、視床下部-下垂体-精巣系の内分泌機能と精巣組織の機能を検討した。腫瘍組織ではエストラジオールが高値で、精子形成と運動能が障害され、ステロイド合成酵素が阻害されていた。腫瘍産生のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が周囲の正常精巣でエストラジオール産生を促し、精子形成障害を来すと考察された。
pmid-2304089.summary_en: Thirteen men with testicular cancer underwent endocrine testing of the hypothalamic-pituitary-testicular axis, compared with 11 controls, and tumor and adjacent normal testis tissue were studied in vitro. Tumor tissue showed elevated estradiol, impaired spermatogenesis and sperm motility, and blocked steroidogenic enzymes. The authors propose a paracrine-endocrine mechanism: tumor-produced hCG stimulates estradiol production by adjacent normal testicular tissue, and the excess estradiol impairs spermatogenesis.

pmid-2304163.summary_ja: 精巣がん148例の診断遅延と予後を18年間にわたり後方視的に検討した。症状出現から受診までの平均期間は21.1週で、期間に変化はなかった。非セミノーマでは遅延が長いほど病期が進行し、16週を超えると生存率が低下した。この影響はシスプラチン導入前に強く、導入後（1979年以降）は弱まった。
pmid-2304163.summary_en: Records of 148 testicular cancer patients with known diagnostic delay were reviewed over 18 years. Mean symptomatic interval was 21.1 weeks and did not change over time. For nonseminoma, longer delay correlated with higher stage and, beyond 16 weeks, lowered survival. This effect was strong in the pre-cisplatin era but attenuated after 1979. Delay did not affect stage or survival in seminoma. The authors encourage testicular self-examination and patient and physician education to reduce delay.

pmid-2304164.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの精巣セミノーマと病期II以上の症例を比較し、原発巣の特徴を検討した。血管腔浸潤は病期I（17%）より進行例（39%）で多かった。血管浸潤は傍大動脈リンパ節の潜在性転移の予測因子となり、サーベイランスからの除外基準として有用かもしれない。ただし組織学的な侵襲性所見だけでは病期を区別できず、追加検証が必要である。
pmid-2304164.summary_en: Patients with clinical stage I testicular seminoma were compared with those at stage II or higher for primary tumor features. Vascular space invasion was less frequent in stage I (17%) than in advanced disease (39%). Tunica and rete testis invasion and necrosis were slightly more common in advanced cases.
